Experiments on indoor and outdoor datasets with a Unitree Go2 quadruped show that adapting R is sufficient and improves accuracy by 25% for the trotting gait compared to the fixed-tuned InEKF. Finally, the proposed residual-based adaptation achieves comparable performance to the foot force approach, without requiring foot force measurements or additional parameter tuning.
summary_zh:
**摘要**  
状态估计是行走机器人基于模型控制的关键组成部分，更广泛而言，它适用于任何需要推断隐藏变量的场景。卡尔曼滤波器通过融合多种传感模态，广泛用于估计浮动基座的位置与速度。然而，噪声参数的调整具有挑战性，通常需要专家知识。此外，固定的噪声参数难以适应变化的步态与环境。我们提出了一种针对过程噪声协方差矩阵Q与测量噪声协方差矩阵R的在线自适应策略。具体而言，我们引入了一种基于滤波残差与新息的协方差自适应方法，用于腿式机器人的状态估计，并基于依赖IMU与足底力测量的基线方法进行了评估。所提出的自适应方法在融合IMU与腿部运动学的不变扩展卡尔曼滤波器（InEKF）中实现。在Unitree Go2四足机器人的室内与室外数据集实验表明，自适应R矩阵是充分的，并且相较于固定调参的InEKF，在慢跑步态下精度提升了25%。最后，所提出的基于残差的自适应方法在无需足底力测量或额外参数调整的情况下，达到了与足底力方法相当的性能。
tldr: Proposes a residual-based adaptive Kalman filtering method for legged robot state estimation that automatically tunes noise covariance, improving accuracy by 25% on a real quadruped without requiring foot force measurements.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于残差的自适应卡尔曼滤波方法，用于腿式机器人状态估计，自动调整噪声协方差，在真实四足机器人上无需足力测量即可提升25%的精度。

title: Open-DiffLoco: Open-Source Differentiable Learning for Deployable Blind Quadruped Locomotion
summary: Developing deployable locomotion policies through conventional reinforcement learning often requires complex reward engineering and expensive training times. While differentiable simulation offers a highly efficient alternative, open-source tools capable of end-to-end transfer of these policies to physical hardware remain limited. This paper introduces Open-DiffLoco, an open-source framework for training deployable blind quadruped locomotion policies with differentiable simulation. The framework implements the Short-Horizon Actor-Critic (SHAC) algorithm in MuJoCo XLA (MJX) and trains a proprioceptive policy that transfers to real-world hardware. The deployed policy removes privileged actor observations, including base linear velocity, and does not rely on reference trajectories. It also uses a substantially simplified reward function, enabling the robot to discover walking patterns without the complex auxiliary rewards typically used in conventional reinforcement learning pipelines. When deployed on physical hardware (a Unitree Go2 quadruped), the trained policy tracks omnidirectional velocity commands with root-mean-square error below 0.2 m/s, reaches speeds above 1 m/s, and remains robust to uneven terrain and external physical disturbances, such as lateral pushes. Across the reported configurations, training uses under 6 GB of VRAM on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 GPU and completes in approximately 20-60 minutes. As an algorithmic extension to SHAC, we propose Jacobian-Augmented Value Estimation (JAVE), which supervises the critic Jacobians to improve early first-order policy-gradient training. To our knowledge, Open-DiffLoco is the first open-source framework for training deployable locomotion policies using differentiable simulation. Deployment videos and source code are available at: https://diffloco.martin-opat.com/
summary_zh: 摘要：通过传统强化学习开发可部署的运动策略通常需要复杂的奖励工程和昂贵的训练时间。尽管可微分模拟提供了一种高效的替代方案，但能够将这些策略端到端迁移到物理硬件的开源工具仍然有限。本文介绍了Open-DiffLoco——一个利用可微分模拟训练可部署盲态四足机器人运动策略的开源框架。该框架在MuJoCo XLA（MJX）中实现了短视界演员-评论家（SHAC）算法，并训练出一种能够迁移到真实硬件的本体感知策略。部署后的策略去除了特权演员观测（包括基础线速度），且不依赖参考轨迹。它还采用了大幅简化的奖励函数，使机器人能够在没有传统强化学习流程中常用复杂辅助奖励的情况下自主发现行走模式。当部署在物理硬件（宇树科技Go2四足机器人）上时，训练后的策略能够以低于0.2米/秒的均方根误差跟踪全向速度指令，速度可达1米/秒以上，并对不平坦地形和横向推挤等外部物理扰动保持鲁棒性。在已报告的配置中，训练仅需在单块NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 GPU上占用6 GB以下的显存，并在约20至60分钟内完成。作为SHAC的算法扩展，我们提出了雅可比增强价值估计（JAVE），该方法通过监督评论家雅可比矩阵来改进早期一阶策略梯度训练。据我们所知，Open-DiffLoco是首个使用可微分模拟训练可部署运动策略的开源框架。部署视频和源代码可在以下网址获取：https://diffloco.martin-opat.com/
tldr: Open-DiffLoco is an open-source framework using differentiable simulation (SHAC algorithm in MJX) to train blind quadruped locomotion policies that transfer to real hardware with simple rewards and low resource usage.
tldr_zh: Open-DiffLoco 是一个开源框架，利用可微仿真（MJX 中的 SHAC 算法）训练盲态四足运动策略，能以简单奖励和低资源消耗迁移到真实硬件。

title: MANGO-Grasp: Mahalanobis Fields over Geometry-Oriented 3D Gaussians for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasping
summary: Cross-embodiment dexterous grasping aims to synthesize stable grasps across heterogeneous multi-fingered hands with little or no embodiment-specific tuning. Existing interaction-centric methods achieve promising results, but their object representations often underrepresent local surface geometry, while their robot descriptors do not explicitly encode both robot morphology and kinematics. We propose MANGO-Grasp, an anisotropic interaction framework that represents objects as geometry-oriented 3D Gaussian primitives and robot hands as surface keypoints encoded into morpho-kinematic descriptors. The object primitives are adaptively allocated by geometric complexity and shaped as surface-aligned plates with outward normals, encoding local geometry. Mahalanobis fields over keypoint--primitive pairs serve as interaction prediction targets during training and as optimization guidance for grasp realization at inference. These fields rise sharply for displacement along the surface normal but only gently within the tangent plane, matching the directional structure of contact. Grasps are realized with one shared optimization formulation and hyperparameter setting across all embodiments. On the CMAP and MultiGripperGrasp benchmarks, MANGO-Grasp outperforms the strongest seen-hand baseline by up to 8.24 percentage points in simulation. It also transfers zero-shot to the unseen SharpaWave hand, improving over the strongest zero-shot baseline by up to 16.57 percentage points, and achieves 86% success in real-world experiments. The code and additional materials will be made available upon publication at https://connor-zh.github.io/MANGO-Grasp/.
summary_zh: 跨体现灵巧抓取旨在跨异构多指手合成稳定抓取，且几乎不需要针对特定手型进行调整。现有以交互为中心的方法取得了显著成果，但其物体表征往往未能充分表达局部表面几何结构，而机器人描述符也未显式编码机器人形态与运动学信息。我们提出MANGO-Grasp，一个各向异性交互框架，将物体表示为面向几何的三维高斯原语，将机械手表示为编码为形态-运动学描述符的表面关键点。物体原语根据几何复杂度自适应分配，并塑形为带有外法线的曲面贴合板状结构，以编码局部几何。关键点-原语对上的马氏距离场在训练阶段作为交互预测目标，在推理阶段作为抓取实现的优化引导。这些距离场沿表面法线方向位移时急剧上升，而在切平面内仅平缓变化，与接触的方向性结构相匹配。所有手型均使用统一的优化公式和超参数设置实现抓取。在CMAP和MultiGripperGrasp基准测试中，MANGO-Grasp在仿真环境中相较于最强的已见过手型基线提升了高达8.24个百分点。它还能零样本迁移至未见过的SharpaWave手，相较于最强的零样本基线提升了高达16.57个百分点，并在真实世界实验中实现了86%的成功率。代码及附加材料将在论文发表后于https://connor-zh.github.io/MANGO-Grasp/ 提供。
tldr: MANGO-Grasp introduces an anisotropic interaction framework using geometry-oriented 3D Gaussians and morpho-kinematic descriptors to achieve cross-embodiment dexterous grasping with zero-shot transfer to unseen robot hands.
tldr_zh: MANGO-Grasp 提出了一种各向异性交互框架，利用几何导向的3D高斯原语和形态运动学描述符，实现跨形态灵巧抓取并零样本迁移到未见过的机器手。

title: World Action Models in Real Time: An Empirical Study of Smooth Execution via Asynchronous Deployment
summary: World Action Models generate fixed-horizon action chunks through iterative denoising, creating substantial inference latency that can cause pauses, stale actions, and discontinuities during robotic execution. We present an empirical study of asynchronous deployment strategies that overlap model inference with action execution to enable responsive and smooth control. We compare six strategies, including synchronous execution, pure asynchronous switching, post-hoc action blending, denoising-time blending, inference-time velocity guidance, and prefix-conditioned generation, on a 10 Hz bimanual robot. Evaluation combines offline trajectory analysis with online experiments across dynamic manipulation, precision-critical placement, and long-horizon tasks. Our results identify accurate temporal alignment between observations, predictions, and executed commands as a fundamental requirement. Alignment errors produce persistent chunk-boundary discontinuities that cannot be corrected through blending alone. With proper alignment, direct action weighting provides a simple and smooth baseline but sacrifices accuracy in precision-critical tasks. Inference-time velocity guidance fails to reliably constrain committed actions on our platform. In contrast, prefix-conditioned generation achieves the best overall balance between task performance, execution speed, and trajectory smoothness by learning consistent action continuations during training. These findings clarify the practical trade-offs among asynchronous deployment strategies and provide guidance for deploying high-latency World Action Models in real-time robotic systems.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型通过迭代去噪生成固定时域的动作片段，这会带来显著的推理延迟，导致机器人执行过程中出现停顿、动作滞后及连续性中断。我们针对异步部署策略开展了实证研究，该策略将模型推理与动作执行进行重叠，以实现响应迅速且流畅的控制。在10 Hz双臂机器人平台上，我们比较了六种策略：同步执行、纯异步切换、事后动作混合、去噪时混合、推理时速度引导以及前缀条件生成。评估结合了离线轨迹分析与在线实验，涵盖动态操控、精度关键型放置及长时域任务。研究结果表明，观测、预测与执行指令之间的精确时间对齐是基本要求。对齐误差会产生持续的片段边界不连续性，仅通过混合无法修正。在正确对齐条件下，直接动作加权提供了简单平滑的基线方案，但在精度关键型任务中会牺牲准确性。推理时速度引导在我们的平台上无法可靠约束已提交的动作。相比之下，前缀条件生成通过在训练过程中学习一致的动作延续，在任务性能、执行速度与轨迹平滑度之间取得了最佳整体平衡。这些发现厘清了异步部署策略之间的实际权衡，为在实时机器人系统中部署高延迟世界动作模型提供了指导。
tldr: This paper empirically compares six asynchronous deployment strategies for real-time robotic control with high-latency World Action Models, finding that prefix-conditioned generation best balances smoothness and accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文实证比较了六种异步部署策略，用于高延迟世界动作模型的实时机器人控制，发现前缀条件生成在平滑性和准确性之间取得了最佳平衡。

title: Teleopit: A Full-Embodiment Humanoid Teleoperation System
summary: Humanoid teleoperation for demonstration collection requires coordinated whole-body motion, continuous dexterous hand control, and viewpoint control. Existing systems either simplify hand commands or depend on dedicated wearable sensors for fine-grained hand motion. We introduce Teleopit, a full-embodiment teleoperation system that maps body, hand, and head signals from VR to a humanoid body, configurable dexterous hands, and a 2-DoF active vision module. A history encoder and failure-aware rewind sampling improve the motion tracker on both motion-capture and live VR references. An optimization-based hand retargeter combines normalized finger directions, fingertip closure, and thumb-frame alignment to map human hand motion to different dexterous hands without tuning hand-specific objective or solver hyperparameters. Component experiments evaluate tracking success rate and retargeting behavior, while real-robot teleoperation demonstrates coordinated locomotion, manipulation, and viewpoint control. ACT and GR00T N1.7 policies trained on 96 successful demonstrations collected with Teleopit achieve task success rates of 90.0% and 95.0%, respectively, when deployed on the humanoid. The project page is available at https://botrunner64.github.io/teleopit-page.
summary_zh: 用于演示采集的人形遥操作需要协调全身运动、持续灵巧手部控制以及视角控制。现有系统要么对手部指令进行简化，要么依赖专用可穿戴传感器来获取精细手部运动。我们提出Teleopit，一种全身遥操作系统，可将来自VR的身体、手部和头部信号映射至人形身体、可配置灵巧手以及一个二自由度主动视觉模块。历史编码器和故障感知重采样改进了运动追踪器在动作捕捉和实时VR参考中的表现。基于优化的手部重定向器结合归一化手指方向、指尖闭合与拇指框架对齐，可将人类手部运动映射到不同灵巧手上，无需调整手部特定目标或求解器超参数。组件实验评估了追踪成功率与重定向行为，真实机器人遥操作则验证了协调运动、操作与视角控制。采用Teleopit采集的96组成功演示训练的ACT与GR00T N1.7策略，在人形机器人上部署时分别达到90.0%与95.0%的任务成功率。项目页面访问地址：https://botrunner64.github.io/teleopit-page。
tldr: Teleopit is a full-embodiment teleoperation system that maps VR-based body, hand, and head signals to a humanoid robot, enabling coordinated locomotion, manipulation, and viewpoint control for demonstration collection, and achieves high task success rates with ACT and GR00T N1.7 policies.
tldr_zh: Teleopit 是一个全身遥操作系统，将 VR 中的身体、手和头部信号映射到人形机器人，实现协调的运动、操作和视角控制以收集示范数据，并使用 ACT 和 GR00T N1.7 策略在任务中取得了高成功率。

title: CoNav-UAV: Cooperative Dual-Altitude Aerial Navigation via Stackelberg Learning
summary: Target-oriented vision-and-language navigation (VLN) on aerial platforms is attracting growing attention for missions such as disaster rescue, infrastructure inspection, and security patrol. In this task, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) needs to locate targets given only a concise description of their appearance and surroundings. This requires global exploration and grounding as well as collision-free close-range approach, two interleaved processes difficult to reconcile within a single agent. Most existing methods transfer the ground VLN paradigm to a low-altitude UAV and compensate for its inefficient exploration with external assistance. A recent attempt deploys two UAVs at complementary altitudes yet still relies on privileged information and trains its two agents independently, precluding any mutual adaptation essential for cooperation. Here we propose CoNav-UAV, which explicitly models the task as a Stackelberg game between a high-altitude leader and a low-altitude follower, with the system operating on onboard visual and linguistic inputs alone. To solve this game, we introduce Iterative Stackelberg Learning. The leader's high-level vision-language reasoning is refined via memory-based in-context learning, while the follower's precise motion control is updated via DAgger-style expert distillation. The alternation drives both agents toward a Stackelberg equilibrium. CoNav-UAV consistently outperforms single- and dual-agent baselines across three high-fidelity urban scenes from the AerialVLN benchmark. Success rate improves by up to 30.8 points on the learning scene, and 9.0 points under cross-scene transfer while using about 3x less adaptation data. Further analyses validate the complementary gains of the leader and follower updates and reveal robust gains yet distinct learning dynamics across VLM backbones.
summary_zh: 面向空中平台的视觉与语言导航（VLN）任务正因其在灾难救援、基础设施巡检及安防巡逻等领域的应用潜力而受到日益关注。在该任务中，无人航空器需仅凭对目标外观及周边环境的简洁描述定位目标，这要求其具备全局探索与接地定位能力，同时实现无碰撞的近距离接近——这两个相互交织的过程难以在单一智能体中协调统一。现有方法大多将地面VLN范式迁移至低空无人机，并借助外部辅助弥补其探索效率不足。近期有研究尝试在互补高度部署两架无人机，但仍依赖特权信息，且将两个智能体独立训练，阻碍了合作中至关重要的相互适应。本文提出CoNav-UAV，将任务显式建模为高空主导者与低空跟随者之间的Stackelberg博弈，系统仅依赖机载视觉与语言输入运行。为求解该博弈，我们引入迭代Stackelberg学习：通过基于记忆的上下文学习优化主导者的高层视觉语言推理能力，同时采用DAgger式专家蒸馏更新跟随者的精确运动控制。交替迭代过程驱使双智能体趋近Stackelberg均衡。在AerialVLN基准的三个高保真城市场景中，CoNav-UAV持续优于单智能体与双智能体基线方法：在学习场景中任务成功率最高提升30.8个百分点，跨场景迁移时提升9.0个百分点，且适应数据量减少约3倍。进一步分析验证了主导者与跟随者更新的互补增益，并揭示了不同视觉语言大模型骨干下的稳健性能提升及差异化的学习动态。
tldr: CoNav-UAV proposes a dual-UAV cooperative navigation system for aerial VLN using Stackelberg learning, where a high-altitude leader performs vision-language reasoning and a low-altitude follower executes precise motion control, iteratively refining both policies to reach equilibrium.
tldr_zh: CoNav-UAV 提出了一种基于 Stackelberg 学习的双无人机协作导航系统，高海拔领航者进行视觉-语言推理，低海拔跟随者执行精确运动控制，通过迭代优化双方策略达到均衡。

title: TWINS: A Tactile Wearable Isomorphic Arm Networked System for Contact-Rich Manipulation Learning
summary: Recent advances in robot learning for manipulation have increased the importance of collecting real-world demonstration data. However, existing robotic systems primarily focus on end-effector manipulation, making it difficult to teach and execute manipulation tasks involving body-surface contact with the arms and chest. This paper presents TWINS (Tactile Wearable Isomorphic Arm Networked System), a robotic system for manipulation involving body-surface contact. TWINS consists of a Wearable Dual-Arm Device, which is worn by the operator, and an Isomorphic Robot with the same joint configuration and external dimensions. Distributed tactile sensors embedded in the chest and arms enable the measurement of body-surface contact synchronized with joint motion. Using the Wearable Dual-Arm Device, we collected demonstrations for four manipulation tasks involving body-surface contact. We then trained imitation learning policies using the collected demonstrations and deployed them on the Isomorphic Robot, enabling manipulation guided by body-surface tactile observations. Experimental results demonstrate that TWINS provides a unified robotic system for demonstration, learning, and execution of manipulation involving body-surface contact. https://mmurooka.github.io/twins-project-page/
summary_zh: 近期，机器人操作学习领域的进展使得采集真实世界示范数据的重要性日益凸显。然而，现有机器人系统主要聚焦于末端执行器操作，难以教授并执行涉及手臂与胸部体表接触的操作任务。本文提出TWINS（触觉可穿戴同构臂式网络系统），这是一款用于体表接触操作的机器人系统。TWINS由操作员穿戴的双臂可穿戴设备与具有相同关节构型及外部尺寸的同构机器人组成。嵌入胸部与手臂的分布式触觉传感器可同步测量体表接触与关节运动。通过可穿戴双臂设备，我们采集了四项涉及体表接触的操作任务示范数据。随后基于采集的示范数据训练模仿学习策略，并将其部署于同构机器人上，实现了由体表触觉观测引导的操作。实验结果表明，TWINS为涉及体表接触操作的演示、学习与执行提供了统一的机器人系统。https://mmurooka.github.io/twins-project-page/
tldr: TWINS is a dual-arm wearable teleoperation system with distributed tactile sensing that enables collection of demonstrations and learning of policies for manipulation tasks involving body-surface contact.
tldr_zh: TWINS 是一种带有分布式触觉传感的双臂可穿戴遥操作系统，能够收集包含体表接触的操作示教并学习相应策略。

title: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap in Parallel-Link Leg Mechanisms via Simulator-Side Dynamics Normalization
summary: This paper addresses the sim-to-real gap in dynamics arising when a parallel-link mechanism is represented by a serial-tree surrogate in simulation. Conventional Jacobian-based state and torque mappings preserve consistency with the kinematic and virtual-work relations but do not account for the coordinate-induced redistribution of actuator inertia and damping and the linkage inertia omitted during serial-tree reduction. To address this gap, Simulator-Side System Normalization (S3N) is proposed to normalize the serial-tree simulator's effective dynamics while preserving its tree topology. S3N-Act incorporates actuator inertia and damping into the serial-coordinate dynamics through coordinate transformation, whereas S3N-Full restores residual linkage inertia by separately identifying actuator- and leg-level frequency responses. In the 2-DoF validation, S3N-Full reduced the joint-position and torque RMSEs by 80.9% and 82.1%, respectively, relative to the Jacobian-mapping baseline. During pitch-in-place motion, S3N-Act and S3N-Full reduced the RMSE of the ground reaction force norm by 65.1% and 62.4%, respectively. During circular locomotion, S3N-Full reduced the phase-averaged, command-normalized sim-to-real gap from 17.3% to 9.9%. These results show that simulator-side normalization improves motion- and force-level sim-to-real consistency. It enables policy training in a serial-tree framework with hardware-consistent dynamics that better represent the physical parallel-link mechanism.
summary_zh: 本文针对并联机构在仿真中被表示为串联树代理时出现的动力学虚实差距问题展开研究。传统的基于雅可比矩阵的状态与扭矩映射虽能保持运动学与虚功关系的一致性，但无法考虑坐标变换引起的执行器惯性与阻尼的重新分布，以及串联树简化过程中被忽略的连杆惯性。为填补这一差距，本文提出仿真器侧系统归一化（S3N）方法，在保持串联树拓扑结构的同时，对串联树仿真器的有效动力学进行归一化处理。S3N-Act通过坐标变换将执行器惯性与阻尼纳入串联坐标动力学中，而S3N-Full则通过分别辨识执行器层级与腿部层级的频率响应，恢复残余的连杆惯性。在二自由度验证中，与基于雅可比映射的基准方法相比，S3N-Full使关节位置均方根误差降低80.9%，扭矩均方根误差降低82.1%。在定点俯仰运动中，S3N-Act与S3N-Full分别将地面反作用力范数的均方根误差降低65.1%和62.4%。在圆周运动过程中，S3N-Full将相位平均、指令归一化的虚实差距从17.3%降至9.9%。这些结果表明，仿真器侧归一化能够提升运动与力层面的虚实一致性，使得在串联树框架下进行的策略训练能获得与硬件动力学更一致的模型，从而更准确地表征实际并联机构。
tldr: This paper proposes Simulator-Side System Normalization (S3N) to bridge the sim-to-real gap for parallel-link leg mechanisms by normalizing the dynamics of serial-tree simulators, achieving significant reductions in joint-position, torque, and force errors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出模拟器侧系统归一化（S3N），通过归一化串行树模拟器的动力学，缩小并联腿机构的仿真与真实差距，显著降低关节位置、力矩和力误差。

title: AffordTrajDP: Dynamic Affordance-Guided Visuomotor Policy Learning for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Affordance-guided imitation learning has shown impressive performance in robotic manipulation tasks by compressing visual perception into task-specific geometric constraints (e.g., fixed contact points). However, the commonly used static affordances can become inconsistent in precision-critical tasks or under object location perturbations, leading to post-contact trajectory drift. To address this issue, we propose AffordTrajDP, a dynamic framework that constructs affordance trajectories via object-centric temporal propagation to guide the progressive manipulation process. Specifically, given an RGB-D observation, our core insight is that a retrieved anchor affordance, which captures the desired contact point between the end-effector and the target object, can be propagated forward via affordance propagation, using the object's SE(3) pose as a natural propagation medium, to yield an affordance trajectory that provides temporally consistent, state-aware guidance throughout execution. AffordTrajDP achieves 70.0% average success rate on ManiSkill3, outperforming strong baselines by up to 17.8%. Real-world experiments on Galaxea A1 and UR7e robotic arms, covering StackCube, PickCup, AdapterInsertion, Ring-on-Peg, Put-in-Bowl, and USB Insertion, further validate robustness under object placement variations and appearance changes, with seen and unseen object instances evaluated on Galaxea A1, and ablations confirm the contribution of each proposed component.
summary_zh: 功能性引导的模仿学习通过将视觉感知压缩为任务特定的几何约束（例如固定接触点），在机器人操作任务中展现出显著性能。然而，在精度关键型任务或物体位置扰动下，常用的静态功能性可能存在不一致性，导致接触后轨迹漂移。为解决此问题，我们提出AffordTrajDP，一种通过以物体为中心的时序传播构建功能性轨迹的动态框架，以指导渐进式操作过程。具体而言，给定RGB-D观测，我们的核心洞察在于：检索到的锚定功能性（捕获末端执行器与目标物体之间的期望接触点）可通过物体SE(3)位姿作为天然传播介质，经功能性前向传播生成功能性轨迹，从而在执行过程中提供时序一致、状态感知的引导。AffordTrajDP在ManiSkill3上达到70.0%的平均成功率，较强基线模型提升高达17.8%。在Galaxea A1与UR7e机械臂上开展的实物实验（涵盖StackCube、PickCup、AdapterInsertion、Ring-on-Peg、Put-in-Bowl及USB Insertion）进一步验证了该方法在物体位置变化与外观差异下的鲁棒性（在Galaxea A1上评估了已知与未知物体实例），消融实验确认了各提出组件的贡献。
tldr: Proposes a dynamic affordance-guided visuomotor policy (AffordTrajDP) that propagates anchor affordances via object-centric temporal SE(3) pose information to generate temporally consistent affordance trajectories, improving robotic manipulation success and robustness in precision-critical tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种动态可供性引导的视觉运动策略（AffordTrajDP），通过物体中心的SE(3)位姿时序传播锚点可供性，生成时间一致的可供性轨迹，提升了机器人操作在精度关键任务中的成功率和鲁棒性。

title: Uncovering and Mitigating Positional Blind Spots in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve promising performance in robotic manipulation, typically measured by success rates aggregated over predefined object configurations, an evaluation that implicitly assumes spatially uniform competence across the workspace. However, this assumption does not hold: even with the instruction and every other scene factor held fixed, merely relocating a task-irrelevant distractor can sharply raise the failure probability within localized, spatially coherent regions, which we term Positional Blind Spots (PBS). In this paper, we propose a two-stage black-box framework to uncover and mitigate PBS. During the uncovering stage, we grid the workspace and apply a one-sided log-likelihood-ratio test to localize PBS cells with significantly elevated risk. During the mitigation stage, we fine-tune the policy via LoRA on demonstrations collected from these PBS regions, improving competence there while largely preserving performance across the rest of the workspace. We evaluate our framework on five state-of-the-art VLA policies across two benchmarks, and find that PBS are pervasive and spatially concentrated in all of them, with failure rates up to 0.58. Our search strategy achieves an average F1-score of 0.678, outperforming random search and adaptive sampling baselines by 0.268 and 0.178, respectively. Guided by the discovered regions, targeted fine-tuning reduces the overall failure rate by 40.00%--85.19%.
summary_zh: 近期，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操控任务中展现出令人瞩目的性能，通常通过预设物体配置下的成功率聚合指标进行评估。这种评估方式隐含假设模型在整个工作空间内具有空间均匀的能力。然而，该假设并不成立：即使指令及其他所有场景因素保持不变，仅将任务无关的干扰物重新放置，即可在局部空间连贯区域内显著提升失败概率——我们将此类区域定义为位置性盲区。本文提出一种两阶段黑盒框架用于发现并缓解PBS。在发现阶段，我们对工作空间进行网格化划分，通过单侧对数似然比检验定位风险显著升高的PBS网格单元。在缓解阶段，我们利用从这些PBS区域采集的示范数据，通过LoRA对策略进行微调，在提升该区域操控能力的同时，最大程度保持工作空间其余区域的原有性能。我们在两个基准测试中对五种最先进的VLA策略进行了评估，发现PBS在所有策略中普遍存在且呈现空间聚集性，其中最高失败率达0.58。本文提出的搜索策略平均F1分数为0.678，分别较随机搜索与自适应采样基线提升0.268和0.178。基于所发现区域的定向微调使整体失败率降低40.00%至85.19%。
tldr: This paper identifies and localizes positional blind spots in VLA robot policies where failure rates spike due to distractor object location, and proposes a black-box framework to uncover and mitigate these blind spots via targeted fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文发现并定位了视觉-语言-动作模型中的位置盲区（受干扰物位置影响导致的失败率激增区域），并提出了一种黑盒框架来发现并缓解这些盲区。

title: STAR-VLM: Spatiotemporal Grounding Vision-Language Models for Motion and Velocity Estimation via Automotive Radar Supervision
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are emerging as a key component of embodied intelligence, with growing applications in auto-labeling and end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing approaches for improving spatiotemporal reasoning in VLMs often rely on complex preprocessing pipelines, expensive human annotations, or synthetic data, which limit scalability and introduce potential sim-to-real gaps. Moreover, although these methods have improved spatiotemporal understanding, they still lack strong metric reasoning capabilities for dynamic scenes, such as estimating object motion in real-world units. Prior work has explored LiDAR-based metric depth supervision to enhance spatial perception, but it does not directly address temporal reasoning. We introduce STAR-VLM, an automotive radar-supervised framework that enhances spatiotemporal VLMs with motion reasoning and metric velocity estimation for autonomous driving. Automotive radar is a low-cost and widely deployed sensor that provides complementary spatiotemporal supervision through range and Doppler measurements. By leveraging these measurements as label-free ground truth during training, STAR-VLM improves the metric spatiotemporal reasoning ability of VLMs. Through experiments on driving scenarios, we show that STAR-VLM achieves state-of-the-art performance on both motion classification and metric velocity estimation, outperforming even task-specific methods designed for each task. These results highlight automotive radar as a scalable and cost-effective source of supervision for building metric-aware spatiotemporal VLMs for real-world autonomous driving.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）正逐渐成为具身智能的关键组成部分，在自动标注和端到端自动驾驶领域的应用日益广泛。然而，现有提升VLM时空推理能力的方法通常依赖复杂的预处理流程、昂贵的人工标注或合成数据，这不仅限制了可扩展性，还可能引入仿真到现实的差距。此外，尽管这些方法改进了时空理解能力，但在动态场景的度量推理方面仍显不足，例如无法以真实世界单位估算物体运动。先前研究探索了基于激光雷达的度量深度监督以增强空间感知，但并未直接解决时序推理问题。我们提出STAR-VLM，一种基于车载雷达监督的框架，通过运动推理和度量速度估计来增强面向自动驾驶的时空VLM。车载雷达是一种低成本且广泛部署的传感器，能够通过距离和多普勒测量提供互补的时空监督。通过在训练过程中将这些测量值作为无标签的基准真值，STAR-VLM提升了VLM的度量时空推理能力。在驾驶场景的实验表明，STAR-VLM在运动分类和度量速度估计任务上均取得了最优性能，甚至超越了为单一任务设计的专用方法。这些结果凸显了车载雷达作为构建面向真实世界自动驾驶的度量感知时空VLM时，一种具备可扩展性和成本效益的监督来源。
tldr: STAR-VLM uses automotive radar as a label-free supervision source to enhance spatiotemporal grounding and metric velocity estimation in VLMs for autonomous driving, achieving SOTA on motion classification and velocity estimation without complex preprocessing or human annotations.
tldr_zh: STAR-VLM 利用车载雷达作为无标签监督来源，增强 VLM 在自动驾驶中的时空定位和公制速度估计能力，在运动分类和速度估计任务上达到 SOTA。

title: Rapid Embodiment Adaptation for Quadrupedal Locomotion
summary: Humans readily adapt their movements as their bodies change through aging, injury, or load carrying, but learning-based robot policies often break when hardware properties shift. We introduce an online embodiment adaptation framework for quadrupedal locomotion that infers embodiment parameters from short interaction histories and conditions control on the inferred hardware state. Our method pairs a generalist policy trained under embodiment randomization with a lightweight adaptation module that identifies physical changes within half a second. We evaluate two representative forms of embodiment variation: joint-range constraints and trunk-mass changes, corresponding to joint-level kinematic degradation and body-level dynamic variation. In simulation, the module accurately estimates these changes and enables closed-loop control that substantially outperforms policies conditioned directly on interaction history. On a real Unitree Go2 robot, our system maintains stable locomotion under severe instances of the evaluated changes, including a fully locked leg and a 5 kg payload, where non-adaptive methods fail. These results demonstrate the practicality of explicit online embodiment identification for rapid adaptation to joint-limit and payload-mass changes, and provide a step toward handling broader forms of uncertain, degraded, or changing robot hardware.
summary_zh: 人类能够根据身体因衰老、损伤或负重而发生的变化，自如地调整自身运动，但基于学习的机器人策略在硬件属性发生变化时往往会失效。我们提出了一种用于四足运动的在线机体适配框架，该框架能从短时交互历史中推断机体参数，并根据推断出的硬件状态实现控制条件化。我们的方法将一种在机体随机化条件下训练的通用型策略与轻量级适配模块相结合，该模块能在半秒内识别物理变化。我们评估了两种具有代表性的机体变化形式：关节范围约束与躯干质量变化，分别对应关节层面的运动学退化以及机体层面的动力学变化。在仿真环境中，该模块能准确估计这些变化，并实现闭环控制，其性能显著优于直接基于交互历史进行条件化的策略。在一台真实的Unitree Go2机器人上，我们的系统在评估所涉及的严重变化实例（包括一条腿完全锁死以及承载5千克负载）下仍能保持稳定运动，而采用非自适应方法时则会失败。这些结果证明了显式在线机体识别方法在快速适应关节限位与负载质量变化方面的实用性，并为应对更广泛形式的不确定、退化或变化的机器人硬件迈出了重要一步。
tldr: Proposes an online embodiment adaptation framework that infers physical hardware changes (joint constraints, mass) from short interaction histories and conditions a quadrupedal locomotion policy on the inferred state, enabling rapid adaptation on real robots under locked joints or heavy payloads.
tldr_zh: 提出一种在线本体适应框架，通过短时交互历史推断物理硬件变化（关节约束、质量），并将控制策略建立在推断状态上，在真实四足机器人上实现锁定关节或重载条件下的快速适应。

title: When Replanning Becomes the Bottleneck: Budgeted Replanning for Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied agents replan frequently to recover from execution drift, partial observability, and coordination hazards, but each LLM-based replanning call can consume an accumulated textual context that grows over time and across agents. Once this context becomes large, replanning latency develops heavy tails and can miss real-time deadlines even when task success remains high, a failure mode that is hard to detect from average latency or success alone. We present BRACE, a controller that formulates replanning as a budgeted control loop by deciding whether to replan, selecting a replanning mode, and allocating an explicit token budget and latency service-level objective (SLO) while accounting for optional efficiency modules. As a reusable component, we introduce E-RECAP, a cost-aware progressive token pruning method that predicts token utility and prunes replanning contexts across transformer layers while preserving critical head and tail tokens. Across Meta Habitat, RoboFactory, and AirSim, BRACE with E-RECAP reduces replanning-call token counts by 62-92% and SLO violation rates from 85.5-100.0% to 4.7-50.0% in settings where task success is already saturated. In a harder RoboFactory setting where open-loop, frozen-plan, and No BRACE all fail, BRACE + E-RECAP reaches 80.0% success with 4.6% SLO violations, demonstrating that tail-aware per-call budgeting is effective across embodied platforms.
summary_zh: 具身智能体因执行漂移、部分可观测性及协调风险需频繁重新规划，但每次基于大语言模型的重规划调用会消耗随时间与智能体数量增长的累积文本上下文。当上下文规模过大时，重规划延迟将呈现重尾分布，即便任务成功率保持高位仍可能错过实时截止时限——这种失效模式难以通过平均延迟或成功率单独检测。我们提出BRACE控制器，将重规划形式化为预算化控制循环：通过决策是否重规划、选择重规划模式、分配显式令牌预算与延迟服务水平目标（SLO），同时兼顾可选效率模块。作为可复用组件，我们引入E-RECAP——一种成本感知的渐进式令牌剪枝方法，可预测令牌效用并在跨Transformer层剪枝重规划上下文时保留关键首尾令牌。在Meta Habitat、RoboFactory与AirSim平台上，当任务成功率已趋饱和时，采用E-RECAP的BRACE将重规划调用令牌数减少62-92%，SLO违例率从85.5-100.0%降至4.7-50.0%。在更严苛的RoboFactory场景中，开环控制、冻结规划及无BRACE方案均失效时，BRACE+E-RECAP仍能达到80.0%成功率与4.6% SLO违例率，证明感知尾延迟的按调用预算策略在具身平台上具有普适有效性。
tldr: BRACE is a budgeted replanning controller that reduces LLM-based replanning latency and token usage for embodied agents via per-call budgeting and progressive token pruning, achieving high success rates with low SLO violations across multiple platforms.
tldr_zh: BRACE 是一种为具身代理设计的预算化重规划控制器，通过每次调用的预算分配和渐进式令牌剪枝来降低基于 LLM 的重规划延迟和令牌使用量，在多个平台上实现了高成功率与低服务级别目标违规率。

title: TALSC: Timeliness-Aware Large-Small VLM Collaboration for Infrastructure-Assisted Autonomous Driving
summary: The deployment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in autonomous driving (AD) systems is constrained by on-board computing power, restricting vehicles to small VLMs (SVLMs) with limited perception and reasoning capabilities. Infrastructure-assisted AD alleviates this resource constraint by enabling collaboration with large VLMs (LVLMs) at edge servers. However, in dynamic vehicular environments, the utility of sensory data for downstream tasks decays rapidly, making timeliness of information a critical concern. To balance the accuracy gains of LVLMs with their latency-induced timeliness degradation, we develop a Timeliness-Aware Large-Small VLM Collaboration (TALSC) framework. Specifically, we first model the Age of Information (AoI) evolution for VLM inference and characterize the coupling among AoI, token length, and task performance to formulate a general timeliness metric. Building on this, we propose the TALSC online scheduling algorithm. Since scheduling decisions have a delayed impact on future timeliness metric and the output token number is unknown at scheduling time, we design a Lyapunov drift-plus-estimated-penalty algorithm and provides a guaranteed performance. In simulation, we first conduct a case study to derive a fitted timeliness metric based on nuScenes dataset, and further show that TALSC outperforms baselines under various communication and computing settings, achieving up to a 12.6\% normalized improvement in Micro-F1 score compared with the best-performing baseline.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在自动驾驶（AD）系统中的应用受到车载计算能力的制约，导致车辆只能使用感知与推理能力有限的小型VLM（SVLM）。基础设施辅助的AD通过与边缘服务器上的大型VLM（LVLM）协作，缓解了这一资源限制。然而，在动态车载环境中，感知数据对下游任务的效用会快速衰减，因此信息的时效性成为关键问题。为平衡LVLM的精度提升与其延迟导致的时效性下降，我们提出了一种时效性感知的大-小型VLM协作（TALSC）框架。具体而言，我们首先对VLM推理过程中信息年龄（AoI）的演变进行建模，并刻画AoI、令牌长度与任务性能之间的耦合关系，从而构建通用时效性度量。在此基础上，我们提出TALSC在线调度算法。由于调度决策对未来时效性度量具有延迟影响，且调度时刻无法获知输出令牌数量，我们设计了一种李雅普诺夫漂移加估计惩罚算法，并提供了性能保证。在仿真中，我们首先基于nuScenes数据集开展案例研究，推导出拟合的时效性度量，进而证明TALSC在各种通信与计算场景下均优于基线方法，与性能最佳的基线相比，归一化Micro-F1分数提升高达12.6%。
tldr: TALSC proposes a timeliness-aware scheduling framework that balances the accuracy gain of large VLMs against the latency-induced information decay in infrastructure-assisted autonomous driving, using a Lyapunov drift-plus-estimated-penalty algorithm.
tldr_zh: TALSC 提出了一种时效性感知调度框架，通过李雅普诺夫漂移加估计惩罚算法，在基础设施辅助的自动驾驶中平衡大型VLM的精度提升与延迟导致的信息衰减。

title: WorldExam: Benchmarking World Models from Apparent Appearance to Inherent Reactivity
summary: Controllable video generation models are increasingly being developed as world models. Accordingly, evaluating them in this role extends beyond the apparent appearance of generated videos to the inherent reactivity of the worlds they depict: the ability to infer from the scene state how the world should react and to generate plausible consequences not explicitly described in the input. Yet existing benchmarks mainly assess visual quality or explicit instruction fulfillment by checking whether requested actions and interaction outcomes are realized, leaving inherent reactivity underexamined. We introduce WorldExam, a hierarchical diagnostic benchmark spanning four levels: Visual Quality, Control Adherence, Spatial Consistency, and World Reactivity. It comprises 1,474 cases across eight dedicated tasks and supports unified evaluation of camera-, action-, and language-driven model paradigms. The World Reactivity level evaluates scene-conditioned reactions and goal-directed behaviors beyond what is explicitly specified in the input. Evaluation of 20 representative models reveals a clear capability split. Camera-driven models excel at camera control, but their interfaces do not support dynamic interaction; action-driven models control subjects more precisely but often leave the world unresponsive; and language-driven models perform better on interaction but follow complex controls less faithfully. No model combines broad task coverage with consistently strong performance, showing that high visual quality and explicit instruction fulfillment do not guarantee inherent reactivity.
summary_zh: 可控视频生成模型正日益被开发为世界模型。相应地，在此角色下对其进行评估，需超越生成视频的表面外观，延伸至其所描绘世界的内在反应性：即根据场景状态推断世界应如何反应，并生成输入中未明确描述的合理后续结果的能力。然而，现有基准测试主要通过检查请求的动作与交互结果是否实现来评估视觉质量或显式指令完成度，对内在反应性的考察尚不充分。我们提出WorldExam，这是一个覆盖四个层级的层次化诊断基准：视觉质量、控制遵循度、空间一致性与世界反应性。该基准包含1,474个案例，分布于八项专门任务，并支持对相机驱动、动作驱动与语言驱动三类模型范式的统一评估。其中，世界反应性层级评估超越输入显式规范的条件性场景反应与目标导向行为。对20个代表性模型的评估揭示了明确的能力分野：相机驱动模型在相机控制方面表现优异，但其接口不支持动态交互；动作驱动模型能更精确地控制主体，但通常使世界缺乏响应；语言驱动模型在交互方面表现更佳，但对复杂控制的遵循准确度较低。尚无模型能兼具广泛任务覆盖与持续强劲性能，表明高视觉质量与显式指令完成度并不保证内在反应性。
tldr: WorldExam is a hierarchical benchmark that evaluates video-based world models across four levels, with a novel focus on 'World Reactivity'—the ability to infer and generate plausible consequences beyond explicit input. Testing 20 models reveals that high visual quality and instruction fulfillment do not guarantee this inherent reactivity.
tldr_zh: WorldExam 是一个分层基准，用于评估基于视频的世界模型，涵盖四个层次，并创新性地关注‘世界反应性’——即模型推断并生成超出显式输入的合理后果的能力。对20个模型的测试表明，高视觉质量和指令遵循并不保证这种内在的反应能力。

title: Quo Vadis, World Modeling?
summary: Continually improving agents require dynamic interaction feedback beyond static supervision, yet direct real-environment interaction is costly, slow, unsafe, and hard to parallelize. World modeling offers a natural intermediate proxy that allows agents to query lower-cost, more controllable feedback before committing to real actions. Classical world models instantiate this proxy primarily through future physical-state prediction, a formulation useful yet narrow for agents that require actionable feedback beyond raw state transitions. In this work, we conceptualize Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies, shifting the fundamental paradigm from physical state transitions to agent-usable information transitions, such as execution outcomes, retrieved experiences or skills, and verification signals, broadening the scope of world modeling to provide versatile feedback for continually improving agents. To systematically map this design space, we organize world proxies into six functional forms based on their feedback modalities: dynamics, spatial, execution, memory/experience, skill, and reward/verification proxies, which together characterize the primary ways world modeling serves agent improvement. We further analyze how these proxies empower agents across three progressive levels: L.1 Inference-Time Guidance, where proxy outputs enrich in-context information for superior decisions; L.2 Training-Time Optimization, where proxy outputs yield rewards, critiques, or synthetic rollouts for policy learning; and L.3 Agent-Proxy Co-Evolution, where real-environment evidence continuously updates both the proxy and the agent for co-evolution. Ultimately, this work recasts world modeling into an agent-centric paradigm, establishing a roadmap for building world proxies that empower agents to plan better, learn faster, and evolve continually.
summary_zh: 持续改进的智能体需要超越静态监督的动态交互反馈，然而直接与真实环境交互成本高昂、速度缓慢、存在安全隐患且难以并行化。世界建模提供了一种天然的中间代理机制，允许智能体在采取真实行动之前，先获取成本更低、更可控的反馈。经典的世界模型主要通过预测未来物理状态来实现这一代理功能，这种形式虽然有效，但对于需要超越原始状态转换的可操作反馈的智能体而言仍显局限。本研究提出"以智能体为中心的世界交互代理"概念，将基础范式从物理状态转换转变为智能体可用信息转换——例如执行结果、检索到的经验或技能，以及验证信号——从而拓展世界建模的范畴，为持续改进的智能体提供多样化反馈。为系统性地构建这一设计空间，我们根据反馈模态将世界代理划分为六种功能形式：动力学代理、空间代理、执行代理、记忆/经验代理、技能代理和奖励/验证代理，这些共同刻画了世界建模服务于智能体改进的主要方式。我们进一步分析了这些代理如何在三个递进层级上赋能智能体：L1推理时引导——代理输出丰富上下文信息以优化决策；L2训练时优化——代理输出提供奖励、批评或合成轨迹以支持策略学习；L3智能体-代理协同进化——真实环境证据持续更新代理与智能体以实现共同进化。最终，本研究将世界建模重塑为以智能体为中心的范式，并为构建能够赋能智能体更优规划、更快学习与持续进化的世界代理建立了发展路线图。
tldr: This paper shifts world modeling from predicting physical state transitions to agent-usable information transitions, proposing six proxies (dynamics, spatial, execution, memory/experience, skill, reward/verification) and three levels of agent empowerment.
tldr_zh: 本文将世界建模从预测物理状态转移转向智能体可用的信息转移，提出了六种代理（动力学、空间、执行、记忆/经验、技能、奖励/验证）和三个层次的智能体赋权。

title: Probabilistic Reachable-Action Verification of Visuomotor Policies via Set-Based Training
summary: Reachability analysis for visuomotor policies is difficult because large visual encoders make end-to-end set propagation computationally expensive and excessively conservative. We therefore freeze the visual encoder and confine set propagation to a low-dimensional interface between it and the downstream policy, with the interface set calibrated from held-out camera-pose perturbations. Propagating this set through the policy with zonotopes yields a terminal output-enclosure width that set-based training optimizes directly. During evaluation, camera-pose perturbations are sampled from the prescribed distribution, and rollout-level split conformal calibration converts the resulting action-deviation scores into a probabilistic reachable-action radius with finite-sample coverage. In controlled manipulation experiments, set-based training reduces this radius while preserving closed-loop task capability, and matched behavior-only, observational-consistency, and pointwise-adversarial controls all leave a larger radius.
summary_zh: 对于视觉运动策略的可达性分析十分困难，因为大型视觉编码器会导致端到端的集合传播计算成本过高且过于保守。因此，我们冻结视觉编码器，将集合传播限制在其与下游策略之间的低维接口上，并通过保留的相机位姿扰动对该接口集合进行校准。利用多面体将这一集合通过策略进行传播，可得到终端输出包络宽度，而基于集合的训练可直接优化该宽度。在评估阶段，相机位姿扰动按预设分布采样，滚动级别的分裂共形校准将由此产生的动作偏差分数转化为具有有限样本覆盖的概率性可达动作半径。在受控操作实验中，基于集合的训练在保持闭环任务能力的同时缩小了该半径，而匹配的行为仅、观测一致性和逐点对抗控制方法均留下更大的半径。
tldr: This paper proposes a set-based training method for probabilistic reachable-action verification of visuomotor policies, reducing the reachable-action radius while preserving task capability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于集合训练的视觉运动策略概率可达动作验证方法，在保持任务能力的同时减小可达动作半径。

title: TravKAN: Fast and Interpretable Nonlinear Traversability Analysis with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: Traversability analysis is a fundamental capability for autonomous mobile robots operating in unstructured environments. While modern machine learning approaches such as deep neural networks and gradient-boosted trees achieve strong predictive performance, they lack interpretability and provide limited insight into the underlying terrain-robot interaction dynamics. In this paper, we propose TravKAN, a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-based framework for fast, scalable, and interpretable traversability estimation. TravKAN represents multivariate decision functions through compositions of learnable univariate functions, enabling compact architectures and symbolic extraction of analytic expressions after training. In addition, we introduce a novel set of handcrafted features derived from the reflectivity channel of LiDAR sensors. To the best of our knowledge, reflectivity has not been systematically exploited for handcrafted traversability descriptors, despite its potential to capture material and surface properties complementary to geometric cues. We evaluate TravKAN on public, real-world urban and off-road datasets and compare it against strong baselines. TravKAN achieves strong performance across all metrics, outperforming conventional deep models and approaching the performance of XGBoost. TravKAN-Lite, i.e., TravKAN's symbolic representation, reveals meaningful nonlinear feature interactions and provides a compact, deployment-friendly, and fast analytic model. Ablation studies further show the robustness of our method to architectural variations and quantify the contribution of the proposed reflectivity-based features. These properties make TravKAN attractive for robotic systems requiring transparency, real-time computational efficiency, and interpretability in safety-critical decision-making.
summary_zh: 可通行性分析是自主移动机器人在非结构化环境中运行的基础能力。尽管现代机器学习方法（如深度神经网络和梯度提升树）取得了强大的预测性能，但它们缺乏可解释性，且对地形-机器人交互动力学的理解有限。本文提出TravKAN——一种基于柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络的快速、可扩展且可解释的可通行性估计框架。TravKAN通过可学习单变量函数的复合来表示多元决策函数，从而在训练后实现紧凑的架构和解析表达式的符号提取。此外，我们引入了一组基于激光雷达反射率通道的新颖手工特征。据我们所知，尽管反射率具有捕获材料与表面特性（可补充几何线索）的潜力，但尚未被系统性地用于构建手工可通行性描述符。我们在公开的真实城市与越野数据集上评估了TravKAN，并与强基线模型进行了对比。TravKAN在所有指标上均表现出色，超越传统深度模型，性能接近XGBoost。TravKAN-Lite（即TravKAN的符号表示）揭示了有意义的非线性特征交互，并提供了紧凑、易于部署且快速的解析模型。消融研究进一步证明了该方法对架构变化的鲁棒性，并量化了所提出反射率特征的贡献。这些特性使TravKAN在需要透明性、实时计算效率以及安全关键决策可解释性的机器人系统中具有吸引力。
tldr: TravKAN uses Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for fast, interpretable traversability analysis, leveraging novel reflectivity-based features for mobile robots.
tldr_zh: TravKAN 利用 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络实现快速、可解释的地形可通过性分析，并采用了基于反射率的新颖特征。

title: Toward Geometry-Scalable Whole-Body Touch for Humanoids: A 3D-Printed Conformal EIT Skin
summary: Whole-body tactile sensing is a prerequisite for humanoids that operate in contact-rich human environments, but conventional taxel arrays scale poorly with surface area, wiring complexity, and robot-specific curvature. We present a conformal electrical impedance tomography tactile skin fabricated through a geometry-adaptable additive-manufacturing workflow. A flexible conductive TPU layer forms a continuous sensing domain, while contact-induced coupling with conductive patches produces boundary voltage changes that are reconstructed using a one-step Gauss-Newton EIT solver. We first characterize the electromechanical design space of the layered structure and show that low-resistance contact-enhancement patches and a porous conductive TPU sensing layer improve sensitivity while preserving printability. We then validate contact localization on a planar prototype, a curved U-shaped prototype, and a qualitative iCub-face-shaped geometry. The curved sensor achieves a mean localization error of 6 mm over 18 contact positions without supervised post-processing. These results suggest that additively manufactured tomographic skins can reduce the morphology-specific redesign burden for humanoid tactile coverage and provide a practical route toward large-area contact sensing for human-centered deployment.
summary_zh: 全身触觉感知是类人机器人在充满接触的人类环境中运行的前提条件，但传统的触觉单元阵列在表面积、布线复杂性和机器人特定曲率方面扩展性较差。我们提出了一种通过几何自适应增材制造工艺制备的共形电阻抗层析成像触觉皮肤。柔性导电热塑性聚氨酯（TPU）层形成连续的传感域，而接触引发的与导电贴片的耦合会产生边界电压变化，这些变化通过一步高斯-牛顿EIT求解器进行重构。我们首先对层状结构的机电设计空间进行了表征，结果表明低电阻接触增强贴片和多孔导电TPU传感层在保持可打印性的同时提高了灵敏度。随后，我们在平面原型、弯曲U形原型以及定性的人形iCub面部形状几何体上验证了接触定位能力。弯曲传感器在18个接触位置上的平均定位误差为6毫米，且无需监督后处理。这些结果表明，增材制造的层析成像皮肤能够减少类人机器人触觉覆盖中对形态特定重新设计的负担，并为人本部署中的大面积接触传感提供了一条实用路径。
tldr: This paper presents a 3D-printed conformal tactile skin for humanoids using electrical impedance tomography, enabling geometry-scalable whole-body touch sensing with low localization error and reduced redesign burden.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于3D打印的共形触觉皮肤，利用电阻抗层析成像技术，实现几何可扩展的全身触觉传感，适用于人形机器人，定位误差低且减少了形态重设计负担。

title: Adaptive Human-Robot Collaborative Painting Combining Preference-Based Optimization and Dynamic Motion Primitives
summary: This work presents a human-centered collaborative framework that integrates Preference-Based Optimization (PBO) and Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs) to optimize robot-assisted tasks such as painting. The system allows the operator to perform the process while the robot adapts its behavior in real-time, dynamically adjusting the orientation of the piece in order to match the orientation of the operator's hand. The PBO framework leverages the GLISp algorithm to iteratively refine control parameters such as execution time, robot responsiveness, and rotation amplification through human feedback. Moreover, DMPs have been modified to enhance the reactive behavior of the robot and its adaptability to ergonomic requirements. The method was validated with a heterogeneous group of participants executing \rev{painting tasks}. The results show that our strategy effectively reduces operator effort while optimizing process outcomes.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种以人为中心的协作框架，融合了基于偏好的优化（PBO）与动态运动基元（DMP），用于优化喷涂等机器人辅助任务。该系统允许操作员执行操作流程，同时机器人实时调整其行为，动态改变工件的朝向，以匹配操作员手部的方向。PBO框架利用GLISp算法，通过人工反馈迭代优化控制参数，如执行时间、机器人响应速度及旋转放大倍数。此外，对DMP进行了改进，以增强机器人的反应行为及其对人体工程学要求的适应性。该方法通过一组不同参与者执行喷涂任务进行了验证。结果表明，本策略在优化流程成果的同时，有效减少了操作员的体力消耗。
tldr: A human-robot collaborative painting framework that combines Preference-Based Optimization (GLISp) with Dynamic Movement Primitives to adapt robot behavior in real-time based on operator feedback, reducing effort while improving task outcomes.
tldr_zh: 一种结合基于偏好的优化（GLISp）与动态运动基元的人机协作绘画框架，使机器人根据操作员反馈实时调整行为，减少操作者负担并优化任务结果。

title: Weights or Skills? A Survey of Robot-Learning Techniques: from Action-Predicting Weights to Robots that Write their Own Skills
summary: Robot learning is splitting into two bets: policies that bake competence into frozen weights (vision-language-action, or VLA, models), and agents that write and refine their own executable skills as code. This survey organises the field around that axis of weights versus skills. Its central analytical contribution is a deep-dive that arranges code-as-policy methods by their degree of self-improvement, from zero-shot program synthesis, through closed-loop self-repair and persistent skill memory, to the sparsely populated cell in which execution feedback, skill memory, and evolutionary search combine into one open-ended loop; only a few very recent systems (for example ASPIRE, ENPIRE, and RoboClaw) occupy that cell. We map the complementary "skills" pole, from unsupervised reinforcement-learning skill discovery to large-language-model skill libraries, and show that the word "skill" is used in at least five distinct senses, of which only the code sense self-improves without gradient updates. We then connect the taxonomy to the emerging skill economy: commercial robot-skill marketplaces now distribute one-tap skills across robots but ship only static playback, which surfaces open problems of adaptation, cross-embodiment portability, provenance, safety verification, composition, and standardisation. This is a deliberately focused survey. Rather than cataloguing the field exhaustively, it examines 77 representative systems across six technique families through one taxonomy and a set of contrast tables, and it supplies operational definitions of the self-improvement mechanisms together with a statement of what each family cannot do.
summary_zh: 机器人学习正分化为两条路径：一是将能力固化于冻结权重中的策略（即视觉-语言-动作模型，简称VLA模型），二是以代码形式自主编写并优化可执行技能的智能体。本综述围绕"权重与技能"这一核心轴线组织该领域研究。其核心分析贡献在于深度梳理了"代码即策略"方法，依据其自我改进程度进行层次划分：从零样本程序合成，经闭环自修复与持久技能记忆，直至将执行反馈、技能记忆与进化搜索融为一体的开放循环体系——当前仅极少数最新系统（如ASPIRE、ENPIRE和RoboClaw）占据该层级。我们系统映射了互补的"技能"维度，涵盖从无监督强化学习技能发现到大语言模型技能库，并揭示"技能"一词至少存在五种不同语义，其中仅代码语义支持无需梯度更新的自我改进。进而将分类体系与新兴技能经济相联结：商业机器人技能市场现已支持机器人间一键式技能分发，但仅提供静态回放能力，由此暴露出适应性、跨形态可移植性、溯源、安全验证、组合与标准化等开放性挑战。本综述刻意聚焦而非详尽枚举领域全貌，通过单一分类体系与对比表格，审视六大技术家族中的77个代表性系统，并提供自我改进机制的操作性定义，同时阐明各技术家族的能力边界。
tldr: A survey organizing robot-learning techniques by the 'weights vs. skills' axis, analyzing code-as-policy methods with varying self-improvement and mapping the skill definitions gap, while connecting to commercial skill marketplaces. It offers a focused taxonomy and identifies open problems.
tldr_zh: 一篇综述，将机器人学习技术按“权重与技能”轴组织，分析代码即策略方法的自改进程度并映射技能定义差异，同时连接商业技能市场，提供聚焦的分类法和开放问题。

title: ProtoAct: Turning Wet-Lab Protocols into Embodied Robotic Actions
summary: Biological wet-lab protocols are written for trained researchers and often leave routine operations, state-dependent conditions, and contextual parameters implicit, making them difficult to translate into robot-executable actions. We present ProtoAct, a structured protocol-grounding framework that converts free-form biological procedures into state-aware, embodiment-ready action sequences. ProtoAct uses ProtoRAG to retrieve manually annotated examples for context-sensitive parsing, employs RefineChecker to detect and revise missing or inconsistent steps, and applies ActSchema to map the refined procedure into constrained JSON function sequences. We further introduce BioP2E, for which we manually annotate 22 cell-culture protocols into 258 monitoring conditions, 910 executable subtasks, and 962 grounded action calls. Evaluation across seven large language models demonstrates that ProtoAct can be effectively instantiated with different backbones. Ablations confirm that retrieval, posterior checking, and schema constraints make complementary contributions. The parsed subtasks further support demonstration collection and VLA model training, enabling successful execution in both simulation and real-robot settings. ProtoAct thus provides a practical interface between biological protocol understanding and embodied robotic execution.
summary_zh: 生物湿实验操作指南专为受过训练的研究人员编写，常省略常规操作流程、状态依赖条件及上下文参数，导致难以转化为机器人可执行的指令序列。我们提出ProtoAct——一个结构化的协议接地框架，可将自由形式的生物操作流程转化为具有状态感知、适配具身化的动作序列。该框架通过ProtoRAG检索人工标注范例实现上下文敏感解析，运用RefineChecker检测并修正缺失或不一致步骤，并借助ActSchema将优化后的操作流程映射为约束性JSON函数序列。我们进一步引入BioP2E数据集，人工标注了22项细胞培养协议，涵盖258个监测条件、910个可执行子任务及962个接地动作调用。基于七种大语言模型的评估表明，ProtoAct可通过不同主干模型有效实例化。消融实验证实，检索机制、后验校验与模式约束形成互补效应。解析生成的子任务可进一步支持示范收集与视觉-语言-动作模型训练，在仿真及实体机器人环境中均实现成功执行。因此，ProtoAct为生物协议理解与具身化机器人执行之间提供了实用接口。
tldr: ProtoAct converts biological wet-lab protocols into structured, embodiment-ready action sequences using retrieval, refinement, and schema mapping, enabling robot execution in simulation and real settings.
tldr_zh: ProtoAct将生物湿实验协议转化为结构化的、具身就绪的动作序列，通过检索、细化和模式映射，支持在仿真和真实机器人环境中执行。

title: Perception-and-action system for humanoid robot task execution in construction
summary: Humanoid robots, with their human-like shape and multi-tasking capabilities, are well-aligned with human-dominated workplaces, like those in civil and construction engineering, where they could collaborate with human workers or autonomously perform physically demanding and hazardous tasks. Despite this promise, limited research has explored how to endow these robots with the practical capabilities needed to perform construction tasks. To this end, this study proposes a novel perception-and-action system that enables humanoid robots to learn and perform construction tasks from worker demonstrations. This system contains two deep networks: Humanoid-PoseNet, which extracts human postures and translates them into mechanically feasible poses for a humanoid robot; and Humanoid-ActionNet, which learns robot-executable actions based on these translated poses. Experimental results demonstrate that the humanoid robot reliably executed eight construction-related actions, achieving an average motion-tracking error of 82.45 mm MPJPE (Mean Per Joint Position Error). This work provides an early step toward deploying humanoid collaborators in construction.
summary_zh: 人形机器人因其仿人形态与多任务能力，与土木工程、建筑工程等以人类为主导的工作场景高度契合。在这类场景中，它们既能与人类工人协作，也能自主执行高强度、高风险的作业任务。尽管潜力巨大，但目前关于如何赋予人形机器人执行建筑作业所需实际能力的研究仍十分有限。为此，本研究提出了一套新型感知-行动系统，使人形机器人能够通过观察工人演示来学习并执行建筑任务。该系统包含两个深度网络：Humanoid-PoseNet用于提取人体姿态并将其转换为人形机器人可实现的机械位姿；Humanoid-ActionNet则基于转换后的位姿学习机器人可执行的动作。实验结果表明，该人形机器人可靠地完成了八种与建筑相关的动作，平均运动跟踪误差达82.45毫米MPJPE（平均每关节位置误差）。本研究为将人形机器人协作体部署至建筑领域迈出了探索性的一步。
tldr: This paper proposes a perception-and-action system with two deep networks (Humanoid-PoseNet and Humanoid-ActionNet) to enable humanoid robots to learn and execute construction tasks from human demonstrations, achieving an average motion-tracking error of 82.45 mm MPJPE.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种包含两个深度网络（Humanoid-PoseNet和Humanoid-ActionNet）的感知-动作系统，使类人机器人能够从人类演示中学习并执行建筑任务，平均运动跟踪误差为82.45毫米MPJPE。

title: DynamicManip: Enabling Dynamic Manipulation from a Single Static Demonstration
summary: Dynamic manipulation is a critical capability for robots operating in complex and dynamic environments, where robots must interact with objects that are moving or require rapid adjustments. However, learning models for dynamic manipulation tasks face two major challenges: (1) the combinatorial complexity of dynamic scenarios leads to substantial data requirements, and (2) rapid variations in dynamics require real-time and accurate policy execution. In this paper, we propose DynamicManip to address these challenges through an efficient data augmentation pipeline and a low-latency imitation policy. We first propose a static-to-dynamic augmentation pipeline that synthesizes diverse dynamic manipulation demonstrations from a single static demonstration. Second, we introduce a dynamic-aware adaptive policy that adjusts its inference frequency according to task dynamics, enabling responsive and effective dynamic manipulation. Third, we build a dynamic manipulation benchmark, which includes diverse dynamic tasks with an automatic evaluation system for scalable and consistent assessment. Extensive experiments in both simulation and the real world demonstrate that DynamicManip not only provides significant improvements in data efficiency but also achieves better performance in dynamic manipulation tasks, with a mean success rate 18.4 percentage points higher and policy-query latency 32.9% lower.
summary_zh: 动态操控是机器人在复杂动态环境中运行的关键能力，要求机器人能够与移动物体或需快速调整的物体进行交互。然而，学习动态操控任务模型面临两大挑战：（1）动态场景的组合复杂性导致数据需求量大；（2）动力学的快速变化要求策略执行兼具实时性与准确性。本文提出DynamicManip方法，通过高效的数据增强流水线与低延迟模仿策略应对上述挑战。首先，我们提出静-动态增强流水线，能从单一静态演示合成多样化的动态操控示教。其次，引入动态感知自适应策略，根据任务动态特性调整推理频率，实现响应式高效动态操控。第三，构建动态操控基准测试集，包含多种动态任务及自动化评估系统，支持可扩展且一致的性能评估。仿真与实物环境中的大量实验表明，DynamicManip不仅显著提升数据效率，在动态操控任务中亦取得更优性能：平均成功率提升18.4个百分点，策略查询延迟降低32.9%。
tldr: DynamicManip proposes a static-to-dynamic data augmentation pipeline and a dynamic-aware adaptive imitation policy, enabling efficient dynamic manipulation from a single static demonstration with improved data efficiency and performance.
tldr_zh: DynamicManip 提出了一种从单次静态演示生成动态操作演示的数据增强流水线，并结合动态自适应模仿策略，实现了高效且性能更优的动态操作。

title: RSC-GestureNet: Reliability-Aware Selective Causal Recognition of Chinese Traffic Police Gestures
summary: Traffic police gestures are safety-critical perception cues for autonomous driving. A deployable recognizer must infer commands causally from continuous full-frame video, remain stable around transitional arm motion, and avoid over-trusting corrupted pose measurements. This study presents RSC-GestureNet, a reliability-aware selective causal recognizer, for Chinese traffic police gestures. The model treats pose confidence as a first-class signal: unreliable joints are down weighted during graph reasoning, temporal evidence is aggregated causally, and calibrated predictions are selectively emitted through a reliability-aware inference rule. We further introduce CTPGesture-C, a reproducible feature-level corruption benchmark with seven pose/RGB degradation families, and an RGB-level diagnostic in which corrupted frames are reprocessed by MediaPipe before recognition. On the complete official CTPGesture v1 split (134,424 labeled frames and 33,451 causal windows), RSC-GestureNet achieves 93.33+-0.24% accuracy, 91.71+-0.27% macro-F1, 91.69+-0.29% online macro-F1, 98.80+-0.07% Early@10, 0.153+-0.013 s TTC, and the best robust macro-F1 among evaluated methods. Under the same split and causal protocol, it exceeds reproduced traffic-specific MD-GCN and HLP-GCN baselines by 3.23-4.11 macro-F1 points and 2.15-3.07 online-F1 points. These results, together with calibration, selective-risk, statistical, adaptive-branching, and image-level re-extraction analyses, indicate that explicit pose-reliability modeling improves early, stable, and robust traffic-command recognition.
summary_zh: 交通警察手势是自动驾驶中关乎安全的感知线索。一个可部署的识别器必须能够从连续全帧视频中因果推断指令，在过渡性手臂动作期间保持稳定，并避免过度信任受损的姿态测量。本研究提出RSC-GestureNet——一种面向中国交通警察手势的可靠性感知选择性因果识别器。该模型将姿态置信度视为一级信号：在图推理过程中对不可靠关节点进行降权重，对时间证据进行因果聚合，并通过可靠性感知推理规则选择性输出校准后的预测结果。我们进一步引入CTPGesture-C——一个可复现的特征级损坏基准，包含七种姿态/RGB退化类型，以及一个RGB级诊断方法，其中受损帧在识别前先经MediaPipe重新处理。在完整的官方CTPGesture v1数据集划分（134,424个标注帧和33,451个因果窗口）上，RSC-GestureNet达到93.33±0.24%准确率、91.71±0.27%宏平均F1分数、91.69±0.29%在线宏平均F1分数、98.80±0.07% Early@10、0.153±0.013秒TTC，并在评估方法中取得最优鲁棒宏平均F1分数。在相同数据划分和因果协议下，它超过复现的交通专用MD-GCN和HLP-GCN基线方法3.23–4.11宏平均F1分数点和2.15–3.07在线F1分数点。这些结果，连同校准、选择性风险、统计、自适应分支和图像级重新提取分析，表明显式姿态可靠性建模能够提升交通指令识别的早期性、稳定性和鲁棒性。
tldr: RSC-GestureNet uses pose confidence as a cue to selectively down-weight unreliable joints and emit calibrated predictions for causal recognition of Chinese traffic police gestures from video, improving robustness to corrupted pose measurements.
tldr_zh: RSC-GestureNet 将姿态置信度作为优先信号，在因果手势识别中对不可靠关节点进行降权处理，并对预测结果进行校准与选择性输出，从而提升在姿态测量受干扰情况下的鲁棒性。

title: DerainSplat: Feed-Forward Clean 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Rainy Views
summary: Although image deraining has advanced substantially, existing methods mainly focus on 2D image restoration. As spatial intelligence applications such as embodied AI and autonomous driving continue to emerge, reconstructing clean 3D scenes from sparse rainy views in a feed-forward manner becomes increasingly important. Existing feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods often assume clean inputs and collapse under rainy conditions. To this end, we present \textbf{\textit{DerainSplat}}, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs clean 3D scenes from only a few rainy views. To support this task, we build a large-scale multi-view derain dataset through a four-stage synthesis pipeline that sequentially models overcast illumination, depth-dependent haze, rain streaks, and lens raindrops, producing privileged weather factors. We introduce a weather net that predicts the weather factors from rainy context and yields two support maps. Scene support modulates cross-view cost-volume matching, while radiance support drives depth-aligned appearance fusion to fill corrupted pixels. The derived geometry evidence further attenuates Gaussian opacity to reduce spurious structures. A rainy cycle consistency re-renders clean views using the predicted factors and aligns them with rainy inputs. Extensive experiments show that \textbf{\textit{DerainSplat}} outperforms existing methods on various datasets, including RealEstate10K, ACID, Mip-NeRF360, and real-world rainy scenes, with strong cross-dataset generalization.
summary_zh: 尽管图像去雨技术已取得显著进展，现有方法主要聚焦于二维图像恢复。随着具身智能和自动驾驶等空间智能应用的持续涌现，以前馈方式从稀疏雨景视角重建清洁三维场景变得日益重要。现有前馈三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）方法通常假设输入画面清洁，在雨景条件下会失效。为此，我们提出 \textbf{\textit{DerainSplat}}——一种仅需少量雨景视角即可重建清洁三维场景的前馈框架。为支撑该任务，我们通过四阶段合成流水线构建了大规模多视角去雨数据集，该流水线依次模拟阴天光照、深度依赖雾霾、雨条纹和镜头雨滴，生成特权天气因子。我们引入天气网络，该网络从雨景上下文中预测天气因子并生成两种支持图：场景支持图调节跨视角代价体匹配，辐射支持图驱动深度对齐的外观融合以填补受损像素。由此推导的几何证据进一步衰减高斯不透明度以减少伪影结构。雨景循环一致性机制利用预测因子重渲染清洁视角并与雨景输入对齐。大量实验表明，\textbf{\textit{DerainSplat}} 在RealEstate10K、ACID、Mip-NeRF360及真实雨景场景等多个数据集上均超越现有方法，并展现出强大的跨数据集泛化能力。
tldr: DerainSplat is a feed-forward framework that reconstructs clean 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes from sparse rainy views, targeting embodied AI and autonomous driving applications.
tldr_zh: DerainSplat 是一个前馈框架，能从稀疏的雨天视角重建干净的3D高斯泼溅场景，面向具身AI和自动驾驶应用。

title: WorldDynCache: Risk-Controlled Latent Dynamics Approximation for Diffusion World Model
summary: Diffusion world models generate high-quality futures, but re- peated transformer evaluations make inference prohibitively slow. Existing caches reuse intermediate features, selectively update tokens, or reuse and extrapolate denoising outputs ac- cording to local drift or short native-space histories. These criteria can miss both approximation-induced latent transition defects that accumulate across skipped steps and phase- or condition-dependent changes in the direction of latent evo- lution. We propose WorldDynCache, a risk-controlled latent dynamics approximation framework with two core compo- nents. First, a lightweight latent-transition risk estimator tracks the accumulated future impact of approximation defects and calibrates its predictions against counterfactual defects ob- served at exact anchors. Second, a condition- and phase- aware lifted latent surrogate approximates latent evolution without extra transformer evaluations. On HunyuanVoyager- 13B and Aether-5B, WorldDynCache achieves 4.92 times and 2.15 times speedups, respectively, while attaining the best gen- eration quality among the compared caching methods across WorldScore, PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.
summary_zh: 扩散世界模型能够生成高质量的未来帧，但重复的Transformer推理步骤导致推断速度极慢。现有缓存方法复用中间特征、选择性更新令牌，或根据局部漂移或短时原始空间历史对去噪输出进行复用与外推。然而，这些准则可能遗漏两类关键缺陷：一是近似误差引发的潜在状态转移缺陷在跳过步骤中累积，二是潜在演化方向随相位或条件变化而产生的偏移。我们提出WorldDynCache——一种风险可控的潜在动态近似框架，包含两项核心组件。首先，轻量级潜在转移风险估计器追踪近似缺陷的累积未来影响，并基于精确锚点处观测到的反事实缺陷校准其预测。其次，条件与相位感知的升维潜在替代模型无需额外Transformer推理即可近似潜在演化过程。在HunyuanVoyager-13B与Aether-5B模型上，WorldDynCache分别实现4.92倍与2.15倍加速，同时在WorldScore、PSNR、SSIM及LPIPS指标上，其生成质量均优于对比的其他缓存方法。
tldr: Proposes a risk-controlled latent dynamics approximation framework for diffusion world models that caches intermediate features to accelerate inference, achieving significant speedups while maintaining generation quality.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于扩散世界模型的风险可控潜动力学近似框架，通过缓存中间特征加速推理，在保持生成质量的同时实现了显著加速。

title: DecoupleGS: Interactive 3D Gaussian Splatting for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Testing
summary: End-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving algorithms require rigorous closed-loop validation in simulation environments offering high visual fidelity, strong interactivity, and real-time performance. Existing approaches, from game engines to static neural rendering, inherently trade off these requirements and struggle with the dynamic scene composition essential for E2E testing. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel decoupled 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) framework tailored for large-scale E2E evaluation. We fundamentally decompose scenes into a high-fidelity static background and manipulable dynamic agents using an object-centric canonical representation. To resolve resulting representational conflicts, we introduce three targeted modules: (1) asset compression via perceptual pruning and vector quantization for real-time traffic rendering; (2) map-guided geometric registration leveraging semantic topology to strictly align trajectories; and (3) proxy-based relighting transferring ambient illumination for seamless photometric integration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoupleGS achieves a balanced fidelity-efficiency trade-off, improves metric and photometric consistency, and provides a practical closed-loop sensor simulation platform for E2E autonomous driving evaluation.
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶算法需要在具备高视觉保真度、强交互性和实时性能的仿真环境中进行严格的闭环验证。现有方法（从游戏引擎到静态神经渲染）本质上均需权衡这些要求，且难以处理端到端测试所需的动态场景合成。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种专为大规模端到端评估设计的新型解耦三维高斯泼溅框架。该方法通过基于物体的典型化表示，将场景从根本上分解为高保真静态背景与可操控动态智能体。为解决由此产生的表征冲突，我们引入了三个针对性模块：（1）通过感知剪枝与向量量化实现资产压缩，以支持实时交通流渲染；（2）利用语义拓扑进行地图引导的几何配准，实现轨迹严格对齐；（3）基于代理的重光照技术，通过传递环境光照实现无缝光度融合。大量实验表明，DecoupleGS方法在保真度与效率间实现了均衡权衡，改善了度量一致性与光度一致性，并为端到端自动驾驶评估提供了实用的闭环传感器仿真平台。
tldr: DecoupleGS presents a decoupled 3D Gaussian Splatting framework with static background and dynamic agent representations, enabling high-fidelity, interactive, real-time closed-loop simulation for testing end-to-end autonomous driving systems.
tldr_zh: DecoupleGS 提出了一种解耦的 3D 高斯泼溅框架，将场景分解为静态背景和可操控的动态智能体，为端到端自动驾驶测试提供了高保真、交互且实时的闭环仿真平台。

title: Enhancing Visual Perception in Foggy Conditions via Multiclass Fog Density Modeling
summary: Autonomous driving (AD) systems have advanced rapidly over the past decade; however, robust perception under adverse weather conditions remains a major challenge, particularly in dense fog. In this work, we investigate fog-aware perception using synthetically generated fog data derived from the Waymo dataset. To support fog simulation, depth images are generated using an iterative learning approach. We consider five fog-density levels: clear, light fog, moderate fog, heavy fog, and very heavy fog. Instead of training a single unified model across all conditions, we train separate perception models for each fog-density level. Experimental results show that density-specific training improves performance in severe fog conditions. In particular, for the very heavy fog class, recall improves from 0.076 to 0.232, corresponding to an absolute gain of 15.6 percentage points. These findings suggest that deploying multiple specialized models, rather than a single general-purpose model, can improve perception robustness for autonomous vehicles under challenging visibility conditions. Future work will extend this strategy to additional sensing modalities, including LiDAR and radar, and evaluate generalization across diverse weather scenarios.
summary_zh: 自主驾驶（AD）系统在过去十年中取得了快速发展；然而，在恶劣天气条件下实现稳健感知仍是一项重大挑战，尤其是在浓雾环境中。本文利用基于Waymo数据集生成的合成雾数据，研究雾感知技术。为支持雾效模拟，我们采用迭代学习方法生成深度图像。考虑五种雾浓度级别：无雾、轻雾、中雾、重雾和极重雾。不同于在所有条件下训练单一统一模型，我们针对每种雾浓度级别分别训练独立的感知模型。实验结果表明，针对特定浓度训练的模型在严重雾况下性能显著提升。具体而言，在极重雾类别中，召回率从0.076提升至0.232，绝对增益达到15.6个百分点。这些发现表明，部署多个专用模型而非单一通用模型，可提升自动驾驶车辆在低能见度条件下的感知鲁棒性。未来工作将把该策略扩展至激光雷达和雷达等附加感知模态，并评估其在多样化天气场景中的泛化能力。
tldr: This paper improves foggy-condition perception for autonomous driving by training separate specialist models for different fog density levels, achieving significant recall gains in severe fog.
tldr_zh: 本文针对自动驾驶在雾天场景下的感知问题，通过为不同雾浓度级别训练专用模型，在浓雾条件下显著提升了召回率。

title: Situation Aware Frontier Prioritization for Quadruped Search and Rescue
summary: Quadruped robots are a promising platform for search and rescue missions because they can navigate cluttered indoor environments that may be restrictive for wheeled systems. However, in unknown rescue scenarios, autonomous exploration must balance map expansion with the likelihood of finding victims, which is not explicitly addressed by clas- sical frontier selection strategies. This paper presents a situation aware frontier prioritization method for single robot quadruped search and rescue. The proposed approach preserves the frontier exploration framework, but extends frontier ranking with information gain, observation deficit, rescue relevance, terrain penalty, and travel cost. The method is eval- uated in Gazebo simulation with a quadruped robot in two indoor rescue scenarios with different levels of difficulty. The first scenario is used as a sanity check, while the second introduces stronger clutter and frontier ambiguity. Experimental results show that all methods perform reliably in a simple scenario, whereas in a complex scenario is different. In that setting, the proposed method achieves the highest completion rate and the highest victim recovery among the evaluated approaches. These results indicate that situation aware frontier prioritization is beneficial when frontier choice becomes nontrivial and rescue utility must be balanced against generic exploration objectives.
summary_zh: 四足机器人是搜索与救援任务中极具前景的平台，因其能够在轮式系统受限的杂乱室内环境中导航。然而，在未知的救援场景下，自主探索必须平衡地图扩展与发现幸存者的可能性，而经典的前沿选择策略并未明确解决这一问题。本文提出了一种面向单机器人四足搜索救援的情景感知前沿优先级排序方法。该方法保留了前沿探索框架，但通过引入信息增益、观测缺陷、救援相关性、地形惩罚和移动代价对前沿排序进行了扩展。该方法在Gazebo仿真环境中使用四足机器人进行了评估，涉及两个难度不同的室内救援场景。第一个场景用于基础验证，第二个场景则引入了更强的杂乱度和前沿模糊性。实验结果表明，所有方法在简单场景中均表现可靠，但在复杂场景中则呈现差异。在该复杂场景中，所提方法在所有评估方法中实现了最高的完成率和最高的幸存者找回率。这些结果表明，当前沿选择变得复杂且必须平衡救援效用与一般性探索目标时，情景感知前沿优先级排序具有显著优势。
tldr: This paper proposes a situation-aware frontier prioritization method for quadruped search and rescue that balances exploration with victim-finding utility, evaluated in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向四足机器人搜索与救援的态势感知前沿优先级方法，在探索与搜救效用之间取得平衡，并在仿真中进行了评估。

title: TRACE: Ergodic Trajectory Optimization for Active Scene Reconstruction
summary: Existing active reconstruction systems with Gaussian-splatting maps select observations greedily, optimizing a single next-best-view (NBV) at each step and connecting the chosen views by short-horizon path planning. This greedy decoupling disregards the global structure of scene information, producing inefficient trajectories that waste sensing capacity in transit between selected views. In this work, we study active reconstruction as an ergodic coverage problem: the time-averaged spatial statistics of the sensor trajectory should match a target information distribution induced by the current map. Our approach derives this target distribution online from uncertainty and visibility, and calculates ergodic trajectories via a kernel-ergodic horizon planner with gradient flow and footprint depletion, closing the loop between mapping and trajectory optimization. We thoroughly evaluate TRACE on the Replica dataset against the Next-Best-View (NBV) baselines, improving PSNR by 1.5 dB. Code: https://github.com/spikelab-jhu/trace-active-reconstruction.
summary_zh: 现有基于高斯溅射地图的主动重建系统采用贪婪方式选择观测点，每步仅优化单个最优视角（NBV），并通过短视路径规划将所选视角连接起来。这种贪婪解耦策略忽视了场景信息的全局结构，导致生成低效轨迹，在选定视角间的移动过程中浪费感知能力。本研究将主动重建视为遍历覆盖问题：传感器轨迹的时间平均空间统计特性应与当前地图导出的目标信息分布相匹配。本方法通过不确定性及可见性在线推导该目标分布，并借助基于核遍历性水平规划器（结合梯度流与足迹衰减）计算遍历轨迹，从而实现建图与轨迹优化的闭环。在Replica数据集上与最优视角（NBV）基线方法进行充分对比，本方法TRACE将PSNR提升了1.5 dB。代码：https://github.com/spikelab-jhu/trace-active-reconstruction
tldr: TRACE formulates active scene reconstruction as an ergodic coverage problem, where the trajectory's time-averaged spatial statistics match a target information distribution derived from uncertainty and visibility, using a kernel-ergodic horizon planner with gradient flow and footprint depletion.
tldr_zh: TRACE 将主动场景重建问题建模为遍历覆盖问题，使轨迹的时间平均空间统计量与由不确定性和可见性导出的目标信息分布相匹配，并采用带有梯度流和足迹衰减的核遍历水平规划器。

title: RADAR Perception for Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance onboard small-scale Quadrotor UAVs
summary: Fast dynamic obstacle avoidance (DOA) on uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) demands not only low-latency control and actuation but also reliable perception with sufficient sensing range for accurate obstacle detection and speed estimation. This letter presents, to the best of our knowledge, the first mmWave RADAR-based perception-and-control system for fast onboard DOA. We derive and analyze latency and spatial bounds that relate sensing range, relative speed, and control delay, yielding sufficient conditions for successful avoidance. Our system adopts a lightweight tracker based on interacting multiple models and a controller based on control-barrier functions that directly outputs evasive accelerations. It achieves position errors of less than 0.15 m, 0.93 m, and 0.87 m in x, y, and z directions for 300 experiments with three different object sizes and varying visibility (light and dark), and a similar spread for 90 experiments in smoke. An onboard implementation on a Raspberry Pi 4B demonstrates real-time feasibility with an end-to-end sensing-to-command latency of approximately 14 ms. Code and the full dataset of 390 throws are available (https://tinyurl.com/radardoagit).
summary_zh: 无人机快速动态避障不仅需要低延迟的控制与执行，还需具备可靠感知能力及足够感知范围，以实现精确的障碍物检测与速度估计。本文提出了首个基于毫米波雷达的感知-控制系统（据我们所知），用于实现无人机机载快速动态避障。我们推导并分析了关联感知范围、相对速度与控制延迟的延迟与空间边界，得出了成功避障的充分条件。系统采用基于交互式多模型的轻量级跟踪器，以及基于控制障碍函数直接输出规避加速度的控制器。在针对三种不同尺寸物体及可变光照条件（明/暗）的300次实验中，系统在x、y、z方向的位置误差分别小于0.15米、0.93米和0.87米；在烟雾环境下的90次实验中，误差分布范围相似。基于树莓派4B的机载实现验证了其实时可行性，端到端感知-指令延迟约为14毫秒。代码及全部390次投掷实验数据集已开源（https://tinyurl.com/radardoagit）。
tldr: This paper presents the first mmWave RADAR-based perception-and-control system for fast dynamic obstacle avoidance on small-scale quadrotor UAVs, achieving real-time onboard performance with ~14ms latency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了首个基于毫米波雷达的感知与控制系统，用于小型四旋翼无人机的快速动态避障，实现了约14毫秒的机载实时性能。

title: Hybrid Impedance-Admittance Control with Multi-Link Aerial Robot for Contact-Rich Surface Sliding Task
summary: Multi-link aerial robots can actively deform their articulated structures during flight, giving them strong potential for aerial manipulation. However, they still face substantial challenges in contact-rich aerial manipulation tasks such as surface sliding, which requires both disturbance robustness and compliance to uncertain surface geometry. Force-control strategies such as impedance and admittance control are commonly employed to address these requirements. Although impedance control can provide disturbance-resistant interaction and admittance control can offer compliant adaptation, their opposite force--motion causalities prevent their simultaneous implementation when applied through the same actuation source, such as the rotor thrusts used by conventional aerial robots. To overcome this limitation, we propose a hybrid impedance--admittance control strategy for a multi-link aerial robot. The articulated morphology enables a functional separation of force and motion regulation across joint and rotor actuation sources. In this framework, admittance behavior is generated through joint angle regulation to enhance adaptive interaction, while impedance behavior is achieved by modulating rotor thrust to regulate the sliding motion. This structural coordination allows the robot to leverage the complementary strengths of both control paradigms. As a result, the multi-link aerial robot achieves resilient and adaptive surface sliding. Experimental results demonstrate robust and compliant sliding performance on unknown surfaces.
summary_zh: 多连杆空中机器人在飞行过程中能够主动改变其铰接结构，因此在空中操控方面具有巨大潜力。然而，在执行如表面滑动等接触密集型的空中操控任务时，这类机器人仍面临重大挑战，这些任务既要求具备抗扰动力，又需要适应不确定的表面几何形状。通常采用阻抗控制与导纳控制等力控制策略来满足这些要求。尽管阻抗控制能提供抗扰动的交互能力，导纳控制能实现柔顺适应，但由于其力-运动因果关系相反，当通过同一驱动源（例如传统空中机器人使用的旋翼推力）施加时，无法同时实现这两种控制。为克服这一局限，我们提出了一种适用于多连杆空中机器人的混合阻抗-导纳控制策略。铰接式形态使得力和运动的调节功能可在关节与旋翼驱动源之间实现分离。在此框架下，导纳行为通过关节角度调节生成，以增强自适应交互；而阻抗行为则通过调节旋翼推力来实现滑动运动的控制。这种结构上的协调使机器人能够发挥两种控制范式的互补优势。因此，多连杆空中机器人实现了具有弹性和适应性的表面滑动。实验结果证明了其在未知表面上具有稳健且柔顺的滑动性能。
tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid impedance-admittance control strategy for multi-link aerial robots, enabling compliant and disturbance-resistant surface sliding by functionally separating force regulation across rotor thrust and joint angle actuation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多连杆空中机器人的混合阻抗-导纳控制策略，通过将力调节功能分离到旋翼推力和关节角度驱动上，实现了顺应且抗干扰的表面滑动。

title: Learning Smooth SE(3) Trajectories under Left-Invariant Riemannian Metrics
summary: Optimal trajectory generation for rigid-body motions on Lie groups can be formulated as a variational problem that minimizes energy functionals defined by Riemannian metrics. While closed-form solutions exist for special cases such as product metrics and rest-to-rest boundary conditions, solving the general problem with arbitrary boundary states and coupled rotational-translational metrics often requires computationally expensive numerical boundary value solvers. These limitations restrict the use of geometrically consistent trajectory generation in real-time robotic planning and control. This paper presents a learning-based framework for approximating higher-order smooth trajectories on SE(3) under general left-invariant Riemannian metrics. The method parameterizes body-twist trajectories using high-order polynomials and relies on a neural network to learn a subset of the polynomial coefficients and the trajectory duration. The remaining coefficients are analytically determined to enforce the boundary conditions. The training of the network is guided by losses derived from Euler-Lagrange optimality conditions, metric-weighted smoothness objectives, and feasibility constraints. The metric-conditioned framework enables generalization across diverse metric structures and motion conditions. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach generates smooth trajectories that closely approximate solutions from numerical optimization while achieving millisecond-level inference times. We demonstrate two practical applications of the proposed framework: real-time generation of diverse motion primitives with waypoint traversal, and refinement for quadrotor flight under dynamic conditions. These results suggest that learning-based motions with geometric structure can provide an efficient alternative to conventional optimization-based methods for trajectory generation on SE(3).
summary_zh: 李群上刚体运动的最优轨迹生成可表述为最小化由黎曼度量定义的能量泛函的变分问题。尽管对于乘积度量和静止到静止边界条件等特例存在闭式解，但求解任意边界状态与耦合旋转-平移度量的广义问题通常需要计算代价高昂的数值边界值求解器。这些局限性限制了几何一致性轨迹生成在实时机器人规划与控制中的应用。本文提出了一种基于学习的框架，用于在一般左不变黎曼度量下近似生成SE(3)上的高阶光滑轨迹。该方法采用高阶多项式参数化身体扭转轨迹，并利用神经网络学习部分多项式系数及轨迹持续时间，其余系数通过解析方式确定以满足边界条件。网络训练由基于欧拉-拉格朗日最优性条件、度量加权光滑性目标及可行性约束的损失函数引导。该度量条件化框架能够泛化至不同度量结构与运动条件。大量数值实验表明，所提方法生成的光滑轨迹与数值优化结果高度近似，同时实现毫秒级推理速度。我们展示了该框架的两项实际应用：含路径点遍历的多样化运动基元实时生成，以及动态条件下四旋翼飞行的精细化控制。这些结果表明，具有几何结构的基于学习方法可为SE(3)上轨迹生成提供传统优化方法的有效替代方案。
tldr: This paper presents a learning-based framework that uses neural networks to approximate fast, geometrically consistent higher-order smooth trajectories on SE(3) under general left-invariant Riemannian metrics, enabling millisecond-level inference for real-time robotic planning and control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于学习的框架，利用神经网络近似在一般左不变黎曼度量下的SE(3)上高阶光滑轨迹，实现毫秒级推理，用于实时机器人规划与控制。

title: PhyCheck: Fine-Grained Evidence-Grounded Dataset for Physical Law Understanding in Video-LLMs
summary: Embodied intelligence and world models require video understanding systems to go beyond recognizing objects and actions and develop an understanding of physical regularities. However, despite their strong performance on general video understanding tasks, current video-language models still struggle to reliably determine whether an observed event conforms to specific physical laws. Existing benchmarks primarily assess the physical quality of generated videos, providing limited support for systematically evaluating and improving the physical-law understanding of Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs). To address this gap, we introduce PhyCheck, a video question answering dataset organized at two complementary levels of granularity. The coarse-grained subset asks models to determine whether the phenomenon shown in a video conforms to or violates physical laws, while the fine-grained subset further examines whether models can capture physical details responsible for the violation or compliance.
