However, conditioning grasp synthesis on specific human grasp taxonomies typically requires prohibitively expensive, object-annotated datasets. To address these limitations, we propose CoToGrasp, a novel generative framework that synthesizes diverse, stable grasps strictly conditioned on specific contact topologies. To bypass the data collection bottleneck, CoToGrasp is trained entirely in an object-agnostic manner. We introduce a feature-based canonical workspace that projects local object features into a unified gripper-centric domain, effectively decoupling the semantic functional intent from the arbitrary object geometry. By learning the intrinsic contact manifold of the gripper within this workspace, our model achieves zero-shot generalization to unseen objects at inference. Extensive evaluations on the large-scale DexGraspNet dataset demonstrate that CoToGrasp achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing taxonomy-guided planners. Finally, we demonstrate the physical viability and kinematic feasibility of our synthesized contact topologies on a physical robot platform. Code is available on our project website https://cea-list.github.io/cotograspweb/ .
summary_zh: 当前灵巧抓取规划方法主要针对物理稳定性进行优化，关注的是物体能否被抓住，而非应如何抓取以支持后续功能性任务。然而，将抓取合成过程限定于特定的人为抓取分类体系，通常需要成本高昂的物体标注数据集。为解决这些局限，我们提出CoToGrasp——一种新颖的生成式框架，能够严格基于特定接触拓扑生成多样化且稳定的抓取姿态。为绕过数据采集瓶颈，CoToGrasp以完全与物体无关的方式进行训练。我们引入基于特征的标准工作空间，将局部物体特征投影到统一的夹爪中心域，从而有效解耦语义功能意图与任意物体几何结构。通过在该工作空间内学习夹爪的内在接触流形，我们的模型在推理阶段可实现对未见物体的零样本泛化。在大型DexGraspNet数据集上的广泛评估表明，CoToGrasp取得了最先进的性能，优于现有的分类引导式规划方法。最后，我们在物理机器人平台上验证了所合成接触拓扑的实际可行性与运动学可行性。相关代码已发布于项目网站：https://cea-list.github.io/cotograspweb/。
tldr: CoToGrasp is a generative framework for synthesizing dexterous grasps conditioned on specific contact topologies, trained in an object-agnostic manner via a canonical workspace to enable zero-shot generalization to unseen objects.
tldr_zh: CoToGrasp 是一个基于接触拓扑条件生成灵巧抓取框架，通过规范工作空间以物体无关方式训练，实现对未知物体的零样本泛化。

title: GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
summary: Multifingered grasping is a crucial robotic skill, but current deep-learning grasp planners often struggle to generalize to new objects because they are trained on limited, object-specific datasets. We introduce a fundamentally different approach, grounded in the observation that the gripper and the object share identical surface geometry at their mutual contact points. We propose GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation, a novel deep generative model that learns a compact latent representation of a specific gripper's contact surface distribution, enabling the efficient sampling of valid grasp configurations without relying on object-specific training data. We show that by introducing object features only at inference time, our model can effectively retrieve admissible contact areas that are compatible with the gripper's capabilities. We validate our approach through extensive experiments on established grasp protocols in both simulated and real-world scenarios, demonstrating its effectiveness with different grippers from the literature. Our method delivers state-of-the-art results on the objects from the MultiDex dataset, achieving an average success rate of 86.93%. It offers significantly faster processing when generating numerous grasps, while matching the performance of leading approaches specifically trained on this dataset. Unlike these methods, our approach does not rely on object-specific training data, highlighting the advantages of object-agnostic learning. It effectively addresses the generalization challenges faced by traditional data-driven grasp planners. Code and videos are available on our project website https://cea-list.github.io/goagweb/ .
summary_zh: 多指抓取是一项关键的机器人技能，但当前的深度学习抓取规划器往往难以泛化至新物体，原因是它们基于有限且特定物体的数据集进行训练。我们提出了一种根本不同的方法，其基础在于观察到：夹持器与物体在相互接触点处具有相同的表面几何形状。我们提出了GOAG：用于灵巧机器人操作的生成式且与物体无关的抓取规划器，这是一种新颖的深度生成模型，它学习了特定夹持器接触面分布的紧凑潜在表征，从而无需依赖特定物体的训练数据即可高效采样有效抓取构型。我们证明，仅在推理阶段引入物体特征，该模型便能有效恢复与夹持器能力兼容的可接受接触区域。我们通过在模拟和真实场景中遵循既定抓取协议进行的大量实验验证了该方法，并展示了其与文献中不同夹持器配合使用的有效性。我们的方法在MultiDex数据集的物体上取得了最先进的结果，平均成功率达到86.93%。在生成大量抓取时，该方法处理速度显著更快，同时性能与在该数据集上专门训练的前沿方法相当。与这些方法不同，我们的方法不依赖于特定物体的训练数据，凸显了与物体无关学习的优势。它有效解决了传统数据驱动抓取规划器面临的泛化挑战。代码和视频可在我们的项目网站上获取：https://cea-list.github.io/goagweb/。
tldr: A deep generative model for dexterous grasping that learns a gripper's contact surface distribution, enabling object-agnostic grasp planning and achieving state-of-the-art results without object-specific training data.
tldr_zh: 一种用于灵巧抓取的深度生成模型，通过学习夹爪接触表面的分布，实现与物体无关的抓取规划，在无需物体特定训练数据的情况下达到最优结果。

title: SafeBranch: Branch-Pair Safety Alignment for Embodied Agents
summary: Vision-language-model-based embodied agents can complete instructed tasks but often violate safety constraints in the process, a problem recently framed as interactive safety. Training such agents to act safely is difficult, since safety and task success are distinct objectives, and safety arises only at a small number of safety-critical steps within a trajectory. Standard supervision is insufficient: imitating safe trajectories teaches behavior without explaining why it is safe, and contrasting arbitrary safe and unsafe trajectories mixes the safety signal with unrelated differences. We propose SafeBranch, a framework that aligns an embodied actor on safety through branch pairs constructed from the actor's own unsafe rollouts via environment rollback. SafeBranch rolls each unsafe rollout back to the safety-critical step that caused the violation, queries the actor for a safe alternative, and pairs the original action with the alternative so that the two branches differ only at that step. The trained actor acts safely at deployment with no critic in the loop. On IS-Bench, SafetyALFRED, and out-of-distribution variants with unseen tasks and objects, it handles safety reliably without sacrificing task success, achieving roughly ten times more safe successes than the untrained baseline on the unseen-object variant.
summary_zh: 基于视觉-语言模型的具身智能体能够完成指令性任务，但在此过程中常违反安全约束，这一问题近期被定义为交互安全性。训练这类智能体安全行动具有挑战性，因为安全与任务成功属于不同目标，且安全仅出现在轨迹中少数关键步骤。标准监督方法存在不足：模仿安全轨迹仅传授行为而无法解释其安全性，简单对比任意安全与不安全轨迹则会将安全信号与无关差异混杂。我们提出SafeBranch框架，通过环境回滚机制从智能体自身的不安全轨迹构建分支对，从而在安全性上对齐具身智能体。SafeBranch将每个不安全轨迹回滚至导致违规的安全关键步骤，向智能体查询安全替代动作，并将原始动作与替代动作配对，使得两个分支仅在该步骤存在差异。经训练的智能体在部署时无需批评者模块即可安全行动。在IS-Bench、SafetyALFRED以及包含未见任务与物体的分布外变体测试中，该方法在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下可靠处理安全问题，在未见物体变体测试中安全成功次数约为未训练基线的十倍。
tldr: SafeBranch proposes a branch-pair safety alignment framework that constructs contrastive action pairs from the agent's own unsafe rollouts, enabling VLM-based embodied agents to act safely at deployment without sacrificing task success.
tldr_zh: SafeBranch 提出一种分支对安全对齐框架，通过从智能体自身的不安全轨迹中构建对比动作对，使基于VLM的具身智能体在部署时能够安全行动而不牺牲任务成功率。

title: What Matters for Latent Actions in Robot Learning
summary: Latent Action Models (LAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling robot learning to leverage large-scale unlabeled videos through latent actions that serve as compact surrogates for physical actions. Despite rapid progress, research on LAM remains highly fragmented, with existing methods evaluating different design choices in isolation under inconsistent experimental settings, making it difficult to identify the factors that truly determine downstream robotic manipulation performance. In this work, we present the first comprehensive empirical study of latent action learning for robotic manipulation. We unify representative LAM methods within a common autoencoding framework and systematically investigate 41 LAM design choices across three dimensions, including latent action modeling paradigms, learning objectives and regularization methods, and latent action integration strategies. We further examine four proxy metrics for evaluating latent action quality and assess their ability to reliably predict downstream robotic manipulation performance. Extensive experiments on three widely used benchmarks provide strong empirical evidence that fine-tuning vision-language model (VLM) backbones with latent actions provides a stronger initialization for downstream policy learning, with further validation on real-world robot manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 潜在动作模型（LAM）已成为一种极具前景的范式，使机器人学习能够通过作为物理动作紧凑替代的潜在动作，利用大规模无标注视频。尽管进展迅速，但关于LAM的研究仍高度碎片化，现有方法在不一致的实验环境下孤立地评估不同设计选择，导致难以确定真正决定下游机器人操作性能的关键因素。本工作首次对面向机器人操作的潜在动作学习进行了系统性实证研究。我们将代表性LAM方法统一纳入一个通用自编码框架，并系统性地探究了三个维度共41种LAM设计选择，包括潜在动作建模范式、学习目标与正则化方法，以及潜在动作整合策略。我们进一步考察了评估潜在动作质量的四种代理指标，并评估其可靠预测下游机器人操作性能的能力。在三个广泛使用的基准上开展的大量实验提供了强有力的实证证据：用潜在动作微调视觉语言模型（VLM）主干网络，可为下游策略学习提供更强的初始化效果，该结论在真实机器人操作任务中也得到了进一步验证。
tldr: A comprehensive empirical study identifying that fine-tuning vision-language model backbones with latent actions provides the strongest initialization for downstream robotic manipulation policy learning.
tldr_zh: 一项全面的实证研究，发现使用潜在动作微调视觉语言模型骨干网络为下游机器人操作策略学习提供了最强的初始化。

title: OrthoSkillVLA: Continual Skill Learning via Gradient-Informed Skill Subspace Adaptation
summary: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action models provide a strong foundation for robot learning, but sequentially adapting them to diverse skills can perturb the representations and velocity mappings used by previous skills, leading to catastrophic forgetting. Architecture-based approaches improve retention by isolating skills but lead to increased inference footprint. Recent subspace-constrained methods restrict parameter updates in an orthogonal subspace to minimize interference but impose a unified constraint on the entire model. We analyze the distinct roles of internal VLA components and identify two VLA-specific challenges. First, the VLM maintains broad semantic representations, making it vulnerable to capacity exhaustion, whereas the ActionHead refines semantics into localized velocity patterns that are highly sensitive to perturbations. Second, the final velocity decoder serves as a readout layer. Freezing it forms an output-stage expressivity bottleneck, while updating it risks overwriting previous velocity mappings. To this end, we propose OrthoSkillVLA, a parameter-efficient framework for continual skill learning in pretrained VLA models without demonstration replay. Given the representation heterogeneity, we impose separate subspace constraints on the VLM and ActionHead, preserving reusable semantic capacity while protecting localized velocity patterns. For the output layer, we introduce a lightweight feature-aware MoE decoder, where each skill is allocated a compact expert and a training-free router selects the expert according to feature-space affinity. Extensive simulated and real-world evaluations, together with ablations, demonstrate that OrthoSkillVLA better preserves prior skills while acquiring new ones.
summary_zh: 预训练视觉-语言-动作模型为机器人学习提供了坚实基础，但将其依次适配到不同技能会扰动先前技能的表征和速度映射，导致灾难性遗忘。基于架构的方法通过隔离技能来提升保留能力，却增加了推理开销。近期子空间约束方法在正交子空间中限制参数更新以最小化干扰，但这对整个模型施加了统一约束。我们分析了VLA内部组件的独特作用，并识别出两个VLA特定挑战：第一，VLM维持广泛的语义表征，易受容量耗尽影响，而动作头将语义精炼为局部速度模式，对扰动高度敏感；第二，最终速度解码器作为读出层，冻结它会形成输出阶段的表征瓶颈，更新则可能覆盖先前速度映射。为此，我们提出OrthoSkillVLA——一种无需演示回放、可在预训练VLA模型中实现持续技能学习的参数高效框架。针对表征异质性，我们对VLM和动作头施加独立子空间约束，在保护局部速度模式的同时保留可复用语义容量。针对输出层，我们引入轻量级特征感知的MoE解码器，为每个技能分配紧凑专家，并通过无训练路由器根据特征空间亲和度选择专家。广泛的仿真与真实世界评估及消融实验表明，OrthoSkillVLA在获取新技能的同时能更好地保留先前技能。
tldr: OrthoSkillVLA introduces a parameter-efficient continual skill learning method for pretrained VLA models, applying separate subspace constraints on the VLM and ActionHead and a lightweight feature-aware MoE decoder to prevent catastrophic forgetting without replay.
tldr_zh: OrthoSkillVLA提出了一种针对预训练VLA模型的参数高效连续技能学习方法，通过对VLM和ActionHead施加独立子空间约束并引入轻量级特征感知MoE解码器，在不重放演示的情况下防止灾难性遗忘。

title: SCAPE: Scenario-Conditioned Simulation-Augmented Policy Evaluation
summary: Reliable performance evaluation is a central bottleneck for deploying robot-learning policies in real-world conditions. Real-world testing is faithful but costly and difficult to scale, whereas simulation-based testing scales easily but is inevitably biased by the sim-to-real gap. Existing simulation-augmented methods combine limited real-world rollouts with abundant simulation proxies, but focus on performance averaged over initial conditions and deployment settings. Such population-level averages obscure scenario-specific variation and provide limited guidance about when and where a policy can be safely deployed. We propose SCAPE, a scenario-conditioned simulation-augmented policy evaluation framework that predicts scenario-conditioned real-world policy performance using limited paired sim-and-real samples and large-scale simulation rollouts. SCAPE corrects sim-to-real bias in simulation labels before training the prediction model and calibrates prediction uncertainty through conformal prediction. We validate SCAPE on autonomous driving and quadruped velocity tracking. In sim-to-sim studies, SCAPE reduces scenario-level prediction error by 4.9%/34.7% (driving) and 14.5%/27.7% (quadruped) relative to scene-conditioned neural and aggregate statistical baselines on average. We further evaluate a velocity-tracking policy deployed on a physical Unitree Go2. SCAPE also improves testing sample efficiency, produces narrower calibrated prediction intervals, generalizes better to out-of-distribution scenarios, and enables fine-grained deployment strategies.
summary_zh: 可靠的性能评估是机器人学习策略在真实世界条件下部署的核心瓶颈。真实世界测试虽然可靠但成本高昂且难以规模化，而基于仿真的测试易于扩展却不可避免地存在仿真与现实差异带来的偏差。现有仿真增强方法将有限的真实世界部署与大量仿真代理相结合，但仅关注初始条件和部署设置下的平均性能。这种群体层面的平均会掩盖特定场景的差异，且对策略何时何地可安全部署提供的指导有限。我们提出SCAPE——一种场景条件化的仿真增强策略评估框架，利用有限的配对仿真-真实样本与大规仿真部署预测场景条件化的真实世界策略性能。SCAPE在训练预测模型前校正仿真标签中的仿真-现实偏差，并通过共形预测校准预测不确定性。我们在自动驾驶与四足机器人速度跟踪任务上验证SCAPE。仿真-仿真研究中，相较于场景条件化神经网络与聚合统计基线，SCAPE将场景级预测误差平均降低4.9%/34.7%（驾驶任务）及14.5%/27.7%（四足任务）。我们进一步评估部署在实体Unitree Go2上的速度跟踪策略。SCAPE还提升了测试样本效率，生成更窄的校准预测区间，对分布外场景具有更优泛化能力，并支持细粒度部署策略。
tldr: SCAPE proposes a scenario-conditioned simulation-augmented framework that corrects sim-to-real bias and uses conformal prediction to estimate real-world policy performance per scenario, validated on autonomous driving and quadruped locomotion.
tldr_zh: SCAPE提出了一种场景条件的仿真增强策略评估框架，通过修正仿真到现实的偏差并利用保形预测来估计每个场景下的真实策略性能，在自动驾驶和四足机器人上得到验证。

title: EXIMO: VLM Guided Exploration of VLA Policies
summary: How to efficiently finetune robot policies to learn new tasks on the fly? State of the art robotic manipulation policies are based on behaviour cloning of large vision-language-action (VLA) models with billions of parameters on huge teleoperation datasets. While this simple approach has enabled significant advances for robotic manipulation, finetuning of VLA policies for learning new tasks still remains an open problem. In particular, collecting teleoperation datasets requires hundreds of hours of expensive human labour and the alternative, reinforcement learning (RL), can be notoriously sample-inefficient especially for long-horizon tasks. In addition, RL with VLAs imposes several challenges due to the model's size and architectural design. In this work, we propose EXIMO, an efficient algorithm for finetuning of VLA policies. EXIMO operates in three stages: explore, imitate, and optimize. During the explore phase, EXIMO equips the VLA with a vision language model (VLM) that acts as a planner. The VLM thinks and breaks down challenging long-horizon problems into shorter ones for the VLA. The VLM, together with the VLA, is used to collect an orchestrated dataset on new tasks. During the imitate phase, the VLA is finetuned with the orchestrated data. Finally, during the optimize stage, we use residual off-policy RL to further finetune the policy. In our experiments, we ablate all three stages of EXIMO and show that it outperforms existing approaches significantly in terms of sample-efficiency and final performance.
summary_zh: 如何高效微调机器人策略以即时学习新任务？当前最先进的机器人操作策略，依赖于对参数规模达数十亿的大型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行行为克隆，并基于海量遥操作数据集。尽管这种简单方法已推动机器人操作领域取得重大进展，但通过微调VLA策略学习新任务仍是一个未解决的难题。具体而言，收集遥操作数据集需要耗费数百小时的高昂人力成本，而替代方案——强化学习（RL）——则以样本效率低下著称，尤其在长时域任务中。此外，由于模型规模与架构设计的限制，将RL应用于VLA会带来诸多挑战。为此，我们提出EXIMO——一种高效的VLA策略微调算法。EXIMO包含三个阶段：探索、模仿与优化。在探索阶段，EXIMO为VLA配备一个作为规划器的视觉语言模型（VLM）。该VLM通过思考将复杂的长时域问题分解为VLA可处理的短时域子问题。VLM与VLA协同工作，用于收集新任务上的编排数据集。在模仿阶段，VLA通过编排数据进行微调。最后在优化阶段，我们采用残差离策略强化学习进一步优化策略。通过实验对EXIMO的三个阶段进行消融分析，结果表明：在样本效率与最终性能方面，本方法显著优于现有方案。
tldr: EXIMO introduces a three-stage algorithm (explore, imitate, optimize) that uses a VLM planner to guide exploration and collect data for efficiently fine-tuning VLA policies on new tasks, significantly improving sample efficiency and performance.
tldr_zh: EXIMO提出了一种三阶段算法（探索、模仿、优化），利用VLM规划器引导探索并为新任务收集数据，从而高效微调VLA策略，显著提升了样本效率和最终性能。

title: RoMAN-Flow: Taming Autoregressive Normalizing Flows for Offline Reinforcement Learning in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Offline reinforcement learning improves robotic policies using previously collected data without further environment interaction. Yet prevalent diffusion- and flow-matching robot policies lack tractable likelihoods, limiting their use in likelihood-based offline RL post-training. AR-NFs offer both expressive action modeling and exact likelihood evaluation, but their sequential sampling incurs substantial sampling overhead during policy optimization and deployment. We present RoMAN-Flow (Robotic Manipulation with Autoregressive Normalizing Flows), an offline reinforcement learning framework that makes AR-NF policies practical for robotic manipulation by addressing this sampling bottleneck in both stages. During policy optimization, RoMAN-Flow employs a sampling-free, advantage-weighted likelihood objective that assigns higher likelihood to high-advantage actions from the offline dataset without sampling from the autoregressive policy. For efficient deployment, it distills the optimized autoregressive policy into a one-step action generator, enabling low-latency action prediction. Experiments across multiple simulated manipulation benchmarks and real-world robotic platforms demonstrate that RoMAN-Flow achieves competitive policy performance while substantially reducing inference latency. Code is available at https://github.com/konnyaku28/RoMAN-Flow.
summary_zh: 离线强化学习利用先前收集的数据改进机器人策略，而无需进一步的环境交互。然而，当前流行的扩散模型和流匹配机器人策略缺乏可处理的似然函数，限制了其在基于似然的离线强化学习后训练中的应用。自回归归一化流（AR-NFs）既能提供具有表现力的动作建模，又能实现精确的似然评估，但其顺序采样在策略优化和部署过程中会带来显著的采样开销。我们提出RoMAN-Flow（基于自回归归一化流的机器人操控框架），这是一种通过解决上述两个阶段的采样瓶颈，使AR-NF策略实际应用于机器人操控的离线强化学习框架。在策略优化阶段，RoMAN-Flow采用无需采样的优势加权似然目标，无需从自回归策略中采样，即可为离线数据集中高优势动作分配更高似然。为实现高效部署，它将优化后的自回归策略蒸馏为单步动作生成器，从而实现低延迟的动作预测。在多个模拟操控基准测试和真实机器人平台上的实验表明，RoMAN-Flow在显著降低推理延迟的同时，实现了具有竞争力的策略性能。代码已开源：https://github.com/konnyaku28/RoMAN-Flow。
tldr: RoMAN-Flow introduces an offline RL framework that uses autoregressive normalizing flows (AR-NFs) for robotic manipulation policies, enabling exact likelihood evaluation while mitigating sampling overhead via a sampling-free advantage-weighted objective and one-step distillation for low-latency deployment.
tldr_zh: RoMAN-Flow 提出了一种离线强化学习框架，利用自回归归一化流（AR-NFs）生成机器人操作策略，支持精确似然评估，并通过免采样的优势加权目标和一步蒸馏减少采样开销，实现低延迟部署。

title: Learning Highly Dynamic Skills Transition for Quadruped Jumping Through Constrained Space
summary: Although legged animals are capable of performing explosive motions while traversing confined spaces, replicating this behavior in quadrupedal robots has been a longstanding challenge. Here, we propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning pipeline that empowers the robots to perform aggressive locomotion through constrained obstacles--a narrow gate. The imitation learning technique is used to train the low-level policy, which mimics the behaviors of real animals and forms a set of diverse skills. The high-level controller, having an awareness of the capability of low-level skills and acquiring the gate information via vision-based detection, determines the suitable maneuvers with collision-free trajectories to traverse it dynamically. Notably, we also verify that this framework can be extended to other highly dynamic tasks. This is one of the first works that perform autonomous and agile aerial gate traversal tasks on ground-walking robots, extending the lifelike agility of legged robots to match that of their biological counterparts.
summary_zh: 尽管有腿动物能够在穿越受限空间时完成爆发性动作，但在四足机器人中复现这一行为一直是一项长期挑战。本文提出了一种分层强化学习框架，使机器人能够通过受限障碍物——狭窄门洞执行激进运动。采用模仿学习技术训练底层策略，该策略模仿真实动物的行为并形成一组多样化技能。高层控制器在感知底层技能能力并借助基于视觉的门洞信息后，确定具备无碰撞轨迹的合适操作以实现动态穿越。值得注意的是，我们验证了该框架可拓展至其他高动态任务。本研究是首批实现地面行走机器人自主完成敏捷空中门洞穿越的工作之一，将四足机器人的仿生敏捷性提升至与其生物原型相匹配的水平。
tldr: A hierarchical reinforcement learning pipeline that enables quadruped robots to perform highly dynamic jumping through constrained spaces (narrow gates) by combining imitation learning for diverse low-level skills and vision-based high-level planning.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种分层强化学习框架，通过模仿学习训练多样化低层技能，并利用视觉检测的高层控制器选择无碰撞轨迹，使四足机器人能够动态穿越狭窄障碍物。

title: PVRA: A Pointwise Key-point Voting Framework for Robotic Assembly
summary: Modern computer vision has enabled partial autonomy in robotic assembly manipulation. However, performing autonomous manipulation of a progressive assembly demands a more specific set of skills, in addition to perceiving the objects. Through a comparative analysis of research in the associated domains, we deduce that object-centric perception must advance towards learning assembly dependencies to predict meaningful actionable outputs for autonomous assembly manipulation. Subsequently, we present a 3D keypoint-based modular learning framework to learn assembly dependencies to infer actionable outputs given a RGB-D input of an assembly scene. We train and evaluate our trained network on an assembly pose estimation dataset and compare it against object-centric baselines with an augmented set of metrics for progressive assemblies.
summary_zh: 现代计算机视觉已赋予机器人装配操作实现部分自主的能力。然而，对渐进式装配进行自主操作，除了感知物体之外，还需要一系列更为特定的技能。通过对比分析相关领域的研究，我们推断以物体为中心的感知必须向学习装配依赖关系迈进，以便为自主装配操作预测有意义的可操作输出。为此，我们提出一种基于三维关键点的模块化学习框架，用于学习装配依赖关系，从而根据装配场景的RGB-D输入推断可操作输出。我们在装配姿态估计数据集上训练并评估所提出的网络，并将其与以物体为中心的基线方法进行对比，同时采用一套针对渐进式装配增强的评估指标。
tldr: This paper presents a 3D keypoint-based modular learning framework that predicts actionable outputs for robotic assembly from RGB-D input, advancing object-centric perception toward learning assembly dependencies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于3D关键点的模块化学习框架，能够从RGB-D输入中预测机器人装配的可操作输出，推动面向装配依赖学习的物体中心感知发展。

title: Keeping the Franka Emika Panda alive: a ROS 2 stack with a reliable position interface
summary: This paper presents an open-source software stack that restores ROS 2 support for the Franka Emika Panda robot while resolving the long-standing unreliability of its external position control interface. We first analyze the root causes of unstable position control and show that the observed vibrations and protective stops arise from the timing of the external control loop and sampling jitter, rather than from limitations of the robot itself. Building on this analysis, we introduce an asynchronous hardware interface that decouples real-time communication from the ROS 2 control loop, a rate-matching mechanism for slower command sources, and a position-domain reference generation strategy that produces reliable, smooth position commands. Experimental validation shows that the proposed architecture reliably tracks velocity references by reducing motion artifacts introduced by the official implementation, and the stack is validated across motion planning, compliance control, position-controlled manipulation, and haptic teleoperation on two independent Panda platforms. By restoring a modern, reliable, and open ROS 2 ecosystem for the Panda, this work lowers the barrier to developing safe, responsive, and reproducible human-robot collaboration applications that integrate planning, perception, interaction, and shared autonomy. Code and videos are available on our website at https://sites.google.com/view/fer-ros2/.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种开源软件栈，在恢复Franka Emika Panda机器人对ROS 2支持的同时，解决了其外部位置控制接口长期存在的不稳定问题。我们首先分析了位置控制不稳定的根本原因，表明观察到的振动和保护性停止源自外部控制环的时序与采样抖动，而非机器人本身的局限。基于此分析，我们引入了一种异步硬件接口，将实时通信与ROS 2控制环解耦；一种适用于慢速指令源的速率匹配机制；以及一种位置域参考生成策略，可生成可靠、平滑的位置指令。实验验证表明，所提出的架构通过减少官方实现引入的运动伪影，能够可靠地跟踪速度参考值，并在两个独立的Panda平台上，该软件栈在运动规划、柔顺控制、位置控制操作及力觉遥操作等场景中均通过了验证。通过为Panda恢复一个现代、可靠且开源的ROS 2生态系统，本工作降低了开发集成规划、感知、交互与共享自主能力的**安全、响应式且可复现**的人机协作应用门槛。代码与视频已发布于我们的网站：https://sites.google.com/view/fer-ros2/。
tldr: This paper presents an open-source ROS 2 stack for the Franka Emika Panda robot that resolves long-standing unreliability in its external position control interface through an asynchronous hardware interface, rate-matching, and position-domain reference generation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个针对Franka Emika Panda机器人的开源ROS 2软件栈，通过异步硬件接口、速率匹配和位置域参考生成解决了其外部位置控制接口长期存在的不稳定性问题。

title: World-Model-Grounded LLM Planning for AUV and ASV Navigation Near Offshore Wind Farms
summary: Large language models can turn a natural-language mission into a sequence of robot actions, but they do not have a sense of physics: they cannot judge how long a command should run, or whether it will make the robot drift into an obstacle. We proposed the use of a world model to expand the capabilities of Large Language model-based planners. Our method has three components: a physics-grounded neural world model, a three-phase gradient-based trajectory optimizer, and a Model Predictive Controller (MPC)-style closed-loop replanner with a trust-region guard. The language model decides what to do, and the world model decides how long, whether that means driving eight thrusters through 6 DOF or two differential thrusters through 3 DOF. We evaluate two marine vehicle classes operating near offshore wind infrastructure: a 6-DOF Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) and a 3-DOF differential-drive Autonomous Surface Vehicle (ASV). In five benchmark missions per platform, both vehicles reach every goal with zero predicted collisions, and both transfer to GazeboSim under ocean current, waves, and thruster dynamics, remaining collision-free and cutting GazeboSim goal-distance error versus the ungrounded baseline by 70-82% (ASV) and roughly 93% (AUV), after a residual fine-tuning pass that separately reduces surrogate rollout Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) by 60% (AUV) and 69% (ASV). For the ASV we further demonstrate a Vision language model (VLM)-assisted semantic-mapping pipeline that extracts obstacles and environmental context from satellite imagery, nautical charts, and forecast Application Programming Interface (API) instead of onboard sensors, reaching 96% navigability accuracy as a drop-in replacement for hand-specified obstacle geometry.
summary_zh: 大语言模型能够将自然语言任务转化为机器人动作序列，但缺乏物理感知能力：它们无法判断指令应持续多长时间，也无法判定该指令是否会导致机器人漂移撞上障碍物。我们提出利用世界模型来扩展基于大语言模型的规划器能力。该方法包含三个组件：基于物理的神经世界模型、基于三阶段梯度的轨迹优化器，以及带有置信域防护机制的模型预测控制（MPC）闭环重规划器。语言模型决定执行何种操作，世界模型则决定操作持续时间——无论这意味着通过六自由度（6 DOF）驱动八个推进器，还是通过三自由度（3 DOF）驱动两个差动推进器。我们评估了两类在海上风电基础设施附近运行的海洋运载器：六自由度自主水下航行器（AUV）和三自由度差动驱动自主水面航行器（ASV）。在每种平台的五项基准任务中，两种运载器均实现零碰撞预测并抵达所有目标点；经残差微调后，两者可在海流、波浪和推进器动力学条件下迁移至GazeboSim仿真环境，保持零碰撞运行，并将GazeboSim目标距离误差相比无物理感知基准降低70-82%（ASV）和约93%（AUV），且该微调过程分别将替代轨迹展开的均方根误差（RMSE）降低60%（AUV）和69%（ASV）。针对ASV，我们进一步展示了视觉语言模型（VLM）辅助的语义地图构建流程——该流程通过卫星图像、海图及预报应用程序接口（API）提取障碍物与环境上下文信息，而非依赖船载传感器，在作为人工指定障碍物几何模型的即用替代方案时达到了96%的导航准确率。
tldr: This paper presents a world-model-grounded LLM planning framework for AUV and ASV navigation near offshore wind farms, combining a physics-grounded neural world model, trajectory optimization, and MPC-style replanning to achieve collision-free navigation and significant reductions in goal-distance error.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基于世界模型的大语言模型规划框架，用于近海风电场的自主水下航行器（AUV）和自主水面航行器（ASV）导航，结合了物理基础神经网络世界模型、轨迹优化和MPC式重规划，实现了无碰撞导航并大幅减少了目标距离误差。

title: Multimodal Trajectory Planning for Surface Vehicles using Turning Circle-based Control Barrier Functions
summary: This paper presents a guide path-free multimodal trajectory planning framework for autonomous surface vehicles operating in dynamic environments. The proposed method integrates model predictive control (MPC) with a turning circle-based control barrier function (TC-CBF). Unlike conventional Euclidean distance-based CBFs (ED-CBFs), which evaluate safety solely based on proximity, the TC-CBF accounts for the nonholonomic motion and finite turning capability of a surface vehicle. Its geometric formulation identifies feasible avoidance regions according to the vehicle's turning circles and generates distinct left- and right-turning avoidance modes. These modes allow the optimization solver to explore and select topologically different trajectories without relying on globally planned guide paths, as required by many conventional multimodal planning approaches. By embedding the avoidance direction directly into the safety constraint, the proposed framework alleviates the local-minimum and deadlock problems of single-mode MPC while maintaining computational efficiency. Extensive simulations involving multiple moving vessels demonstrate that the proposed method achieves higher success rates, fewer safety violations, and smaller residual violations than single-mode baselines across all tested traffic densities.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向动态环境下自主水面艇的无导引路径多模态轨迹规划框架。该方法将模型预测控制（MPC）与基于转弯圆的控制障碍函数（TC-CBF）相结合。与仅依据距离评估安全性的传统欧氏距离CBF（ED-CBF）不同，TC-CBF考虑了水面艇的非完整运动特性及有限转弯能力。其几何构造根据船舶的转弯圆确定可行避让区域，并生成明确的左转与右转避让模式。这些模式使优化求解器能够探索并选择拓扑结构不同的轨迹，无需像许多传统多模态规划方法那样依赖全局规划的导引路径。通过将避让方向直接嵌入安全约束，所提框架在保持计算效率的同时缓解了单模态MPC的局部极小值与死锁问题。涉及多艘运动船舶的广泛仿真表明：在所有测试的交通密度下，该方法相较于单模态基线方法均实现了更高的任务成功率、更少的安全违规次数以及更小的残余违规量。
tldr: A multimodal trajectory planning framework for autonomous surface vehicles that integrates MPC with turning circle-based control barrier functions to handle nonholonomic motion and enable left/right avoidance modes without global guide paths.
tldr_zh: 一种针对自主水面车辆的多模态轨迹规划框架，结合模型预测控制与基于转向圆的控制障碍函数，处理非完整运动并实现无全局引导路径的左右避让模式。

title: When Automata Meet Streams: Temporal Logic Compilation for Stream-Based Robotics Task and Motion Planning
summary: Stream-based robotics Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) integrates discrete symbolic planning with dynamically generated continuous geometric parameters, such as poses, grasps, and trajectories. However, stream-based planners typically reason only about goal reachability, whereas long-horizon tasks also demand adherence to temporal specifications, such as safety-critical ordering, invariance, and liveness constraints. No methods currently exist to enforce such temporal constraints for stream-based solvers because streams generate an expanding geometric object set via iterative stream refinement loops during planning, rendering existing temporal-logic compilation techniques incompatible. We therefore present Synchronous Action Monitoring with Token Destruction (SAM-TD), a compilation method that enforces arbitrary Linear Temporal Logic over finite traces ($\textrm{LTL}_f$) specifications in stream-based TAMP. SAM-TD translates arbitrary $\textrm{LTL}_f$ constraints into automata and embeds regressed automaton guards into action schemas, which are pre-specified before planning begins. By doing so, SAM-TD can handle objects generated by streams during planning, thus circumventing the need to enumerate a fixed object set or modify the underlying planner. During search, SAM-TD synchronously updates automaton states and uses a validity token shared across all automata to prune constraint-violating branches. We show that SAM-TD supports dynamically generated stream objects from iterative stream refinements during plan search. Experimental results provide the first ever demonstration of stream-based TAMP under $\textrm{LTL}_f$ constraints in three robotics PDDLStream environments. Furthermore, on standard discrete PDDL benchmarks, SAM-TD is competitive with state-of-the-art temporal-constraint compilation methods.
summary_zh: 基于流的机器人任务与运动规划（TAMP）将离散符号规划与动态生成的连续几何参数（如位姿、抓取和轨迹）相结合。然而，流式规划器通常仅推理目标可达性，而长时域任务还需要遵循时间规约，例如关键安全排序、不变性和活性约束。由于流在规划过程中通过迭代流精化循环生成不断扩展的几何对象集，导致现有时序逻辑编译方法无法兼容，目前尚无方法能为流式求解器施加此类时间约束。为此，我们提出带有令牌销毁的同步动作监控（SAM-TD）方法，这是一种在基于流的TAMP中对有限轨迹线性时序逻辑（$\textrm{LTL}_f$）规约施加任意约束的编译方法。SAM-TD将任意$\textrm{LTL}_f$约束转换为自动机，并将回归后的自动机守卫嵌入到规划开始前预先指定的动作模式中。通过这种方式，SAM-TD能够处理规划期间由流生成的对象，从而避免枚举固定对象集或修改底层规划器的需求。在搜索过程中，SAM-TD同步更新自动机状态，并利用所有自动机共享的有效性令牌剪除违反约束的分支。实验证明，SAM-TD能够支持规划搜索期间通过迭代流精化动态生成的流对象。在三个机器人PDDLStream环境下的实验首次展示了$\textrm{LTL}_f$约束下基于流的TAMP。此外，在标准离散PDDL基准测试中，SAM-TD与最先进的时间约束编译方法相比具有竞争力。
tldr: This paper introduces SAM-TD, a method that compiles LTL_f temporal constraints into stream-based Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) for robotics, enabling safe long-horizon manipulation with dynamically generated objects.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SAM-TD方法，将LTL_f时序约束编译到基于流的任务与运动规划中，使得机器人能够在长时程操作中满足安全性等时序要求，并处理动态生成的对象。

title: Hybrid Feedback Sampling for Sample-Efficient Model Predictive Control
summary: Thanks to its parallelizability and flexibility, sampling-based Model Predictive Control (MPC) has become widely popular for controlling real-world robotic systems. However, for high-dimensional and open-loop unstable dynamical systems, the required number of samples to improve the control sequence will grow exponentially with the horizon, leading to poor sample efficiency and numerical instability. This paper investigates the instability of shooting methods in sampling-based MPC and shows that the optimal sampling proposal distribution can be realized by sampling with an optimized feedback policy. We refer to this algorithm as Feedback Sampling MPC (FS-MPC). FS-MPC involves a hybrid sampling design which balances local and global search based on the system stability and the available computation budget. Our theoretical analysis shows that our hybrid sampling approach achieves faster convergence than standard MPPI and better optimality than standard feedback sampling. Empirically, in diverse contact-rich control tasks like humanoid loco-manipulation and dexterous manipulation, we show that FS-MPC successfully tackles dynamically unstable tasks where standard sample-based approaches struggle, and strictly outperforms feedback policies alone. Finally, we validate our method on humanoid robot locomotion and manipulation tasks in the real world.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
由于具有并行化和灵活性的优势，基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）在控制真实机器人系统中已广泛应用。然而，对于高维且开环不稳定的动态系统，为改进控制序列所需的采样数量会随预测时域呈指数增长，导致采样效率低下和数值不稳定。本文研究了基于采样MPC中打靶法的不稳定性问题，并证明通过采用优化反馈策略进行采样，可实现最优采样提议分布。我们将该算法称为反馈采样MPC（FS-MPC）。FS-MPC采用一种混合采样设计，能够根据系统稳定性和可用计算预算平衡局部搜索与全局搜索。理论分析表明，我们的混合采样方法比标准MPPI收敛更快，且比标准反馈采样具有更优的最优性。在实验层面，针对类人机器人全身操作与灵巧操作等多种高接触控制任务，我们展示了FS-MPC能够成功处理标准采样方法难以应对的动态不稳定任务，并严格优于仅使用反馈策略的方案。最后，我们在真实场景中验证了该方法在类人机器人行走与操作任务中的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes Hybrid Feedback Sampling for Model Predictive Control (FS-MPC), a sampling-based MPC method that combines local and global search to improve sample efficiency and stability for high-dimensional, open-loop unstable robotic systems, and validates it on real humanoid and dexterous manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了用于模型预测控制的混合反馈采样方法（FS-MPC），通过结合局部与全局搜索来提高高维、开环不稳定机器人系统的采样效率与稳定性，并在真实人形机器人和灵巧操作任务上进行了验证。

title: Learning the Right Abstraction: Neural Reduced Dynamics for Complex Robot Control
summary: High-fidelity embodied AI simulators provide realistic evaluation of complex robotic systems, but their computational cost limits their direct use for large-scale reinforcement learning campaigns. We advocate the use of less accurate but more expeditious simulations, which might draw on data-driven, e.g., neural dynamics, models. This contribution argues that the practical value of a neural dynamics model for complex robot control lies in learning the \emph{right abstraction}: a reduced state that preserves the control-relevant physics of the high-fidelity system while enabling high-throughput policy learning. We develop a neural reduced dynamics (NRD) framework that separates the state the model propagates from what can be supplied as an input or recovered analytically, trains policies entirely inside the frozen learned model, and validates them back in the high-fidelity simulator. Two case studies instantiate it across three control tasks: terrain-aware HMMWV trajectory tracking on rigid, bumpy and deformable Continuum Representation Model (CRM) terrain; and goal reaching for a stock tracked vehicle and its front-mounted articulated arm. Every policy transfers back to the high-fidelity simulator. A single policy trained inside the terrain-conditioned dynamics model, and given no terrain input of its own, attains lower median and mean tracking error than both single-terrain specialists on all three terrains, including zero-shot bumpy terrain. Quantitatively, the tracked vehicle reaches 100 of 100 goals and the arm 97 of 100, with zero contacts or joint-limit violations. The NRD models advance roughly four orders of magnitude faster in simulated time than the high-fidelity simulator scenes they replace, making iterative on-policy learning practical and supporting neural reduced dynamics as a bridge between accurate but expensive physics simulation and scalable robot learning.
summary_zh: 高保真具身AI模拟器能够对复杂机器人系统进行逼真评估，但其计算成本限制了其在大规模强化学习任务中的直接应用。我们提倡使用精度较低但速度更快的模拟方法，这类方法可借助数据驱动模型（如神经动力学模型）实现。本文论证了复杂机器人控制中神经动力学模型的实践价值在于学习**正确的抽象**：一种保留高保真系统控制相关物理特性、同时支持高吞吐量策略学习的降阶状态。我们开发了神经降阶动力学（NRD）框架，该框架将模型传播的状态与可作为输入或通过解析方式恢复的状态分离，完全在冻结的已学习模型内部训练策略，并在高保真模拟器中验证这些策略。两个案例研究在三个控制任务中实现了该框架：在刚体、崎岖及可变形连续介质表示模型（CRM）地形上进行地形感知型HMMWV轨迹跟踪；以及某现役履带式车辆及其前置铰接臂的目标到达任务。所有策略均成功迁移回高保真模拟器。在地形条件动力学模型内部训练且未获取任何地形输入的单一策略，在所有三种地形（包括零样本崎岖地形）上均取得了低于单地形专家策略的中值和均值跟踪误差。定量而言，履带式车辆实现100/100目标到达，机械臂实现97/100目标到达，且未发生任何接触或关节限位违规。NRD模型在模拟时间上比其所替代的高保真模拟器场景快约四个数量级，这使得迭代在策略学习变得可行，并支持神经降阶动力学作为精确但昂贵的物理模拟与可扩展机器人学习之间的桥梁。
tldr: Proposes Neural Reduced Dynamics (NRD) to learn a reduced state that preserves control-relevant physics, enabling fast policy training inside a frozen learned model that transfers back to high-fidelity simulators.
tldr_zh: 提出神经约化动力学（NRD）方法，学习保留控制相关物理的约化状态，从而在冻结的学习模型内快速训练策略，并成功迁移回高保真模拟器。

title: The Missing Touch: Spatially Distributed Tactile Feedback Brings Teleoperation Closer to Human Dexterity
summary: A fundamental challenge in robotic teleoperation is enabling an operator to control a remote robot as effortlessly and intuitively as their own hands. Despite the growing use of teleoperation to collect demonstration data for training autonomous robot policies, teleoperated robot performance still falls significantly short of human dexterity, even for basic tasks. Here, we present evidence that a key factor contributing to this performance gap is the absence of spatially distributed tactile feedback. Using a two-degree-of-freedom (DoF) bilateral force-feedback telemanipulator paired with a 32-DoF tactile fingertip display, we show that operator performance improves significantly when localized deformations on the remote manipulator are faithfully reproduced on the operator's fingertip. In a series of teleoperation tasks, reproducing distributed contact information not only accelerated task performance but also brought teleoperated movements closer to natural human behavior by minimizing corrective actions and task completion steps, thereby reducing the deviation between teleoperated and natural trajectories by 29$\unicode{x2013}$79%. Furthermore, we found that increasing the resolution of the tactile feedback$\unicode{x2014}$by refining how finely the measured displacements were quantized for reproduction$\unicode{x2014}$compressed the state-space distribution of teleoperated motions, which has been associated with improved training outcomes for autonomous robot policies. Together, these results suggest that spatially distributed tactile feedback is essential for closing the gap between human and teleoperated dexterity and training the next generation of autonomous robots.
summary_zh: 机器人远程操作中的一个基本挑战是让操作者能够像控制自己的双手一样轻松直观地控制远程机器人。尽管远程操作越来越多地被用于收集演示数据以训练自主机器人策略，但远程操作机器人的性能即使在基本任务中也远未达到人类灵巧度的水平。本文提供的证据表明，造成这一性能差异的关键因素在于缺乏空间分布式的触觉反馈。通过使用结合了32自由度触觉指尖显示器的二自由度双边力反馈远程操作器，我们证明：当远程操作器上的局部形变被忠实地再现于操作者指尖时，操作者的性能会显著提升。在一系列远程操作任务中，再现分布式接触信息不仅加快了任务执行速度，还通过最小化修正动作和任务完成步骤，使远程操作动作更接近自然的人类行为，从而将远程操作轨迹与自然轨迹之间的偏差降低了29%–79%。此外，我们发现提高触觉反馈的分辨率——通过细化测量位移的量化精度以进行再现——压缩了远程操作运动的状态空间分布，而这与改善自主机器人策略的训练效果相关联。这些结果共同表明，空间分布式的触觉反馈对于缩小人类与远程操作灵巧度之间的差距，以及训练下一代自主机器人至关重要。
tldr: This paper demonstrates that spatially distributed tactile feedback significantly improves teleoperation performance, enabling faster task completion and more human-like movements, and suggests this feedback is critical for training autonomous robot policies.
tldr_zh: 本文表明，空间分布触觉反馈显著提升了遥操作性能，使任务完成更快、动作更接近人类，并指出这种反馈对训练自主机器人策略至关重要。

title: DreamHand: Repurposing Video Diffusion Models for Occlusion-Robust Egocentric 3D Hand Motion Recovery
summary: Egocentric video offers scalable manipulation data for embodied AI, yet recovering metric 3D hand trajectories remains challenging due to severe object occlusion and frequent out-of-sight gaps. Existing single-frame and windowed temporal regressors fail when hand shortly leaves the frame, while recent video diffusion models (VDMs) rely on heavy, stochastic multi-step sampling as pixel-space renderers. We instead repurpose VDM into a deterministic geometry encoder. A single forward pass over the clean latent exposes scene content beyond current observations, including occluded and out-of-sight hands. We introduce DreamHand, an offline clip-level framework that extracts features via a Deterministic Clean-Latent Encoder and decodes them with a Bidirectional Spatiotemporal Decoder. DreamHand recovers continuous bimanual trajectories with metric placement and no external detector, while a Ray-Based Camera Solver supports a second configuration that needs no test-time camera intrinsics. Across five egocentric benchmarks, DreamHand sets a new state of the art, cutting MPJPE-p by 30% on occlusion-heavy ARCTIC and 40% on HOT3D. These gains reach 46%-61% once out-of-sight hands are included in the evaluation, offering a scalable path from everyday human video to robot manipulation data.
summary_zh: 自我中心视频为具身智能提供了可扩展的操作数据，但由于严重的物体遮挡和频繁的视线外空白，恢复度量三维手部轨迹仍面临挑战。当手部短暂离开画面时，现有单帧和窗口化时序回归器会失效，而最新视频扩散模型（VDM）依赖高开销的随机多步采样作为像素空间渲染器。我们转而将VDM重构为确定性几何编码器：在干净隐空间上的单次前向传播即可暴露超出当前观测的场景内容，包括遮挡和视线外的手部。我们提出DreamHand——一个离线片段级框架，通过确定性干净隐空间编码器提取特征，并利用双向时空解码器进行解码。DreamHand能够恢复连续的双手轨迹，具有度量空间定位且无需外部检测器；其基于射线的相机求解器还支持第二种配置，无需测试时的相机内参。在五个自我中心基准测试中，DreamHand刷新了最优结果，在重度遮挡的ARCTIC上MPJPE-p降低30%，在HOT3D上降低40%。当视线外手部被纳入评估时，性能提升幅度达46%-61%，为从日常人类视频到机器人操作数据提供了可扩展的路径。
tldr: DreamHand repurposes video diffusion models into a deterministic geometry encoder for offline egocentric 3D hand motion recovery, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy with robustness to occlusion and out-of-sight scenarios, thereby enabling scalable extraction of manipulation data from everyday video.
tldr_zh: DreamHand 将视频扩散模型重新用作确定性几何编码器，用于离线第一人称视角3D手部运动恢复，在遮挡和视线外场景中达到了最先进精度，为从日常视频中提取可扩展的操作数据提供了途径。

title: Multi-Agent Orchestration with the Common-Sense Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicles require robust perception and decision-making capabilities to operate in diverse and unseen scenarios. While reinforcement learning and rule-based methods can provide effective control and safety mechanisms, their performance may degrade in situations requiring contextual reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding multimodal information and generating contextual reasoning, however, their use for direct vehicle control can introduce latency and hallucination risks. To address these limitations, a hybrid framework is proposed. This system uses an orchestrator to coordinate PPO-trained reinforcement learning and PID control, with LLM common-sense reasoning applied throughout the framework. LLM reasoning is further employed iteratively to refine the RL reward function for dynamic driving environments. The proposed framework is evaluated in highly randomized CARLA scenarios under diverse environmental and traffic conditions. The results demonstrate the potential of integrating LLM-based reasoning with conventional autonomous driving methods while retaining structured control and safety mechanism.
summary_zh: 自主驾驶车辆需要在多样且未见过的场景中具备稳健的感知与决策能力。尽管强化学习与基于规则的方法能够提供有效的控制与安全机制，但在需要情境推理的场景中，其性能可能下降。大语言模型（LLMs）在理解多模态信息及生成情境推理方面展现出强大能力，然而将其直接用于车辆控制会引入延迟与幻觉风险。为克服这些局限，本文提出一种混合框架。该系统通过协调器整合经PPO训练的强化学习与PID控制，并在整个框架中应用LLM常识推理。此外，LLM推理被迭代用于优化动态驾驶环境中的强化学习奖励函数。该框架在高度随机化的CARLA场景中，于多样环境与交通条件下进行了评估。结果表明，将基于LLM的推理与传统自主驾驶方法相融合，同时保留结构化控制与安全机制具有可行性。
tldr: Proposes a hybrid autonomous driving framework that uses an LLM orchestrator to coordinate PPO and PID controllers, with iterative LLM refinement of the reward function, evaluated in CARLA.
tldr_zh: 提出一种混合自动驾驶框架，使用大语言模型（LLM）作为协调器来管理PPO和PID控制器，并通过LLM迭代优化奖励函数，在CARLA环境中进行了评估。

title: CAViAR: A Causal Video Dataset for Fine-Grained Accident Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios
summary: While modern autonomous driving systems excel at perception tasks such as object detection and trajectory prediction, they lack the high-level causal reasoning required to interpret traffic accidents. In particular, determining responsibility, such as identifying who is at fault and which traffic rule was violated, remains largely unexplored in current benchmarks. To this end, we introduce CAViAR (Causal Accident Video and Incident Analysis Repository), a human-annotated dashcam benchmark comprising 2,249 real-world accident videos collected from CarCrashDataset (CCD) and Nexar. Each video is annotated with structured labels spanning environmental conditions, accident type, causal explanation, apparent At-Fault Agent, affected agent, and apparent rule-violation category. We benchmark state-of-the-art vision-language models (VLMs), including Cosmos-Reason2, Qwen3-VL, and InternVL3. Once class imbalance is accounted for with majority/random baselines and balanced metrics, perceptual competence is uneven--lighting is nearly solved, whereas weather and road-condition accuracy fall at or below the majority-class baseline---and all models degrade sharply on accident type and responsibility reasoning. Overall, CAViAR exposes a practical Perception--Reasoning Gap: current VLMs may recognize salient context, but do not reliably map visible agent actions to annotated rule-relevant responsibility categories in safety-critical driving scenarios. Code, annotation schema, prompts, and evaluation scripts are available at: https://github.com/nec-labs-ma/CAViAR
summary_zh:
**摘要**  
尽管现代自动驾驶系统在目标检测和轨迹预测等感知任务中表现出色，但它们缺乏解读交通事故所需的高级因果推理能力。特别是，确定责任归属——例如识别谁负有主要责任以及违反了哪条交通规则——在当前基准测试中仍基本未被探索。为此，我们推出了CAViAR（因果事故视频与事件分析库），这是一个人工标注的行车记录仪基准数据集，包含从CarCrashDataset（CCD）和Nexar收集的2,249个真实世界事故视频。每个视频均标注了结构化标签，涵盖环境条件、事故类型、因果解释、明显责任主体、受影响主体以及明显违规类别。我们评估了最先进的视觉-语言模型（VLMs），包括Cosmos-Reason2、Qwen3-VL和InternVL3。在通过多数类/随机基线和平衡指标处理类别不平衡后，感知能力表现不均衡——光照条件几乎被解决，而天气和道路条件准确率低于或等于多数类基线——所有模型在事故类型和责任推理上的表现急剧下降。总体而言，CAViAR揭示了一个实际的感知-推理鸿沟：当前VLMs可能能识别显著上下文，但在安全关键驾驶场景中，无法可靠地将可见的主体行为映射到标注的规则相关责任类别。代码、标注模式、提示词和评估脚本可在以下地址获取：https://github.com/nec-labs-ma/CAViAR
tldr: CAViAR introduces a human-annotated dashcam video benchmark (2,249 real-world accidents) for fine-grained causal accident reasoning, exposing a perception-reasoning gap in current VLMs that fail to reliably map visible actions to responsibility categories in safety-critical driving scenarios.
tldr_zh: CAViAR 提出了一个包含2249个真实世界事故视频的人工标注行车记录仪基准，用于细粒度的事故因果推理，揭示了当前VLM在安全关键驾驶场景中无法可靠地将可见行为映射到责任类别的感知-推理差距。

title: G-MARK: Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Cooperative Driving via Knowledge Graphs
summary: Autonomous driving systems must operate under partial observability, where safety-critical objects may be occluded or visible only to neighboring connected vehicles. Vehicle-to-vehicle cooperation can reduce this uncertainty, but existing cooperative driving methods often compress multi-agent evidence into latent features or hidden multimodal states. As a result, they obscure which agent observed each object, whether the object is visible to the ego vehicle, and how conflicting evidence affects downstream decisions. We propose G-MARK, a grounded multi-agent reasoning framework that converts cooperative object-centric observations into explicit provenance-aware knowledge graphs (KGs). The resulting KGs preserve object hypotheses together with their source attribution, ego-versus-partner visibility, uncertainty, conflicts, spatial relations, and planning-relevant context. G-MARK then derives a shared feature representation from these KGs, enabling lightweight task heads to support object reasoning, motion prediction, control selection, and trajectory forecasting. Compared with the state-of-the-art baseline, GMARK improves occlusion reasoning accuracy by 42.2%, reduces control-selection error by 13.1%, and achieves comparable trajectory-planning accuracy with a 25.6x smaller structured communication payload. Our code is available at https://github.com/bhavyagupta98/g-mark.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶系统必须在部分可观测条件下运行，此时安全关键物体可能被遮挡，或仅能被邻近的网联车辆观测到。车-车协同可以降低这种不确定性，但现有的协同驾驶方法通常将多智能体证据压缩为潜在特征或隐式多模态状态，从而模糊了每个智能体观测到哪些物体、物体对自车是否可见，以及相互矛盾的证据如何影响下游决策。我们提出G-MARK，一种基于显式溯源的多智能体推理框架，可将以物体为中心的协同观测转换为显式溯源知识图谱。生成的知识图谱保留了物体假设及其来源归属、自车与合作伙伴的可见性、不确定性、冲突、空间关系以及与规划相关的上下文信息。随后G-MARK从这些知识图谱中提取共享特征表示，使轻量级任务头能够支持物体推理、运动预测、控制选择与轨迹预测。与现有最优基线相比，G-MARK在遮挡推理准确率上提升42.2%，控制选择误差降低13.1%，并在结构化通信负载缩小25.6倍的情况下达到可比的轨迹规划精度。我们的代码开源在 https://github.com/bhavyagupta98/g-mark。
tldr: G-MARK converts multi-agent cooperative observations into provenance-aware knowledge graphs to improve occlusion reasoning and control accuracy in autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: G-MARK 将多智能体协作观测转化为带有来源追踪的知识图谱，以提升自动驾驶中的遮挡推理和控制准确性。

title: Towards Surgical World-Action Modeling: A Preliminary Joint Visual-Trajectory Forecasting for Surgical Motion Planning
summary: Reliable surgical planning requires models to anticipate not only how instruments will move, but also how the operative visual state will evolve together with such motion. Existing approaches typically treat future scene generation and instrument trajectory prediction as two separate tasks. Scene-only models cannot directly evaluate the accuracy of future instrument motion at the trajectory level, while trajectory-only models fail to capture the visual consequences of instrument movement, leaving the consistency between predicted trajectories and future scene evolution unaddressed. Jointly forecasting both provides a more complete account of surgical action-scene dynamics by enabling explicit trajectory-level evaluation while simultaneously modeling the corresponding visual evolution. To bridge this gap, we present a preliminary joint visual-trajectory world-action model that simultaneously forecasts future visual states and instrument trajectories from historical surgical observations. Specifically, we encode historical video frames and tool trajectories into latent representations, which are processed by a temporal-spatial encoder and subsequently decoded through separate visual-state and trajectory prediction heads. Based on this preliminary architecture, a chunked autoregressive rollout is repeatedly applied to predict fifteen future steps. The chunked strategy consistently outperforms direct one-shot prediction across all evaluated horizons, improving first-segment PSNR from 18.86 to 23.11 dB and reducing ADE from 45.77 to 22.22 pixels. These results demonstrate the initial feasibility of joint visual-motion forecasting. However, we observe progressive visual degradation and accumulated trajectory errors over longer prediction horizons, which remain important challenges for future surgical world-action modeling.
summary_zh: 可靠的手术规划要求模型不仅能预测器械的运动方式，还需预判手术视觉状态随该运动的演变过程。现有方法通常将未来场景生成与器械轨迹预测视为两个独立任务：仅处理场景的模型无法在轨迹层面直接评估未来器械运动的准确性，而仅处理轨迹的模型则无法捕捉器械运动产生的视觉结果，导致预测轨迹与未来场景演变之间的一致性未被妥善解决。联合预测两者可通过在建模对应视觉演变的同时实现显式的轨迹层级评估，更完整地描述手术行为-场景动态。为弥合这一差距，我们提出一种初步的视觉-轨迹联合世界-行为模型，该模型能基于历史手术观测同步预测未来视觉状态与器械轨迹。具体而言，我们将历史视频帧与工具轨迹编码为潜在表征，经时空编码器处理后，通过独立的视觉状态预测头与轨迹预测头进行解码。基于该初步架构，我们重复应用分块自回归推演以预测未来十五步。在所有评估时域内，分块策略始终优于直接一次性预测，将首段PSNR从18.86 dB提升至23.11 dB，并将ADE从45.77像素降至22.22像素。这些结果表明视觉-运动联合预测的初步可行性。然而，我们观察到随着预测时域延长，视觉退化逐步加剧且轨迹误差持续累积，这仍是未来手术世界-行为建模面临的重要挑战。
tldr: This paper proposes a joint visual-trajectory world-action model for surgical motion planning that simultaneously forecasts future visual states and instrument trajectories from historical observations, demonstrating initial feasibility with a chunked autoregressive rollout strategy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于手术运动规划的联合视觉-轨迹世界动作模型，该模型同时从历史观测中预测未来的视觉状态和器械轨迹，并通过分块自回归滚动策略验证了初步可行性。

title: LF-GICP: Parameter-Free Degeneracy-Aware LiDAR Odometry via a Voxel-Normal Localizability Field
summary: Scan-to-map LiDAR odometry drifts unboundedly along the unobservable axes of geometrically degenerate environments like tunnels and corridors, and existing degeneracy handling requires environment-specific parameter tuning. This paper presents a parameter-free approach. We show that in voxelized GICP the Gauss--Newton (GN) Hessian masks translational degeneracy, because covariance regularization keeps the translation block artificially well-conditioned. We bypass this with a regularization-free voxel-normal localizability field and two of its statistics: a normalized fraction $f_0$ detecting directional anisotropy, and an absolute per-voxel mass $λ_0$ distinguishing information absence (tunnels) from dilution (dense open scenes). A temporal-median gate combines both to trigger Fisher-information correspondence weighting. Calibrated once by fixed rules on two short sequences and then frozen, LF-GICP achieves the lowest KITTI relative translation error ($0.865\%$) under an identical evaluation protocol against re-run baselines, outperforms them on GEODE tunnels and MulRan, leads the HeLiPR mean, and generalizes across four sensor types without re-tuning. We further demonstrate empirically that straight, uniform tunnels remain unobservable along their axis for LiDAR-only registration.
summary_zh: 摘要：扫描至地图的激光雷达里程计在几何退化环境（如隧道和走廊）中会沿不可观测轴产生无界漂移，现有退化处理方法需要针对特定环境调整参数。本文提出一种无需参数的方法。我们证明，在体素化广义迭代最近点（GICP）中，高斯-牛顿（GN）海森矩阵会掩盖平移退化，因为协方差正则化使平移块人为保持良态。为此，我们采用无正则化的体素法向可定位性场及其两种统计量：用于检测方向各向异性的归一化分数$f_0$，以及区分信息缺失（隧道）与信息稀释（密集开阔场景）的每体素绝对质量$λ_0$。时间中值门控将两者结合以触发费舍尔信息对应加权。通过固定规则在两个短序列上标定一次并冻结后，LF-GICP在相同评估协议下与重运行基线对比，取得了KITTI最低相对平移误差（0.865%），在GEODE隧道和MulRan数据集上表现更优，在HeLiPR平均指标中领先，且无需重新调整即可泛化至四种传感器类型。我们进一步通过实验证明，对于仅依赖激光雷达的配准，笔直均匀的隧道沿其轴线仍保持不可观测性。
tldr: A parameter-free LiDAR odometry method that uses a voxel-normal localizability field to handle degeneracy in geometrically sparse environments like tunnels, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on KITTI.
tldr_zh: 一种无参数的激光雷达里程计方法，利用体素-法线可定位场处理隧道等几何稀疏环境中的退化问题，在KITTI上达到最优精度。

title: Beyond Multimodal Alignment: Certifying Physical Language through Response Substitution and Ordered Execution
summary: World models increasingly treat compact multimodal representations as interfaces between perception and physical interaction, yet existing probes do not establish whether different sensors carry the same executable meaning or whether that meaning survives a new action composition. We introduce an operational capability hierarchy and the Disjoint-Bridge Operator-Substitution Certificate (DBOSC), which asks whether independently trained modality compilers enter a frozen response chart interchangeably on evidence outside their training panels. On Cluster Haptic, audio and acceleration representations of the same unseen surface are 4.5x closer in response space than wrong-surface pairings, with the gap holding for all 19 held-out surfaces; unsealing withheld responses confirms that every branch predicts the physics better than the population chart. We then test ordered execution in a controlled elastoplastic system with complementary modality blind spots. At the pre-registered budget, the prerequisite refuses the stack because the frozen executor cannot advance even an exact chart coordinate through a held-out program. At a converged budget, the same rank-three chart executes those programs (oracle NMSE 0.18), fusion improves on both modalities, and 14 of 16 registered checks pass; the two failures arise because a diagonal restriction of the fused information matrix performs as well as the full one. Clearing the gate is a property of the executor, not the chart: an executor emitting whole programs instead of shared per-step dynamics is 38x worse than an entity-blind predictor on the same chart. A matching non-identifiability result explains why compression and fusion alone cannot determine an unseen composition law. These results separate attribute access, response substitution, fusion closure, and ordered execution into distinct, separately testable achievements.
summary_zh: 世界模型日益将紧凑的多模态表征视为感知与物理交互之间的接口，但现有探测手段尚未确定不同传感器是否承载相同的可执行语义，亦或该语义能否在新的动作组合中得以保留。我们引入了一个操作能力层级结构及分离-桥接算子-替换证书（DBOSC），该证书旨在验证独立训练的多模态编译器是否能在其训练集之外的证据上互换地进入冻结响应图谱。在集群触觉实验中，相同未见过表面的音频与加速度表征在响应空间中的距离，比错误表面配对近4.5倍，且该差距在所有19个保留表面上均成立；解锁被保留的响应后证实，每一分支对物理特性的预测均优于总体图谱。随后，我们在一个具有互补模态盲区的受控弹塑性系统中测试有序执行。在预注册的预算条件下，前提条件拒绝了堆叠操作，因为冻结执行器无法将精确的图谱坐标推进到被保留的程序中。在收敛预算条件下，同一秩三图谱能够执行这些程序（oracle NMSE为0.18），融合效果优于两种单一模态，且16项注册检查中有14项通过；两项失败的原因在于融合信息矩阵的对角线约束与完整矩阵性能相当。通过门控是执行器的属性，而非图谱的属性：一个发射完整程序而非共享逐步骤动力学的执行器，在同一图谱上比无视实体的预测器差38倍。一个匹配的不可辨识性结果解释了为何仅靠压缩与融合无法确定未见过的组合规律。这些结果将属性访问、响应替换、融合封闭性与有序执行区分为各自独立、可分别验证的能力标志。
tldr: This paper proposes a formal certificate (DBOSC) to test whether multimodal representations in world models maintain consistent physical meaning across modalities and survive ordered execution, using haptic/audio data to show that response substitution works but ordered execution fails without sufficient budget.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种形式化证书（DBOSC），用于检验世界模型中的多模态表示是否在不同模态间保持一致的物理意义并能承受有序执行，通过触觉/音频数据表明响应替换有效，但有序执行在预算不足时失败。

title: Towards general embodied intelligence: integrating large language models, knowledge bases, and reasoning capabilities to build the next generation of AI agents
summary: The convergence of large language models (LLMs), structured knowledge bases (KBs), and reasoning ability (RA) presents a promising trajectory toward general embodied intelligence (GEI). This paper reviews the evolution of LLM-centered intelligent systems, emphasising their integration with knowledge representation, logical reasoning, and physical embodiment. We analyse LLM architectures, pre-training methods, and inference mechanisms, along with their interaction with external knowledge sources and structured reasoning frameworks. Furthermore, we examine embodied intelligence (EI) paradigms wherein agents learn and act in physical environments. To synthesise these dimensions, we present a conceptual framework that illustrates the synergy among LLMs, KBs, RA, and embodiment, serving as a guiding model for perception, reasoning, and action rather than an implemented engineering architecture. To advance toward GEI, we identify five key challenges: efficient LLM deployment, closed-loop knowledge integration, hybrid symbolic-neural reasoning, perception-action grounding, and continual learning. This survey provides a comprehensive roadmap for developing adaptive, multimodal agents capable of operating in complex, dynamic settings.
tldr: This survey reviews the integration of LLMs, knowledge bases, and reasoning for embodied intelligence, proposing a conceptual framework and identifying key challenges toward general embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了大语言模型、知识库与推理能力的融合以实现具身智能，提出了概念框架并指出了实现通用具身智能的关键挑战。

title: Learning Hierarchical Skill Policies with Offline Quality-Diversity Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent studies investigate how to leverage pre-collected datasets to improve the policy performance and sample efficiency of RL. One promising approach to achieve this goal is to employ a two-stage strategy: In the first stage, diverse skills are extracted as a low-level policy from a given dataset, and a high-level policy is trained to solve a specific task in the second stage. Typically, extraction of the low-level policy is performed based on unsupervised learning such as trajectory VAE. However, a limitation of this approach is that the quality of the low-level policy highly depends on the quality of the dataset. To address this issue, we introduce QDOS (Quality-Diversity Offline Skill learning), a unified pipeline for robust offline-to-online learning. Our approach incorporates an Advantage-Weighted Quality-Diversity pretraining objective, which weights the skill extraction and diversity objectives by the estimated advantage of each trajectory segment. This approach allows the model to extract diverse and high-value skills. By providing robust and task-relevant skill representations, QDOS significantly improves the quality of the embedded skill space used by the low-level policy. We further integrate this with a dual dataset reuse strategy, where offline data is used both for skill pretraining and for populating the online replay buffer via pseudo-labeling. Experiments demonstrate that QDOS significantly outperforms strong baselines in structured manipulation tasks and unstructured locomotion tasks, confirming its ability to accelerate exploration and improve final returns in challenging sparse-reward domains.
tldr: Proposes QDOS, a unified offline-to-online skill learning framework that uses advantage-weighted quality-diversity pretraining to extract diverse, high-reward skills from offline datasets, improving task success in manipulation and locomotion.
tldr_zh: 提出QDOS，一种统一的离线到在线技能学习框架，通过基于优势加权的质量-多样性预训练从离线数据中提取多样且高回报的技能，以提升操作与运动任务的表现。

title: CVSD-Reg: Cross-Modal Visual Semantic Prior Distillation for Robust LiDAR Registration
summary: Learning-based global point cloud registration has achieved remarkable progress, yet its reliance on geometric representations makes existing methods sensitive to variations in point density, scan pattern, viewpoint, and sensor characteristics. We propose CVSD-Reg, a robust global LiDAR registration framework that distills visual semantic priors from a vision foundation model into LiDAR representations. In Stage 1, a Point Transformer V3 student learns from a frozen DINOv2 teacher through contrastive distillation and spherical-manifold alignment, which preserves the hyperspherical geometry of the teacher embedding space. Self-supervised InfoNCE consistency and soft $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ invariance further encourage viewpoint-robust descriptors. In Stage 2, the distilled representation is adapted to registration through correspondence learning, density-aware point-dropout augmentation, and end-to-end pose optimization. With a single checkpoint, CVSD-Reg generalizes to both single-sensor and zero-shot cross-sensor scenarios without sensor-specific adaptation and remains entirely camera-free at inference. On KITTI, nuScenes, and HeLiPR, CVSD-Reg achieves strict success rate (SR@0.5\,m/$1^\circ$) of 97.7$\%$, 99.0$\%$, and 99.3$\%$, respectively, including 97.3$\%$ on sparse 16-beam Velodyne scans. It outperforms state-of-the-art geometric registration methods by up to 44.0 percentage points without requiring camera inputs or post-hoc ICP refinement.
tldr: Proposes a LiDAR registration method that distills visual semantic priors from a frozen vision foundation model (DINOv2) into a point cloud transformer, achieving robust cross-sensor generalization without camera inputs at inference.
tldr_zh: 提出一种激光雷达配准方法，通过从冻结的视觉基础模型（DINOv2）中蒸馏视觉语义先验到点云Transformer中，无需相机输入即可实现跨传感器的鲁棒泛化。

title: Wave-Based Bilateral Teleoperation between Nonlinear Manipulators with Direct Contact Force Feedback
summary: We study bilateral teleoperation between nonlinear, multi-DOF robotic manipulators in the presence of constant communication delays. Unlike classical wave-transformation architectures that transmit a coordinating force, we consider the case where the environmental force is reflected to the master side to enhance teleoperation transparency. Since direct contact force feedback might destabilize the closed-loop system, we first develop a passivity-shortage characterization for the Euler--Lagrange remote system using a linear matrix inequality (LMI) approach. An upper strictly passive communication law is then employed to compensate for the computed passivity shortage so that the closed-loop stability under delays as well as position and force synchronization are preserved under appropriate conditions. Simulations with nonlinear 2-DOF robotic manipulators in different settings illustrate our approach.
tldr: This paper proposes a passivity-shortage-based control framework for bilateral teleoperation of nonlinear manipulators under constant delays, enabling stable direct contact force feedback without wave transformations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于无源性短缺的非线性机械臂双边遥操作控制框架，在恒定时延下实现稳定的直接接触力反馈，无需波变换。

title: ADAPT: Physics-Aware Diffusion-based World Models for Adaptive Predictive Transferable HVAC Control
summary: Buildings account for roughly one-third of global energy consumption and CO$_2$ emissions. Optimizing indoor climate systems plays a critical role for urban climate mitigation aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals 11 and 13. However, indoor delayed thermodynamic responses and partial observability severely hinder existing methods, which are primarily limited by implicit thermal inertia, occupancy dynamic prediction, and cumulative prediction errors, especially for out-of-distribution environments. In practice, these challenges are further exacerbated by the high cost and privacy burden of dense indoor sensing, forcing operators to collect only limited data in a single operating regime while expecting controllers to generalize reliably across unseen seasons and climate regions. To address this problem, we propose ADAPT, a physics-aware conditional diffusion indoor environmental world model for HVAC control. The model predicts a short-horizon held-action thermal baseline to capture the latent thermal inertia of the buildings. The diffusion backbone utilizes the robustness of generative models, while a learnable multi-zone heat-balance regularizer constrains generated trajectories to satisfy transferable building thermodynamics without requiring known building geometry or manually calibrated thermal parameters. A credit assignment is then design for the downstream reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on SemibuildingSim and Sinergym demonstrate that ADAPT reduces HVAC energy consumption by 7.3\% and occupant discomfort by 30.2\% compared with state-of-the-art baselines under IID control. Under OOD control scenarios spanning unseen seasons and climate regions, ADAPT maintains robust performance with only marginal degradation relative to its IID performance, substantially outperforming existing methods in transfer robustness.
tldr: ADAPT proposes a physics-aware conditional diffusion world model for HVAC control, using a heat-balance regularizer to enforce thermodynamic consistency and a credit assignment module for reinforcement learning, achieving reduced energy consumption and discomfort in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution scenarios.
tldr_zh: ADAPT 提出了一种基于物理感知的条件扩散世界模型，用于暖通空调控制，通过热平衡正则化器确保热力学一致性，并设计信用分配模块用于强化学习，在分布内和分布外场景中均降低了能耗和不适度。

title: DART-S: Reachability-Audited Active-Suspension Preconditioning for Off-Road Vehicle Jumps
summary: Airborne torque reaction cannot recover takeoff errors beyond the wheel angular-momentum budget. DART-S applies ramp-face suspension preconditioning to change pitch, pitch rate, and wheel spin before liftoff, thereby shifting the queried state and altering the remaining authority budget. To predict how each suspension action reshapes this state-budget pair, DART-S employs a local calibration map. A support-aware selector combines the predicted shift with local outcome evidence and an interval-reachability screen; an exact-pair audit reports residual authority. Across 600 new runs in 72 independent BeamNG sessions, every positive, negative, and boundary query follows its prespecified branch. At the confirmed 40°/13 m/s boundary, DART-S attains 24/24 post-touchdown attitude-criterion successes versus 0/24 for DART (session-level Holm-adjusted p=0.0234). At 11.5 m/s, a 0.35 s timing action attains 23/24 versus 0/24 for the static preset (p=0.0156). The 200 rad/s command guard keeps drivetrain hard-limit exceedance at zero across all 600 runs. The source code will be available at https://github.com/MeridianCAS/DART-S
tldr: DART-S uses active suspension preconditioning before off-road vehicle jumps to alter pitch, pitch rate, and wheel spin, improving post-touchdown attitude control compared to prior DART methods, validated in high-fidelity simulation.
tldr_zh: DART-S 在越野车辆跳跃前通过主动悬架预调节来改变俯仰角、俯仰角速度和车轮自旋，相比先前的 DART 方法显著改善了触地后的姿态控制，并在高保真仿真中得到验证。

title: Calming Robot Pitches? Exploring the Influence of Robot Voice Pitch on Children's Stress Levels
summary: This study examined whether variations in robot speech pitch influence children's stress levels during a robot-guided game. Although lower-pitched voices have been shown to facilitate stress regulation in human communication, it remains unclear whether this effect generalizes to synthetic voices in child-robot interactions. Twenty-seven Dutch children aged 8-12 years were randomly assigned to interact with a Zenbo Junior II robot using either a lower-pitched or a higher-pitched voice. The interaction consisted of an introduction followed by a timed LEGO-building game. Stress levels, measured with an adapted version of CAM-S, increased during the game, confirming the stress-inducing nature of the task. No differences emerged between pitch conditions. These findings suggest that the benefits of lower pitch in reducing stress may not directly translate to child-robot interactions. Possible explanations include children's developing sensitivity to emotional tone, mismatches between the robot's voice and appearance, or the use of fixed pitch changes that sound unnatural, since real speech varies dynamically across multiple dimensions. Future research examining combinations of prosodic cues (beyond pitch alone) could provide further insights and help inform robot voice design for effective stress regulation support for children.
tldr: This paper investigates whether lower-pitched robot speech reduces children's stress during a robot-guided game, finding no effect and suggesting that human vocal stress-regulation benefits may not transfer to child-robot interaction.
tldr_zh: 本文研究机器人语音音调高低是否影响儿童在机器人引导游戏中的压力水平，结果未发现差异，表明人类语音的减压效果可能不适用于儿童-机器人交互。

title: SAGE: Ergodic Control for Autonomous and Adaptive Inspection of Subsea Infrastructure
summary: Subsea Christmas Trees (XTs) are underwater structures that use valves for directing oil flow, needing constant inspection. But not every valve carries the same risk at the same time: a valve with a suspected leak needs to be revisited far more often than one with a clean history, and that risk picture changes during the mission as new leaks are found. To handle this, we present SAGE (Semantic and Adaptive Generative Ergodicity), an ergodic-control architecture that allocates vehicle time in proportion to a live, sensor-derived risk distribution rather than a scripted route. We study a two-XT scenario, with five valves in total, and compare a fixed-loop A* tour against SAGE. Both methods can be tuned to spend similar total time near a high-risk valve, but only ergodic control also checks it more often: in simulation, a dominant-risk valve was revisited every 5.8 s under ergodic control against a fixed 8.1 s for every valve under A*, regardless of risk, so a leak can go unnoticed for barely two-thirds as long. Because the tracked distribution is recomputed rather than planned once, a newly detected leak shifts vehicle behavior on the next control cycle with no explicit re-planning step and no operator in the loop, which a fixed tour cannot do without a discrete re-route. We derive the ergodic control law behind this behavior and report simulation results on the five-valve scenario.
tldr: SAGE proposes an ergodic-control architecture for subsea infrastructure inspection that continuously reallocates vehicle time based on a live risk distribution, enabling adaptive and more frequent revisits to high-risk valves compared to fixed-route methods.
tldr_zh: SAGE提出了一种用于海底基础设施巡检的遍历控制架构，根据实时风险分布动态分配机器人时间，相比固定路线方法能够更频繁地检查高风险阀门。

title: Magnetically Self-Sealed MR Haptic Actuator With PWM-Based Excitation and High-Fidelity Torque Control
summary: Accurate and stable torque rendering is essential for safe and perceptive human--machine interaction. Magnetorheological fluid (MRF)-based actuators offer a compact and rapidly controllable solution for haptic feedback, but their practical implementation requires reliable fluid sealing, low-hysteresis excitation, accurate torque control, and stable long-duration operation. This article presents an integrated MRF haptic system featuring a compact magnetically self-sealed rotary actuator, low-hysteresis PWM operation, high-fidelity model-based torque rendering, and stable performance during long-time operation. Magnetostatic simulation guides the arrangement of magnetic and nonmagnetic materials to focus flux in the multidisk torque and permanent-magnet sealing regions, enabling a maximum 600 N$\cdot$mm/A output. Experiments show that higher PWM frequencies reduce hysteresis and improve repeatability. At 10 kHz, the response is represented by a nonlinear model that varies with the direction and speed of torque change. The real-time controller combines feedforward, hysteresis compensation, PI feedback, and sliding-mode correction. Compared with PID, it reduces square-wave overshoot, undershoot, and steady-state RMSE by 77.4\%, 61.9\%, and 68.3\%, respectively. It tracks sinusoidal and biomechanics-model-based references, and a 1.5-h test shows only a 2.5 $^\circ$C rise near the coil with no clear tracking loss. This high-fidelity torque rendering will fundamentally transform human--robot collaboration by making interactions safer, more efficient, and more intuitive.
tldr: This paper presents a compact MRF-based haptic actuator with magnetic self-sealing, low-hysteresis PWM excitation, and a high-fidelity model-based torque controller that significantly improves torque tracking for human-robot interaction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于磁流变液的紧凑型触觉致动器，采用磁性自密封、低迟滞PWM激励和高保真模型力矩控制，显著提升了人机协作中的力矩跟踪精度。

title: The Verification Gap in Networked Physical AI: A Post-Semantic Communication Framework
summary: A task-effective proposal is not yet a justified physical action. In networked Physical AI, a proposal may be understood while valid, timely, proposal-bound evidence or the authority required to finalize an action remains unavailable. We call this mismatch the verification gap and introduce a Post-Semantic Communication Framework for the systems interface between proposal formation and physical execution. The framework begins with application-declared evidence requirements, represents qualifying observations as evidence records, validates supporting and conflicting records through one path, and separates evidence sufficiency from authorized finalization and a downstream runtime gate. It further distinguishes evidence transfer, which can enlarge the record set reachable by a finalizer, from evidence coordination, which can suppress transmission around records already held at the finalization endpoint. Finite-state framework checks verify that the evaluator implements the declared distinctions consistently. Under the declared model, the controlled communication study exposes a finalizer-dependent asymmetry: sender-finalized Feedback uses evidence transfer to expand evidence reachability throughout the feasible plotted region, whereas receiver-finalized Feedback uses coordination to suppress redundant payload until loss, latency, freshness, and deadline costs shift selection to One-way. Finally, an episode-level reporting schema defines common denominators for future measured Physical-AI studies.
tldr: This paper proposes a post-semantic communication framework to address the 'verification gap' (the mismatch between a task proposal and its justified physical execution) in networked Physical AI, focusing on evidence transfer, coordination, and authorization for finalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种后语义通信框架，以解决网络化物理AI中任务提案与其合理物理执行之间的“验证差距”，重点关注证据传输、协调以及最终授权。

title: An Irreducible Quantum Advantage in Aligning World Models with Reality
summary: World models provide digital simulacra of the true world, allowing agents to be trained and tested before costly real-world deployment. At each time step, they receive an action and generate an observation and reward matching the statistics of the true world. In complex environments where present outcomes depend on events far in the past, this requires memory. One might expect that, by increasing memory, we can always build a model accurately enough to align the optimal agent policies of the real and virtual worlds. We show that this is false for classical world models, even when the true world itself is classical. We construct true worlds for which every finite classical model fails along the same possible trajectory: it either loses the ability to distinguish actions when the true world clearly prefers one, or repeatedly assigns the highest expected reward to suboptimal actions. Its expected-reward estimates also retain a nonvanishing average error. In contrast, each such true world admits a quantum world model using a single qutrit that reproduces it exactly: its reward estimates and preferred actions always match those of the true world, ensuring that the optimal policies of the real and virtual worlds remain perfectly aligned.
tldr: The paper proves that classical world models with finite memory cannot perfectly align optimal policies with the true world, but a quantum world model using a single qutrit can achieve exact alignment.
tldr_zh: 该论文证明，具有有限记忆的经典世界模型无法使最优策略与真实世界完美对齐，而使用单个qutrit的量子世界模型可以精确实现这种对齐。

title: Mix&Fix-Net: A Dual-Stage Trajectory Prediction Model for AIS and Vision-Derived Vessel Data
summary: Vessel trajectory prediction is critical for maritime safety and accident prevention. While most existing trajectory prediction models rely on Automatic Identification System (AIS) data due to its precision and availability, small vessels mostly operate without AIS, resulting in a significant monitoring gap. To address this, we propose Mix&Fix-Net, a dual-stage mixer-based trajectory prediction model designed to handle vessel trajectory time-series data derived from both AIS and (non-AIS) vision data. Our architecture integrates a Primary Trajectory Predictor with a Residual Trajectory Adjuster, enabling more refined trajectory prediction. Additionally, we introduce a new video-based dataset derived from webcam streams, from which vessel trajectories are extracted to represent non-AIS data. Extensive evaluations on both AIS and non-AIS datasets across six metrics (mean squared error, mean absolute error, symmetric mean absolute percentage error, final displacement error, Frechet distance, and average Euclidean distance) demonstrate that Mix&Fix-Net consistently outperforms existing baselines across most metrics and datasets.
tldr: A dual-stage mixer-based trajectory prediction model for both AIS and vision-derived vessel data, introducing a new video dataset for non-AIS vessels.
tldr_zh: 一个双阶段混合器轨迹预测模型，适用于AIS和视觉衍生船只数据，并引入了新的视频数据集用于非AIS船只。

title: $TCP_α$: Margin-Controlled Confidence estimation for reliable Music Information Retrieval
summary: Deep neural networks are often overconfident, assigning high confidence even to incorrect predictions. Consequently, users lack a reliable signal for deciding when a prediction can be trusted. Post-hoc confidence estimation addresses this by training a lightweight auxiliary head over a frozen classifier. Existing targets, however, suffer from inherent ambiguity: they assign overlapping confidence values to correct and incorrect predictions, while errors near the decision boundary receive confidence scores indistinguishable from correct predictions. In this work, we propose $TCP_α$, a novel confidence target that resolves these limitations by introducing a margin-controlled penalty for misclassified samples.
