Across in-distribution (including long-horizon) and out-of-distribution evaluations, RoG-DAgger improves the end-to-end model SimLingo by 5.3 driving-score points and 6.2 percentage points in success rate on Bench2Drive, doubles its driving score from 22 to 44 on Longest6 v2, and improves out-of-distribution success rate from 55\% to 66\% on Fail2Drive.
summary_zh: 最近的端到端驾驶系统在闭环基准测试中展现出强劲性能，但这些系统仍主要依赖固定专家采集数据，通过开环模仿学习进行训练。这种训练与推理之间的不匹配使得策略在策略诱导状态中变得脆弱，累积误差可能导致安全关键性故障。一种有前景的解决方案是数据集聚合，它通过在策略诱导状态下收集专家示范，随后在生成的聚合数据集上对策略进行微调。然而，现有的驾驶数据聚合流程面临三大挑战：i) 专家被限制在有限的轨迹与速度解空间中；ii) 相对于即将发生的故障，接管可能过早或过晚；iii) 特权专家的决策可能依赖学生无法获取的信息。为此，我们提出RoG-DAgger——一种后训练框架，利用短时域运动学推演在安全关键状态下构建高质量专家示范。具体而言，RoG-DAgger通过推演扩展专家轨迹与速度解空间并评估候选规划，从而构建预防性监督信号。同时，它利用推演可解性在预估不可逆临界点附近确定接管时机。最后，该方法将专家视野与学生视野对齐，以提供与学生兼容的监督。在分布内（含长时域任务）与分布外评估中，RoG-DAgger将端到端模型SimLingo在Bench2Drive上的驾驶评分提升5.3分、成功率提升6.2个百分点，在Longest6 v2上驾驶评分翻倍（从22分提升至44分），并将Fail2Drive上的分布外成功率从55%提升至66%。
tldr: RoG-DAgger is a post-training framework that uses short-horizon kinematic rollouts to generate student-compatible expert demonstrations for end-to-end driving, addressing key challenges in DAgger-based policy aggregation.
tldr_zh: RoG-DAgger 是一个利用短时域运动学 rollout 为端到端驾驶生成与学生兼容的专家示教的后训练框架，解决了 DAgger 策略聚合中的关键挑战。

title: NeuralParker: A Reinforcement Learning Planner for Irregular Parking Environments
summary: Automated parking commonly assumes marked slots and short approach maneuvers. Delivery and service vehicles, however, may need to reach an operator-specified pose in an irregular bounded environment from a distant start. Existing learning-based parking planners often rely on local observations, which can restrict long-range route reasoning. To address this problem, we present NeuralParker, a reinforcement learning-based hybrid planner for arbitrary-pose parking. NeuralParker encodes full-environment obstacle and boundary geometry in a target-relative vertex representation, allowing the policy to retain route-defining context throughout the approach. It further couples a learned curvature--length arc policy with an in-loop terminal ensemble that selects from diverse cubic Hermite connections using a curvature-regularized cost. We also establish factorial and long-range route-choice benchmarks to evaluate planning success and trajectory quality. Experiments on these benchmarks show that NeuralParker achieves higher planning success and better overall trajectory quality than the evaluated baselines, while ablation studies support the benefits of the target-relative global representation and terminal ensemble. Finally, a real-vehicle evaluation confirms that the planner transfers effectively to real delivery-vehicle perception at a working parking site, planning successfully at low computational cost.
summary_zh:
**摘要**  
自动泊车通常假设车位有明确标线且泊入路径较短。然而，配送车辆和服务车辆可能需要从较远的起点出发，在无规则的有界环境中到达操作员指定的位姿。现有的基于学习的泊车规划器往往依赖局部观测，这会限制远距离路径推理能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出 **NeuralParker**——一种基于强化学习的混合规划器，支持任意位姿的泊车。NeuralParker 将完整的环境障碍物和边界几何信息编码为目标相关的顶点表示，使策略在泊车过程中能够保留路径规划所需的全局上下文信息。此外，该规划器将学习的曲率-长度弧策略与闭环终端集成模块相结合，后者通过曲率正则化成本从多种三次埃尔米特连接中择优选择。我们还构建了因子化基准测试和远距离路径选择基准测试，以评估规划成功率与轨迹质量。实验结果表明，NeuralParker 在规划成功率和整体轨迹质量上均优于评估的基线方法；消融研究则验证了目标相关全局表示与终端集成模块的有效性。最后，实车评估证实，该规划器能够在实际工作泊车场景中有效迁移至真实配送车辆的感知系统，以较低计算成本成功完成规划。
tldr: NeuralParker is a reinforcement learning-based hybrid planner for irregular parking environments that uses a target-relative global map representation and a learned curvature-length arc policy with a terminal ensemble to achieve long-range route reasoning and successful real-vehicle transfer.
tldr_zh: NeuralParker 是一种基于强化学习的混合规划器，用于不规则停车环境，通过目标相对全局地图表示、学习到的曲率-长度弧策略和终端集成，实现了长距离路径推理和成功的实车迁移。

title: Variance-Guided Spatial Attention Fusion for Robust End-to-End Driving under Asymmetric Sensor Degradation
summary: End-to-end multimodal driving has progressed rapidly by fusing camera and LiDAR streams. Existing pipelines remain fragile under asymmetric sensor degradation, where either an entire modality or only a localized region is corrupted while other regions remain useful. The key difficulty is not simply to add an uncertainty head, but to obtain dense reliability supervision, calibrate this reliability against physical fault severity, and use it before unreliable features bias the planner. We propose Variance-Guided Spatial Attention Fusion (VG-SAF), in which dense heteroscedastic reliability estimates act as interpretable spatial gates. The framework couples three components. First, a physically grounded augmentor simulates representative camera and LiDAR failures and emits a continuous spatial mask, providing dense supervision without additional annotation. Second, modality-specific experts predict per-pixel reliability scales through cross-branch dense distillation in log space, enforcing a monotone severity-to-scale response. Third, calibrated reliability maps drive a hybrid attention mechanism that suppresses unreliable cells with a local spatial gate and arbitrates between modalities through a cross-modal trust softmax. A Laplace uncertainty head emits a systemic waypoint uncertainty scale that signals severe or combined sensor degradation, including severities outside the training ranges. On the CARLA Longest6 benchmark, VG-SAF consistently improves closed-loop robustness over the baselines across camera-only, LiDAR-only, and joint degradation regimes, as measured by driving score, route completion, and infraction score.
summary_zh: 端到端多模态驾驶通过融合相机与激光雷达数据流取得了快速进展。现有流程在面对非对称传感器退化时仍然脆弱——即整个模态或仅局部区域受损，而其他区域仍保持可用。关键难点并非简单添加不确定性预测头，而是获取密集的可靠性监督、将该可靠性与物理故障严重性进行校准，并在不可靠特征影响规划器之前加以运用。我们提出方差引导空间注意力融合（VG-SAF），其中密集的异方差可靠性估计充当可解释的空间门控。该框架包含三个组件。首先，基于物理的增强器模拟典型的相机和激光雷达故障，并生成连续空间掩码，在无需额外标注的情况下提供密集监督。其次，模态专用专家通过对数空间中的跨分支密集蒸馏预测每个像素的可靠性尺度，强制实现单调的严重性-尺度响应。第三，经校准的可靠性图驱动混合注意力机制：通过局部空间门控抑制不可靠单元，并通过跨模态信任Softmax在模态间进行仲裁。拉普拉斯不确定性预测头输出系统级航点不确定性尺度，用于指示严重或组合型传感器退化（包括超出训练范围的严重程度）。在CARLA Longest6基准测试中，VG-SAF在仅相机、仅激光雷达及联合退化场景下的驾驶分数、路线完成率和违规分数等指标上，持续提升了基线方法的闭环鲁棒性。
tldr: Proposes Variance-Guided Spatial Attention Fusion (VG-SAF) to handle asymmetric sensor degradation in end-to-end autonomous driving by using dense heteroscedastic reliability estimates as spatial gates.
tldr_zh: 提出方差引导空间注意力融合（VG-SAF），通过密集异方差可靠性估计作为空间门控，应对端到端自动驾驶中的非对称传感器退化问题。

title: CARO: Contact-Agnostic Residual Observation for Zero-Shot Robust Quadruped Locomotion
summary: We propose CARO, a contact-agnostic residual observation framework for policy adaptation. CARO embeds a fixed-base Euler--Lagrange model into the reinforcement learning control loop and constructs a torque-level residual observation without requiring torque sensors, explicit contact estimation, or vision-based measurements of the floating-base position and linear velocity. A disturbance observer extracts a structured signal representing dynamics mismatch, while the policy learns to exploit this feedback for online adaptation. CARO is trained under the same terrain, command, and domain-randomization conditions as the nominal policy, without specialized disturbance curricula or additional adaptation supervision. Nevertheless, it achieves substantially improved zero-shot robustness in simulation and sim-to-real transfer tasks involving out-of-distribution payloads, center-of-mass shifts, terrain geometries, abrupt dynamics changes, and elevated-platform landings.
summary_zh: 我们提出了CARO，一种用于策略自适应的非接触式残差观测框架。CARO将固定基座的欧拉-拉格朗日模型嵌入强化学习控制回路，构建了扭矩级残差观测，无需扭矩传感器、显式接触估计或基于视觉的浮动基座位置与线速度测量。扰动观测器提取表征动力学失配的结构化信号，而策略则学习利用该反馈进行在线自适应。CARO在与标称策略相同的地形、指令及域随机化条件下训练，无需专门的扰动课程或额外的自适应监督。然而，在涉及分布外负载、质心偏移、地形几何、突变动力学变化及高架平台着陆的仿真与仿真到现实迁移任务中，它实现了大幅提升的零样本鲁棒性。
tldr: A contact-agnostic residual observation framework that enhances zero-shot robustness of quadruped locomotion policies via a disturbance observer and torque-level residual feedback, achieving strong sim-to-real transfer without specialized training.
tldr_zh: 一种接触无关的残差观测框架，通过扰动观测器和扭矩级残差反馈增强了四足运动策略的零样本鲁棒性，无需专门训练即可实现出色的仿真到真实迁移。

title: GaussVLA: Geometry-Aware Spatial Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models encode visual observations as flat 2D patch tokens that carry no intrinsic geometric structure, and augmenting them with dense monocular depth injects per-pixel scalar values that encode neither surface orientation nor geometric confidence. This leaves the policy with limited structured spatial reasoning for action prediction. We propose GaussVLA, a Mamba-based VLA that incorporates two custom modules: Gaussian Spatial Tokenizer (GST) to lift frozen semantic and depth features into compact 3D Gaussian tokens, pools geometrically salient regions with learned queries, and \emph{Depth-Aware Chain-of-Thought (DA-CoT)} that performs structured, non-autoregressive geometric reasoning under language and flow-time conditioning. Across both simulation and real-world evaluations, GaussVLA demonstrates strong spatial-manipulation performance while remaining parameter-efficient. On LIBERO, it achieves 93.5% average success and 100.0% success on the Spatial suite with only 200M parameters, improving over SpatialVLA by 19.7% relative average success while remaining significantly more parameter-efficient.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉观测编码为扁平的2D补丁标记，这些标记不具备内在的几何结构；而为其添加密集的单目深度信息，仅能为每个像素注入标量数值，既无法编码表面朝向，也无法表达几何置信度。这使得策略在动作预测中缺乏结构化的空间推理能力。我们提出GaussVLA——一种基于Mamba架构的VLA模型，其集成了两个定制模块：高斯空间分词器（GST），用于将冻结的语义与深度特征提升为紧凑的3D高斯标记，并通过学习到的查询池化几何显著区域；以及深度感知思维链（DA-CoT），在语言与流时间条件约束下执行结构化的非自回归几何推理。在仿真与真实世界评估中，GaussVLA在保持参数高效的同时展现了强大的空间操控性能。在LIBERO基准上，该模型仅用200M参数即达到93.5%的平均成功率，并在空间任务组上取得100.0%的成功率；相较于SpatialVLA，其平均成功率相对提升19.7%，同时参数效率显著更高。
tldr: GaussVLA introduces a Gaussian Spatial Tokenizer (GST) and Depth-Aware Chain-of-Thought (DA-CoT) to enhance geometric reasoning in VLA models, achieving 93.5% success on LIBERO with only 200M parameters.
tldr_zh: GaussVLA 通过高斯空间分词器和深度感知思维链增强 VLA 模型的几何推理能力，在 LIBERO 上以仅 200M 参数达到 93.5% 的成功率。

title: Trajectory-Level Continuous Action Representation for Robotic Manipulation
summary: We propose CAT, a trajectory-level continuous action representation framework for robotic manipulation. Existing visuomotor systems often entangle action representation with control frequency or rely on fixed temporal parameterizations. This leads to representational redundancy at high sampling rates and limits the modeling of critical motion. CAT instead encodes action trajectories within a fixed real-time interval into a set of continuous latent tokens. To ensure temporal consistency across varying control frequencies, we further incorporate a frequency-aware positional encoding that establishs a shared temporal coordinate system. Trajectory-level regularization further stabilizes the latent representation. This approach prevents representation growth with timestep density and avoids reliance on predefined temporal parameterizations. Extensive system-level evaluations on LIBERO, MimicGen, and real-world long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate that CAT-based policies consistently outperform both competitive VQ-based and continuous visuomotor baselines under matched training settings. Across various model backbones and control frequencies, CAT consistently improves success rates. These results highlight the advantages of trajectory-level continuous action modeling for scalable robotic manipulation across varying control rates.
summary_zh: 我们提出CAT，一种面向机器人操作的轨迹级连续动作表示框架。现有的视觉运动系统常将动作表示与控制频率相耦合，或依赖固定的时间参数化方式。这导致高采样率下表示冗余，并限制了关键动作的建模能力。CAT则将在固定实时时间间隔内的动作轨迹编码为一组连续的潜在标记。为确保不同控制频率下的时间一致性，我们进一步引入频率感知位置编码，建立共享的时间坐标系。轨迹级正则化进一步稳定了潜在表示。该方法避免了表示随时间步密度增长，且不依赖预定义的时间参数化方式。在LIBERO、MimicGen以及真实世界长时程操作任务上的系统级评估表明，在相同训练设置下，基于CAT的策略在性能上持续优于基于竞争性VQ和连续视觉运动的基线方法。在不同模型主干和控制频率下，CAT均能稳定提升成功率。这些结果凸显了轨迹级连续动作建模在适应不同控制频率的可扩展机器人操作中的优势。
tldr: This paper introduces CAT, a trajectory-level continuous action representation framework that encodes action trajectories into latent tokens with frequency-aware positional encoding, improving manipulation policy performance across varying control frequencies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CAT，一种轨迹级连续动作表示框架，将动作轨迹编码为潜在令牌并引入频率感知位置编码，在不同控制频率下提升操作策略性能。

title: TrAct: Bridging Robot Control and Visual Prediction with Visual Tracks
summary: Robot actions are inherently embodiment-specific and only weakly aligned with image-space visual changes, limiting their effectiveness as conditioning signals for robot world models. In contrast, visual tracks provide an embodiment-agnostic representation of how task-relevant points move through a scene, offering dense image-space guidance for accurate and spatially precise future video prediction. Building on this observation, we propose TrAct, a world-model-based robot decision-making framework that uses visual tracks as an intermediate interface between control and prediction. TrAct consists of three components: a Vision-Language-Action-and-Track model (VLAT) that jointly predicts candidate actions and corresponding visual tracks from the current observation and language instruction; a track-conditioned world model (TWM) that predicts future visual outcomes conditioned on the proposed tracks; and a vision-language reward model (VLAC) that scores the predicted outcomes. At inference time, VLAT generates candidate action-track pairs, TWM rolls out their visual consequences, and VLAC selects the track whose predicted outcome best satisfies the instruction; the action paired with the selected track is then executed by the robot. Experiments on the proposed LIBERO-INTEGRAL benchmark and real-world Franka manipulation show that TrAct improves success rates from 27% to 55% in simulation and from 49% to 76% on real-world tasks compared with the strong VLA baseline $π_{0.5}$. Furthermore, TWM consistently improves video prediction quality over the action-conditioned world model (AWM). These results demonstrate that visual tracks provide an effective shared interface between robot control and visual prediction, enabling more accurate world modeling and stronger robot generalization.
summary_zh: 机器人动作本质上具有具身特异性，且与图像空间中的视觉变化关联较弱，这限制了其作为机器人世界模型条件信号的效能。相比之下，视觉轨迹提供了一种与具身无关的表征方式，描述任务相关点如何在场景中运动，从而为准确且具有空间精度的未来视频预测提供密集的图像空间引导。基于这一发现，我们提出TrAct——一种基于世界模型的机器人决策框架，该框架利用视觉轨迹作为控制与预测之间的中间接口。TrAct包含三个组件：视觉-语言-动作-轨迹模型（VLAT），用于从当前观测和语言指令中联合预测候选动作及对应视觉轨迹；轨迹条件世界模型（TWM），基于所提出的轨迹预测未来视觉结果；以及视觉-语言奖励模型（VLAC），对预测结果进行评分。在推理阶段，VLAT生成候选动作-轨迹对，TWM展开其视觉后果，VLAC选择预测结果最符合指令的轨迹；随后机器人执行与该轨迹配对的动作。在提出的LIBERO-INTEGRAL基准测试及真实世界Franka操作实验表明，与强基线VLA模型$π_{0.5}$相比，TrAct在仿真环境中将成功率从27%提升至55%，在真实世界任务中从49%提升至76%。此外，TWM在视频预测质量上始终优于基于动作的世界模型（AWM）。这些结果表明，视觉轨迹为机器人控制与视觉预测之间提供了有效的共享接口，使得更精确的世界建模与更强的机器人泛化能力得以实现。
tldr: TrAct introduces visual tracks as an embodiment-agnostic intermediate interface between robot control and visual prediction, enabling a world-model-based framework that jointly generates candidate action-track pairs, predicts future outcomes via a track-conditioned world model, and selects the best track via a reward model; it achieves significant success rate improvements on LIBERO-INTEGRAL and real Franka tasks over the π₀.₅ VLA baseline.
tldr_zh: TrAct 提出将视觉轨迹作为机器人控制与视觉预测之间的一种跨具身形态的中间接口，构建了一个基于世界模型的决策框架，联合生成候选动作-轨迹对，通过轨迹条件世界模型预测未来结果，并利用奖励模型选择最优轨迹；在 LIBERO-INTEGRAL 仿真和真实 Franka 操作任务上相比 π₀.₅ VLA 基线取得了显著的成功率提升。

title: Hierarchical Skill Retrieval for Data-Efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models pretrained on large-scale robot datasets provide a strong foundation for robot manipulation, their performance can degrade when adapted to new tasks with limited task-specific demonstrations. Retrieval offers a practical way to reuse existing demonstrations for data-efficient adaptation, but existing methods often rely on visual similarity, state-action representations, or task-level language matching. These approaches may overlook the hierarchical structure of long-horizon manipulation tasks, where complete task matches are rare but reusable skills are often abundant. To address this challenge, we propose Hierarchical Skill Retrieval (HSR), a retrieval framework for data-efficient VLA adaptation. Specifically, HSR first decomposes a target task into candidate skill sequences. It evaluates each plan based on both semantic plausibility and skill reliability estimated from the prior dataset. The selected decomposition is then used for hybrid retrieval. This combines subtask-level language retrieval with behavior-feature reranking to identify demonstrations that are both semantically relevant and compatible with the target task. Finally, we adapt the policy through a two-stage pretraining and finetuning pipeline, which separates general skill acquisition from task-specific adaptation. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark and several real-world robot manipulation tasks show that HSR improves the average success rate by 10.3% and 21.3% over the strongest baseline, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of structured skill-level retrieval for data-efficient VLA adaptation. Videos and code are available at https://hoar012.github.io/HSR-Project.
summary_zh: 在大规模机器人数据集上预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人操作提供了坚实基础，但当其适应仅有少量任务特定演示数据的新任务时，性能可能会下降。检索提供了一种重用现有演示数据以实现数据高效适配的实用方法，但现有方法通常依赖于视觉相似性、状态-动作表示或任务级语言匹配。这些方法可能忽略了长时域操作任务的层级结构——完整任务匹配稀少，而可复用的技能却往往丰富。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了层级化技能检索（HSR），一种面向数据高效VLA适配的检索框架。具体而言，HSR首先将目标任务分解为候选技能序列，并基于语义合理性和从先验数据集中评估的技能可靠性对每个方案进行评价。然后，选定的分解结果用于混合检索，这一过程将子任务级语言检索与行为特征重排序相结合，以识别既语义相关又与目标任务兼容的演示数据。最后，我们通过两阶段预训练与微调流程来适配策略，将通用技能获取与任务特定适配相分离。在LIBERO基准测试以及多项真实世界机器人操作任务上的实验表明，HSR相较于最强基线分别将平均成功率提升了10.3%和21.3%。这些结果证明了结构化技能级检索在数据高效VLA适配中的有效性。视频和代码详见https://hoar012.github.io/HSR-Project。
tldr: Proposes a hierarchical skill retrieval method that decomposes long-horizon tasks into subskills and retrieves behavior demonstrations for data-efficient VLA adaptation, improving robot manipulation success rates on LIBERO and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种分层技能检索方法，将长时域任务分解为子技能并检索行为演示，以实现数据高效的VLA模型适配，在LIBERO和真实机器人操作任务上提升了成功率。

title: NeurRAFT: Robot Motion Planning via Anchor-Level Flow Matching with Clearance-Aware Preference Tuning
summary: Recent end-to-end neural motion planners generate trajectories from raw sensor observations, avoiding the privileged geometric models required by classical planners. However, collision-free planning in cluttered environments remains challenging. We present NeurRAFT, a generative planning framework based on anchor-level flow matching and clearance-aware preference tuning. Unlike prior neural planners that model dense waypoint sequences and spend capacity on redundant local details and smoothness, NeurRAFT operates on compact anchor waypoints. We train the planner using a Jacobian-weighted loss that accounts for the task-space impact of each anchor. At inference, the anchors are generated in two integration steps, followed by cubic-spline interpolation to recover a smooth, full-resolution trajectory. Since imitation learning from positive demonstrations cannot distinguish collision-free from near-collision trajectories, collision-prone behaviors persist at test time. Rather than relying on post-hoc corrections, we directly reshape the pretrained planner's distribution toward safer solutions without augmenting inference. Specifically, Direct Preference Optimization shifts probability mass toward trajectories with larger obstacle clearance, with the resulting improvement directly absorbed into the planner parameters. Experiments show substantial improvements over state-of-the-art planners, while real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer to a Franka robot under noisy and partially occluded depth observations. Video results available at https://neurraft.github.io/.
summary_zh:
摘要：
近年来，端到端神经运动规划器能够直接从原始传感器观测数据生成轨迹，避免了传统规划器所需的特权几何模型。然而，在杂乱环境中实现无碰撞规划仍具挑战性。我们提出NeurRAFT，一种基于锚点级流匹配与间隙感知偏好调优的生成式规划框架。与以往对稠密路点序列建模、将计算能力耗费于冗余局部细节和平滑性的神经规划器不同，NeurRAFT采用紧凑的锚点路点进行操作。我们利用雅可比加权损失函数训练规划器，该函数可表征每个锚点在任务空间中的影响。推理时，锚点通过两步积分生成，随后经由三次样条插值恢复出平滑的全分辨率轨迹。由于仅基于正向示范的模仿学习无法区分无碰撞轨迹与近碰撞轨迹，测试阶段碰撞倾向行为仍然存在。我们不依赖事后修正，而是直接重塑预训练规划器的分布，使其倾向于更安全的解——且无需增加推理负担。具体而言，直接偏好优化将概率质量转移至具有更大障碍物间隙的轨迹，所获改进直接吸收至规划器参数中。实验表明，该方法显著优于当前最先进的规划器，而实际机器人实验展示了在含噪声及部分遮挡的深度观测下，向Franka机器人的零样本迁移能力。视频结果请见 https://neurraft.github.io/。
tldr: NeurRAFT is a generative motion planning framework that uses anchor-level flow matching and Direct Preference Optimization with clearance-aware rewards to produce collision-free trajectories for robot manipulators, demonstrated on a Franka robot.
tldr_zh: NeurRAFT 是一种生成式运动规划框架，通过锚点级流匹配和具有避碰感知奖赏的直接偏好优化来生成无碰撞轨迹，并在 Franka 机器人上进行了验证。

title: DreamLedger: Execution-Settled Credit Files for World-Model Imagination in Robot Decision Loops
summary: Robots are beginning to act on world-model predictions, yet reliability is still expressed through instantaneous, model-internal signals. DreamLedger instead treats reliability as a persistent deployment object: an execution-settled credit file recording how often consumed predictions are borne out, indexed by operating condition, region, and prediction horizon, and consulted before each use. Each consumed prediction is registered as a claim; attributable outcomes are settled against arriving reality at zero labeling cost, an attribution stage excludes measurement-contaminated outcomes, and a settlement-supervised head complements sparse bins. The resulting credit gates consumption: low-credit predictions shorten the dependent horizon or trigger additional observation; every reliance event remains auditable via dependency tickets and replayable logs. We evaluate DreamLedger in three simulated domains (indoor flight, tabletop manipulation, 2D navigation), via mounts on unmodified DreamerV3, TD-MPC2, and V-JEPA 2-AC, and on a real Franka manipulator. Claim failure is dose-monotone in all 12 held-out condition-horizon cells. Credit-gated planning reduces burned imagination (consumed claims that later fail to redeem) by 62% (95% CI 43-81%) versus blind consumption, with equal success and comparable collision rates. At matched risk targets, persistent books cut verification probes from 1.00 to 0.36/episode in manipulation, at success 0.94 versus 0.98; settlement-grounded calibration retains moderate, seed-consistent operating points unlike raw instantaneous gates. The same trust layer operates across decoder-, latent-, and token-space interfaces, including V-JEPA 2-AC settled on real robot frames. On hardware, settlement remains operational under real sensing and contact noise, a deployment failure loop is re-priced online, and all 1,062 registered spends replay from the audit logs.
summary_zh: 机器人正开始基于世界模型预测执行动作，但可靠性仍通过瞬时的、模型内部信号来表达。DreamLedger将可靠性视为一种持久化部署对象：一份经执行结算的信用档案，记录消耗预测在指定运行条件、区域和预测时域内的验证频率，并在每次使用前进行查询。每条被消耗的预测均作为一项声明进行登记；可归属结果以零标注成本与到达的现实进行结算，归因阶段排除受测量污染的结果，结算监督模块补充稀疏数据区间。生成的信用门控机制限制预测消耗：低信用预测会缩短依赖时域或触发额外观察；每次依赖事件均可通过依赖票据和可回放日志进行审计。我们在三个模拟域（室内飞行、桌面操作、二维导航）中，通过未修改的DreamerV3、TD-MPC2和V-JEPA 2-AC，以及在真实Franka机械臂上对DreamLedger进行了评估。在所有12个保留条件-时域单元中，声明失败率呈剂量单调性。与盲目消耗相比，信用门控规划将燃烧的想象（指随后无法兑现的消耗预测）减少了62%（95%置信区间43-81%），同时成功率与碰撞率相当。在匹配的风险目标下，持久化账簿将操作中的验证探针从每轮1.00次降至0.36次，成功率分别为0.94与0.98；基于结算校准的模块保持适中和种子一致的工作点，这与原始瞬时门控不同。同一信任层可跨解码器、潜在空间和令牌空间接口运行，包括在真实机器人帧上进行结算的V-JEPA 2-AC。在硬件上，结算在真实感知和接触噪声下仍可运行，部署故障循环可在线重新定价，所有1,062次注册消耗均可从审计日志中回放。
tldr: DreamLedger introduces a persistent credit system for world-model predictions in robot decision loops, recording historical prediction reliability indexed by condition and horizon, and gating prediction usage to reduce 'burned imagination' while enabling auditability. It is evaluated on simulated and real robots across multiple domains and model interfaces.
tldr_zh: DreamLedger 提出一种持久信用系统，用于机器人决策循环中的世界模型预测，按条件和历史记录预测可靠性，并通过信用门控减少无效想象，同时支持审计。在模拟和真实机器人上进行了多领域、多模型的评估。

title: Learning to Act While Waiting: RL Finetuning of Generalist Robot Policies Under Inference Latency
summary: While reinforcement learning (RL) allows generalist robot policies to continually improve during deployment, the large model size of modern generalist policies, such as VLAs, poses a fundamental obstacle to effective RL improvement. In particular, their severe inference latency---which can lead to pauses or jerky movements---can alter the effective environment dynamics and, if not correctly accounted for, break the Markov assumption that RL relies on, causing standard RL algorithms to fail completely. In this work, we introduce a latency-aware framework, Asynchronous RL with Intermediate Information (ARLI), that enables RL-based improvement of generalist policies under inference delays. Our framework builds on asynchronous inference approaches, which interleave action generation with execution to hide latency, and addresses its incompatibility with RL by providing a low-latency RL policy design that maximizes reactivity within the inference window through two contributions: state augmentations that restore near-Markovian structure by incorporating committed actions and a mid-inference observation. We evaluate our approach across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, and find that it enables effective finetuning under inference delays where standard RL fails entirely, even matching or exceeding the performance of standard RL in idealized no-latency settings.
summary_zh: 尽管强化学习（RL）允许通用机器人策略在部署过程中持续改进，但现代通用策略（如VLA）的大模型规模对有效的RL改进构成了根本性障碍。具体而言，其严重的推理延迟——可能导致停顿或卡顿运动——会改变有效的环境动态，若未妥善处理，将破坏RL所依赖的马尔可夫假设，导致标准RL算法完全失效。本文提出了一种延迟感知框架——基于中间信息的异步强化学习（ARLI），使得在推理延迟条件下仍能实现基于RL的通用策略改进。该框架基于异步推理方法，将动作生成与执行交错进行以隐藏延迟，并通过两项贡献解决其与RL的不兼容问题：第一，提供低延迟RL策略设计，在推理窗口内最大化响应性；第二，通过整合已提交动作与中间推理观测的状态增强机制，恢复近马尔可夫结构。我们在仿真与真实世界的操作任务中评估了该方法，发现其在标准RL完全失效的推理延迟场景下仍能实现有效微调，甚至在理想无延迟环境下也能达到或超越标准RL的性能。
tldr: This paper proposes ARLI, a latency-aware RL framework that enables finetuning of generalist robot policies (like VLAs) under severe inference delays by using asynchronous inference with state augmentations to restore near-Markovian structure.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ARLI，一种延迟感知的强化学习框架，通过异步推理和状态增强来恢复近马尔可夫结构，使得在严重推理延迟下仍能微调通用机器人策略（如VLA）。

title: LeFlow: Generative Latent Flow Planning for World Models
summary: Latent world models are inherently strong encoders that transform image pixel to latent embedding, yet existing world models still rely on online trajectory optimization for action planning: for every state-goal pair, an iterative optimizer is run from scratch to search for optimal action sequences, treating the world model as a black-box simulator. This approach pays the full iterative optimization cost anew at every replanning step and reuses no planning experience across queries. In this work, we ask whether planning itself can be amortized once a latent world model has been learned. We present LeFlow, which learns a reusable latent trajectory prior operating directly in the latent dynamics space from the world model. LeFlow recasts planning as conditional latent trajectory generation: a rectified-flow model imagines a future latent path between the current and goal embeddings, an inverse dynamics decoder turns latent transitions into action chunks, and the frozen world model verifies each candidate by autoregressive rollout. Across four major goal-conditioned pixel-control benchmarks, LeFlow replaces iterative action-space optimization with amortized latent planning and fixed-budget rollout selection, achieving consistent success-rate gains with an order-of-magnitude reduction in planning time. Our results argue that latent world models should support not only prediction but reusable planning priors. Our code is available at https://github.com/hsiangwei0903/LeFlow.
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型本质上是强大的编码器，能够将图像像素转化为潜在嵌入表示，然而现有世界模型在动作规划中仍依赖在线轨迹优化：针对每个状态-目标对，都需要从头运行迭代优化器来搜索最优动作序列，将世界模型视为黑箱模拟器。这种方法每次重新规划时都要重新承担完整的迭代优化成本，且无法跨查询复用规划经验。本研究探讨了在潜在世界模型被学习后，规划本身能否被摊销化的问题。我们提出LeFlow方法，它学习一个可直接在世界模型的潜在动力学空间中运行的可复用潜在轨迹先验。LeFlow将规划重构为条件式潜在轨迹生成：使用整流流模型在当前位置嵌入与目标嵌入之间构建未来潜在路径，通过逆动力学解码器将潜在转移转化为动作序列块，再借助冻结的世界模型通过自回归推演验证每个候选方案。在四个目标条件化像素控制基准测试中，LeFlow用摊销式潜在规划与固定预算推演选择替代了迭代式动作空间优化，在将规划时间降低一个数量级的同时实现了一致的成功率提升。我们的研究结果表明，潜在世界模型不仅应支持预测功能，更应提供可复用的规划先验。我们的代码开源在https://github.com/hsiangwei0903/LeFlow。
tldr: LeFlow amortizes planning in latent world models by learning a latent trajectory prior that generates action sequences via rectified flow, replacing iterative optimization with fixed-budget rollout selection and achieving order-of-magnitude speedup.
tldr_zh: LeFlow通过学习潜在轨迹先验来摊销潜在世界模型中的规划，利用整流流生成动作序列，以固定预算的滚动选择替代迭代优化，实现数量级的加速。

title: GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models
summary: Video generative models provide rich physical priors for robot learning, yet existing world-action models (WAMs) face a fundamental trade-off: synchronous video generation at control rate is latency-prohibitive, while abandoning test-time visual imagination sacrifices task success. We show that visual imagination achieves both real-time inference and superior success rates when generated asynchronously off the critical path and consumed directly in latent space. We introduce GlanceWAM, which decouples imagination from control within a single video DiT: an asynchronous proposer glances ahead on a slow clock to imagine a single lookahead frame seconds into the future in the background, while an action head decodes action chunks at control rate (48 ms) purely in latent space without blocking. Enabled by a non-interfering attention mask that isolates video representations and staleness-robust horizon training that accommodates asynchronous lookahead aging, GlanceWAM breaks the speed-success dilemma. Trained purely on demonstrations, it attains 72.2% on the 24-task RoboCasa kitchen benchmark (surpassing synchronous Cosmos Policy at 67.1% and imagination-free co-training at 64.4%) and 99.0% on LIBERO, executing at 48 ms per chunk on an NVIDIA A100 GPU (24x faster than synchronous baselines). Code is available at https://github.com/linhanwang/GlanceWAM.
summary_zh: 视频生成模型为机器人学习提供了丰富的物理先验知识，然而现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）面临一个根本性的权衡：以控制频率进行同步视频生成会带来难以接受的延迟，而放弃测试时的视觉想象又会牺牲任务成功率。我们证明，当视觉想象在关键路径之外异步生成并直接在潜在空间中消费时，既能实现实时推理，又能获得更高的成功率。我们提出GlanceWAM，它在单个视频DiT内将想象与控制解耦：一个异步提议器以慢时钟频率提前预判，在后台想象未来数秒的一个前瞻帧，而动作头则以控制频率（48毫秒）纯粹在潜在空间中解码动作块，无需阻塞。借助隔离视频表示的无干扰注意力掩码和适应异步前瞻老化的鲁棒时域训练策略，GlanceWAM打破了速度与成功率的两难困境。仅基于演示数据训练，它在包含24个任务的RoboCasa厨房基准测试中达到72.2%的成功率（超越同步Cosmos Policy的67.1%和无想象协同训练的64.4%），在LIBERO基准上达到99.0%，在NVIDIA A100 GPU上以每块48毫秒的速度执行（比同步基线快24倍）。代码已开源在 https://github.com/linhanwang/GlanceWAM。
tldr: GlanceWAM decouples asynchronous visual imagination from real-time action control in a video diffusion transformer, achieving 48 ms/chunk inference while outperforming synchronous and imagination-free baselines on RoboCasa and LIBERO benchmarks.
tldr_zh: GlanceWAM 通过将异步视觉想象与实时动作控制解耦，在视频扩散Transformer中实现48毫秒/块的推理速度，同时在RoboCasa和LIBERO基准测试中优于同步和无想象基线。

title: JEPA-x: Cross-Predictive Physics Grounding for Forecastable Latent Dynamics
summary: Latent world models plan by predicting how candidate actions advance learned latent dynamics. In self-predictive models, however, the encoder and predictor are optimized jointly and can co-adapt to latent transitions that are easy to predict but weakly constrained by the physical evolution of the scene. We introduce the cross-predictive JEPA (JEPA-x), which grounds visual latent dynamics in privileged physical trajectories. JEPA-x treats visual observations and physical states as corresponding views of the same action-conditioned trajectory, advances both through a shared predictor, and matches predictions from either view to future representations in both modalities. This requires the action-conditioned predictor to learn a common transition rule for both the visual and physical descriptions of the scene. The physical branch is used only during training, leaving no computational overhead at deployment. Empirical results show that JEPA-x reduces the rollout drift of a newly fitted predictor from $0.361$ to $0.104$ and increases mean control success from $53.6\%$ to $78.2\%$ on a multi-task suite spanning six evaluation subfamilies. We additionally show that making physical state decodable is not the load-bearing factor; rather, the gains arise from how cross-prediction shapes the geometry of the learned latent dynamics.
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型通过预测候选行动如何推进学习到的潜在动态来进行规划。然而，在自预测模型中，编码器和预测器被联合优化，可能协同适应那些易于预测但受场景物理演化约束较弱的潜在转移。我们引入了交叉预测JEPA（JEPA-x），它将视觉潜在动态建立在特权物理轨迹之上。JEPA-x将视觉观察和物理状态视为同一行动条件轨迹的对应视图，通过共享预测器推进两者，并将任一视角的预测与两种模态中的未来表征进行匹配。这要求行动条件预测器学习适用于场景视觉描述和物理描述的通用转换规则。物理分支仅在训练时使用，部署时无额外计算开销。实证结果表明，在涵盖六个评估子系列的多任务套件中，JEPA-x将新拟合预测器的展开漂移从0.361降至0.104，并将平均控制成功率从53.6%提升至78.2%。我们还证明，使物理状态可解码并非关键因素；真正带来性能提升的是交叉预测如何塑造了所学潜在动态的几何结构。
tldr: JEPA-x grounds visual latent dynamics in privileged physical trajectories via cross-prediction, reducing rollout drift and improving control success in a multitask robotic suite.
tldr_zh: JEPA-x 通过跨预测将视觉潜态动力学与特权物理轨迹对齐，减少了 rollout 漂移并提高了多任务机器人套件的控制成功率。

title: VIP: Variation-based Iterative-learning Planning for Robotic Navigation
summary: Over the past decade, autonomous robotic systems have been increasingly deployed in applications such as surveying, search and rescue, and last-mile delivery. These applications require robots to generate safe and efficient motion plans in large, complex, and obstacle-dense environments, often under limited onboard computing resources. However, conventional planning methods commonly rely on finite-dimensional trajectory parameterization or increasingly long prediction horizons, leading to rapidly growing computational costs, particularly in multi-robot scenarios. This paper presents a novel variation-based iterative-learning planning (VIP) framework for efficient motion planning of both single robots and robotic swarms. Instead of optimizing a large number of discrete trajectory variables, VIP directly updates the planning command as a continuous function in an infinite-dimensional function space. The same variation-based update can be implemented in a model-in-the-loop manner for offline planning or in a robot-in-the-loop manner between online physical executions. By avoiding the computational burden associated with horizon expansion and high-dimensional trajectory discretization, VIP maintains a per-iteration computational complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n)$, where $n$ denotes the number of spatial discretization points. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework can efficiently generate and iteratively improve motion plans for different planning objectives, robotic platforms, and swarm configurations, highlighting its effectiveness, computational efficiency, and scalability as a general planning methodology.
summary_zh: 在过去十年中，自主机器人系统已越来越多地应用于测绘、搜索救援以及末端配送等领域。这些应用要求机器人在大型、复杂且障碍物密集的环境中，在机载计算资源通常有限的条件下，生成安全高效的运动规划方案。然而，传统规划方法通常依赖于有限维度的轨迹参数化或不断延长的预测时域，导致计算成本迅速增长，尤其在多机器人场景中更为突出。本文提出了一种新颖的基于变分的迭代学习规划（VIP）框架，用于实现单个机器人与机器人集群的高效运动规划。VIP不直接优化大量离散轨迹变量，而是在无穷维函数空间中将规划指令作为连续函数进行直接更新。相同的基于变分的更新既可通过模型在环的方式实现离线规划，也可通过机器人在环的方式实现在线物理执行之间的迭代优化。通过避免因时域扩展和高维轨迹离散化带来的计算负担，VIP保持了每次迭代的计算复杂度为\(\mathcal{O}(n)\)，其中\(n\)表示空间离散点的数量。大量仿真与真实世界实验表明，该框架能够针对不同的规划目标、机器人平台及集群配置高效生成并迭代优化运动规划方案，充分证明了其作为通用规划方法的高效性、计算可扩展性与有效性。
tldr: VIP proposes a variation-based iterative-learning planning framework for efficient motion planning of both single robots and robotic swarms, achieving O(n) per-iteration complexity by updating commands as continuous functions instead of discrete trajectories.
tldr_zh: VIP提出了一种基于变分的迭代学习规划框架，用于单机器人和机器人集群的高效运动规划，通过将命令更新为连续函数而非离散轨迹，实现了每次迭代O(n)的计算复杂度。

title: Fiber Optic Sensing Glove for High Performance Dexterous Manipulation Capture
summary: Capturing hand pose during dexterous manipulation remains difficult: vision-based methods degrade under occlusion and challenging lighting, while sensorized gloves, though occlusion-free, are prone to drift and magnetic interference and rarely match motion-capture accuracy. We introduce a fiber optic sensing glove for full hand pose tracking that targets these failure modes, using multi-core shape-sensing fibers that capture each fiber's full 3D shape rather than curvature alone. A novel pipeline registers each reconstructed fiber shape to a common hand reference frame, and a new inverse-kinematics solver reconstructs full hand pose at 60 Hz using curve constraints. Benchmarked on a 2-hour dataset of dexterous object manipulation tasks across 5 subjects, the glove achieves 7.2 mm mean fingertip position error against motion capture ground truth, reduced to 4.9 mm by a one-time factory calibration of the fiber routing hub that transfers across users and sessions. These capabilities enable high-fidelity data capture and bimanual virtual teleoperation - both essential to advancing the robotics field.
summary_zh: 在灵巧操作过程中捕捉手部姿态仍然存在困难：基于视觉的方法在遮挡和复杂光照条件下性能下降，而传感器手套虽无遮挡问题，但易受漂移和磁场干扰，且很少能达到动作捕捉的精度。我们提出一种用于全手姿态追踪的光纤传感手套，旨在解决上述失效模式，该手套采用多芯形状传感光纤，可捕捉每根光纤的完整三维形状而不仅仅是曲率。一种新型流程将每根重构的光纤形状配准到共同的手部参考坐标系，并采用基于曲线约束的新逆运动学求解器以60赫兹频率重构全手姿态。在包含5名受试者、时长2小时的灵巧物体操作任务数据集上进行基准测试，该手套的平均指尖位置误差为7.2毫米（以动作捕捉真值为基准），通过一次性的光纤路由集线器工厂校准可将误差降至4.9毫米，且该校准可跨用户和实验会话迁移。这些能力实现了高保真数据采集和双手虚拟遥操作——这两者对于推动机器人领域发展均至关重要。
tldr: This paper introduces a fiber optic sensing glove that tracks full hand pose during dexterous manipulation at 60 Hz, achieving low fingertip position error via multi-core shape-sensing fibers and a dedicated inverse-kinematics solver, enabling high-fidelity data capture and bimanual virtual teleoperation for robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种光纤传感手套，通过多芯形状传感光纤和专用逆运动学求解器，在灵巧操作过程中以60 Hz频率跟踪完整手部姿态，实现了较低的指尖位置误差，为机器人领域提供高保真数据采集和双手虚拟遥操作能力。

title: CARE: Camera-Residual Reserves for First Sightings in Adaptive LiDAR Sensing
summary: Adaptive LiDAR scanning concentrates a limited sensing budget on regions of interest predicted from past object tracks, lowering data volume in autonomous driving while maintaining detection accuracy. However, existing scanning policies face three challenges. First, history-driven approaches depend on past tracks, so unseen objects are detected late or missed. Second, random or uniform sampling outside the predicted regions has no awareness of where new objects appear. Third, camera-guided alternatives spend budget on all camera detections, resampling objects already covered, costing recall in crowded scenes and range when budgets are scarce. This paper introduces the CAmera-REsidual reserve (CARE), a training-free allocation rule that reserves part of a fixed ray budget for the directions of current camera detections that the track forecasts cannot explain; the rest follows the base history policy, and unused reserve returns to a random floor. The paper makes three contributions. First, a leakage-free ray-budget evaluation on nuScenes (150 scenes, 4,148 events) measuring the first-sighting loss of history-driven scanning, with a strict-causal variant using the preceding keyframe. Second, CARE raises first-sighting recall by 5.2, 5.2, and 4.3 points at 10%, 20%, and 35% budgets over the history policy, with paired intervals excluding zero; the camera cue drives this gain, and the first-sighting versus overall trade-off is a budget-dependent Pareto choice. Third, a safety-bounded forgetting module that releases budget from receding or static tracks beyond a speed-dependent guard distance; at tight budgets, forgetting without the guard significantly harms near-field recall, so the guard is what keeps it safe. The pipeline runs end to end on a real vehicle and, in closed-loop simulation, detects an occluded pedestrian earlier and brakes more reliably than history-driven scanning.
summary_zh: 自适应激光雷达扫描将有限的感知资源集中于根据先前目标轨迹预测的感兴趣区域，从而在降低自动驾驶数据量的同时保持检测精度。然而，现有扫描策略面临三个挑战。其一，基于历史的方法依赖过往轨迹，导致未观测目标被延迟检测或遗漏。其二，对预测区域之外的随机或均匀采样未考虑新目标出现的位置。其三，相机引导的替代方案将资源分配给所有相机检测结果，对已覆盖目标重复采样，在资源稀缺时导致拥挤场景中的召回率下降和探测距离缩短。本文提出相机残差保留（CARE）——一种免训练的资源分配规则：将固定射线预算的一部分保留给当前相机检测中轨迹预测无法解释的方向；其余部分遵循基础历史策略，未使用的保留资源回归随机基准。本文有三点贡献：第一，在nuScenes数据集（150个场景，4148个事件）上实现无泄漏的射线预算评估，通过严格因果变体使用前一关键帧，衡量历史驱动扫描的首次观测损失；第二，CARE在10%、20%和35%预算水平下，将历史策略的首次观测召回率分别提升5.2、5.2和4.3个百分点（配对区间排除零值），相机线索驱动了该项增益，且首次观测与整体召回率的权衡是预算相关的帕累托选择；第三，提出安全边界遗忘模块，对超出速度依赖保护距离的远离或静态轨迹释放预算——在严格预算下，无保护的遗忘会显著损害近场召回率，而保护距离正是保障安全的关键。该流水线在实车上实现端到端运行，闭环仿真中比历史驱动扫描更早检测到遮挡行人并更可靠地执行制动。
tldr: CARE introduces a training-free allocation rule for adaptive LiDAR sensing that reserves ray budget for camera detections not explained by track forecasts, improving first-sighting recall and closed-loop safety in autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: CARE 提出一种免训练的自适应 LiDAR 感知资源分配规则，为相机检测中未被目标轨迹预测解释的区域预留射线预算，从而提升自动驾驶中的首次发现召回率和闭环安全性。

title: A Durable Vision-Based Tactile Fingertip for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Currently available commercial vision-based tactile sensors provide rich contact information but remain vulnerable to abrasion and repeated concentrated loading, limiting their use in demanding robotic applications. This work presents a durable tactile fingertip comprising a soft silicone gel with a nonpigmented, textured, thin thermoplastic-polyurethane protective film and a replaceable sensing cartridge. Durability was evaluated using two accelerated laboratory procedures: a rotating-drum sanding test and a repetitive probe test applying 39.2 N (4.0 kgf) at 45 cycles per minute. Under the defined sanding conditions, the developed sensor reached the protective-film rupture endpoint after approximately 2-3 hours. During repetitive probe testing, all nine developed sensors remained functionally usable when testing was discontinued: seven after 5 days, one after 6 days, and one after 8 days. Commercial GelSight Mini and DIGIT specimens exhibited initial surface-film rupture after approximately 24-30 seconds of sanding and 25-35 minutes of repetitive loading. Damage to the developed sensor progressed gradually and produced little interference with tactile imaging at the test endpoints. These observations establish durability improvements of more than two orders of magnitude under the defined accelerated conditions. Combining increased durability, gradual degradation, and rapid cartridge replacement offers a practical approach to maintainable vision-based tactile sensing for demanding robotic applications.
summary_zh: 目前可用的商用视觉触觉传感器虽然能提供丰富的接触信息，但仍易受磨损和重复集中载荷的影响，限制了其在严苛机器人任务中的应用。本工作提出了一种耐用的触觉指尖，其结构包括含非着色、带纹理的热塑性聚氨酯薄膜的软硅胶，以及可更换的传感盒。采用两种加速实验室程序评估耐久性：转鼓砂纸测试和重复探针测试（施力39.2 N，即4.0 kgf，频率45次/分钟）。在规定的砂纸测试条件下，所研制的传感器在约2-3小时后达到保护膜破裂终点。在重复探针测试中，所有九个研制的传感器在测试终止时仍保持功能可用：七个持续5天，一个持续6天，一个持续8天。商用GelSight Mini和DIGIT样品在砂纸测试约24-30秒及重复载荷测试25-35分钟后即出现初始表面膜破裂。所研制传感器的损伤逐渐发展，并在测试终点对触觉成像的干扰极小。这些观察结果表明，在既定加速条件下，耐久性提升了两个数量级以上。兼具增强的耐久性、渐进式退化及快速传感盒更换特性，为严苛机器人应用中可维护的视觉触觉传感提供了实用方案。
tldr: This paper presents a durable vision-based tactile fingertip sensor with a protective film and replaceable cartridge, demonstrating over two orders of magnitude improvement in abrasion and impact resistance compared to commercial sensors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种耐用的视觉触觉指尖传感器，采用保护膜和可更换模块，在耐磨性和抗冲击性上比商用传感器提升了两个数量级以上。

title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Real-Time Generative Physics Simulation for Surgical Robotics
summary: Generative simulation for surgical robotics still lacks real-time interaction. Physical-robot experiments, often involving animal or cadaver labs, are time-consuming, costly, and difficult to reproduce, while classical simulators struggle to capture photorealistic appearance and deformable-tissue dynamics. We address this gap with Cosmos-H-Dreams, an integrated real-time surgical world-model system combining an action-conditioned generative model, a teacher-to-student distillation recipe, and a deployment stack built on the NVIDIA FlashDreams streaming-inference library. Starting from Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, a multi-embodiment action-conditioned surgical video world model fine-tuned on the large-scale Open-H-Embodiment corpus, we post-train this checkpoint on embodiment- and procedure-specific data. By distilling the resulting bidirectional teacher into a causal, few-step student with Self Forcing, we turn a passive video generator into a controllable surgical simulator that streams at $\sim$160 inference FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell workstation GPU. Crucially, Cosmos-H-Dreams is controller-agnostic: any interface that emits a stream of robot kinematics can drive it. We demonstrate live control through a browser keyboard over WebRTC, a Meta Quest headset over WebXR, a commercial surgical robot console such as CMR Surgical's Versius, and learned policies operating in closed loop. To our knowledge, this is the first interactive surgical world model supporting live human and policy control. Human operators and policies alike can act inside the synthesized world and observe the consequences in real time. We release Cosmos-H-Dreams as an open surgical simulation system, providing a common foundation for surgical education, scalable synthetic data generation, and future intraoperative decision support.
summary_zh: 手术机器人的生成式仿真仍缺乏实时交互能力。涉及动物或尸体实验室的实体机器人实验耗时、成本高昂且难以复现，而传统仿真器难以捕捉照片级真实外观与可变形组织动力学。我们通过Cosmos-H-Dreams弥合了这一差距——这是一个集成化的实时手术世界模型系统，结合了动作条件生成模型、教师-学生蒸馏方案，以及基于NVIDIA FlashDreams流式推理库构建的部署栈。我们从Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator出发（一个基于大规模Open-H-Embodiment语料库微调的多具身动作条件手术视频世界模型），在具身与手术专项数据上对该检查点进行后训练。通过采用自强制机制将双向教师蒸馏为因果式少步学生模型，我们将被动视频生成器转化为可控手术模拟器，在单张NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell工作站GPU上实现约160推理FPS的流式处理。关键在于，Cosmos-H-Dreams与控制器无关：任何输出机器人运动学数据流的接口均可驱动该系统。我们通过以下方式演示实时控制：基于WebRTC的浏览器键盘、基于WebXR的Meta Quest头显、商用手术机器人控制台（如CMR Surgical的Versius系统），以及闭环运行的习得策略。据我们所知，这是首个支持人类与策略实时交互控制的手术世界模型。人类操作员与策略均可在合成世界内操作并实时观察后果。我们将Cosmos-H-Dreams作为开放式手术仿真系统发布，为手术教育、可扩展合成数据生成及未来术中决策支持提供通用基础。
tldr: Cosmos-H-Dreams is the first real-time, interactive world model for surgical robotics, using a teacher-student distillation framework to enable live human and policy control with high-speed streaming inference.
tldr_zh: Cosmos-H-Dreams 是首个用于手术机器人的实时交互式世界模型，通过师生蒸馏框架实现高速流推理，支持用户和策略的实时控制。

title: Robust Slip Detection and Material Classification via Spatiotemporal Transformers on a Uniformly-Illuminated Visuo-Tactile Sensor
summary: Tactile sensing is central to robotic manipulation, among which slip detection stands out as a quintessential and critical task. However, existing slip datasets are predominantly limited to binary classification, lacking fine-grained directional perception. To address this limitation, we propose a visuo-tactile sensor featuring customized uniform RGB illumination, alongside a unified perception framework. At the hardware level, the sensor achieves high-precision, sub-millimeter depth reconstruction. Based on this capability, we collect a multi-task visuo-tactile dataset encompassing 15 objects, synchronously generating depth information for each data sample. Algorithmically, we design a dual-head TimeSformer network to process dynamic spatiotemporal slip. On unseen objects, this network achieves robust accuracies of 95.5% and 91.5% for 3-class contact state prediction and fine-grained 8-class slip direction classification, respectively. Furthermore, static tactile-based object class recognition utilizing a ResNet-50 backbone yields an outstanding accuracy of 98.8% across 15 categories. The proposed hardware-software framework provides high-fidelity feedback and a powerful multi-modal perception baseline for complex robotic manipulation.
summary_zh: 触觉传感是机器人操作的核心，其中滑动检测作为一项典型且关键的任务尤为重要。然而，现有滑动数据集主要局限于二元分类，缺乏细粒度的方向感知能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种采用定制均匀RGB照明的视触觉传感器，以及一个统一的感知框架。在硬件层面，该传感器实现了高精度、亚毫米级的深度重建。基于这一能力，我们收集了一个涵盖15个物体的多任务视触觉数据集，并为每个数据样本同步生成深度信息。在算法层面，我们设计了一个双头TimeSformer网络来处理动态时空滑动信息。在未知物体上，该网络在三类接触状态预测和八类精细滑动方向分类任务中分别达到了95.5%和91.5%的稳健准确率。此外，基于静态触觉的物体类别识别（采用ResNet-50骨干网络）在15个类别上取得了98.8%的优异准确率。所提出的软硬件框架为复杂机器人操作提供了高保真反馈和强大的多模态感知基线。
tldr: This paper presents a visuo-tactile sensor with uniform RGB illumination and a dual-head TimeSformer network for robust slip detection and material classification, achieving high accuracy in contact state prediction and slip direction classification for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种配备均匀RGB照明的视触觉传感器和双头TimeSformer网络，用于鲁棒的滑动检测和材料分类，在接触状态预测和滑动方向分类上实现了高精度，适用于机器人操作。

title: SIREN-Bench: Behavior-Driven Generation and Evaluation of Emergency-Vehicle Interactions
summary: Emergency vehicles (EMVs) can reorganize surrounding traffic as civilian vehicles brake, change lanes, or form rescue corridors in response to their passage. Evaluating these safety-critical interactions requires behavior-level control over both EMV privileges and civilian responses, together with consistent sensing and ground truth. Existing datasets and simulation benchmarks do not directly provide this combination. We present \textbf{SIREN}, a behavior-driven SUMO--CARLA co-simulation platform for generating EMV--civilian interactions. SIREN couples SUMO's network-level traffic evolution and behavior logic with CARLA's continuous vehicle control and synchronized onboard sensing; depending on the active behavior, the interaction is controlled by SUMO, CARLA, or jointly. We instantiate the platform as \textbf{SIREN-Bench-v1}, comprising seven parameterized interaction templates across emergency levels L1--L3 and three behavior families, with synchronized sensor observations and simulator-native annotations. We demonstrate the benchmark through three representative tasks: 3D object detection, trajectory prediction, and vision-language risk understanding. Evaluations of nine trajectory predictors, four LiDAR-based detectors, and five vision-language models reveal behavior-dependent failure modes. Traffic-clearance interactions are hardest for detection, privileged intersection traversal is hardest for prediction, and no learned predictor outperforms the constant-velocity reference on average. Vision-language models perform substantially better on normal traffic than on near-miss and collision events. These results demonstrate the value of behavior-centered benchmarking and establish SIREN as an extensible data-generation and evaluation platform for autonomous-driving and transportation safety research.
summary_zh: 紧急车辆（EMV）在通行时，可通过民用车辆的制动、变道或形成救援通道来重组周围交通。评估这些安全关键交互需要同时具备对EMV优先权与民用车辆响应的行为级控制能力，以及一致的感知与真值数据。现有数据集与仿真基准未能直接提供此类组合。本文提出\textbf{SIREN}，一种基于行为的SUMO--CARLA联合仿真平台，用于生成EMV-民用车辆交互场景。SIREN将SUMO的路网级交通演化与行为逻辑，同CARLA的连续车辆控制与同步车载感知相耦合；根据激活行为的不同，交互控制权由SUMO、CARLA或二者共同接管。我们将该平台实例化为\textbf{SIREN-Bench-v1}，包含覆盖紧急等级L1-L3及三类行为家族的七个参数化交互模板，并提供同步传感器观测数据与仿真器原生标注。通过三项代表性任务：三维目标检测、轨迹预测与视觉语言风险理解，我们验证了该基准的有效性。对九个轨迹预测器、四个基于LiDAR的检测器及五个视觉语言模型的评估揭示了行为依赖的失效模式。其中，交通清空交互对检测最具挑战性，优先路口穿越对预测最具挑战性，而所有学习型预测器在平均性能上均未超过恒速参考模型。视觉语言模型在常规交通场景下的表现显著优于危险接近与碰撞事件。这些结果凸显了以行为为中心的基准测试的价值，并将SIREN确立为面向自动驾驶与交通安全研究的可扩展数据生成与评估平台。
tldr: SIREN-Bench is a behavior-driven co-simulation platform (SUMO-CARLA) for generating and evaluating emergency-vehicle interactions, providing controllable traffic behaviors, synchronized sensors, and benchmark tasks for detection, trajectory prediction, and risk understanding.
tldr_zh: SIREN-Bench是一个行为驱动的SUMO-CARLA联合仿真平台，用于生成和评估紧急车辆交互场景，提供可控交通行为、同步传感器和检测、轨迹预测、风险理解等基准任务。

title: Sensorless damage-safe grasping
summary: Robotic fruit harvesting must hold produce securely without bruising it, yet compression stiffness varies several-fold with ripeness within a single species, so no fixed grip force spans the range. Rather than tune force, we bound deformation: a controller closes the gripper until the object's estimated compression strain reaches a user-specified limit $\varepsilon$, using only the encoder position and motor-effort signal on every servo gripper---no tactile or force-torque sensor. Dividing an effort-based contact force by a lower bound on object stiffness makes the stop provably conservative---true compression stays at or below $\varepsilon$---for any $\varepsilon$ above a contact-detection strain floor we identify and quantify: robust detection itself spends compression, linearly in closing speed, making speed an explicit throughput--gentleness knob. Unlike a hand-tuned force threshold, $\varepsilon$ is a certified, size-scaling, operator-interpretable damage limit, and a ready safe-action parameter for learned grasping policies. In MuJoCo simulation over a realistic fruit-stiffness range, under a sensor-noise model calibrated to the real servo, the controller holds $\ge 98\,\%$ grasp at $0\,\%$ damage across all medium-to-firm stiffnesses for the entire certified $\varepsilon$ range, which neither fixed-force baseline attains; on stiffness-graded 3D-printed TPU cubes it matches baseline grasp success at roughly half the grip force and cuts soft-object damage from $100\,\%$ to $40\,\%$.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
机器人水果采摘必须在不造成损伤的前提下稳固抓取果实，然而同一物种内，果实压缩刚度随成熟度变化可达数倍，因此单一固定抓取力无法覆盖整个范围。本文不调节抓取力，而是约束变形：控制器仅利用每个伺服夹爪的编码器位置与电机驱动力信号——无需触觉或力-力矩传感器——在估计的物体压缩应变达到用户指定的极限值$\varepsilon$时闭合夹爪。通过将基于驱动力的接触力除以物体刚度的下界，该方法可证明其保守性——对于我们识别并量化出的接触检测应变阈值以上的任意$\varepsilon$，真实压缩量始终保持在$\varepsilon$或以下。鲁棒的接触检测本身会消耗压缩量，且该消耗与闭合速度呈线性关系，从而使速度成为显式的吞吐量-轻柔度调节参数。与手动调节的力阈值不同，$\varepsilon$是一个经过认证、可随尺寸缩放、由操作员可解释的损伤极限参数，同时可作为学习型抓取策略中现成的安全动作参数。在基于真实水果刚度范围的MuJoCo仿真中，采用校准自真实伺服系统的传感器噪声模型，控制器在全部认证的$\varepsilon$范围内，对于中等到坚硬的所有刚度等级，均能实现$\ge 98\%$的抓取成功率且$0\%$损伤率，而两种固定力基准方法均无法达到；在刚度为梯度的3D打印TPU立方体上，该方法以约一半的抓取力达到与基准相当的抓取成功率，并将软物体的损伤率从$100\%$降至$40\%$。
tldr: A sensorless damage-safe grasping controller for robotic fruit harvesting that bounds deformation using only servo encoder position and motor effort, ensuring provable conservative compression limits.
tldr_zh: 一种用于机器人水果采摘的无传感器损伤安全抓取控制器，仅利用伺服编码器位置和电机力矩来限制变形，确保压缩在保守界限内。

title: Game2World Engine: Unlocking In-the-Wild Gameplay Videos for World Model Training
summary: Video games provide a scalable source of training data for video world models, offering diverse environments, complex interactions, and abundant in-the-wild gameplay videos. However, raw gameplay footage entangles the game world with screen-space interfaces, introducing game-specific biases and irrelevant dynamics that hinder world-model training. To address this problem, we introduce GameUI-Taxonomy and G2WEngine, a full-stack framework that formalizes gameplay UI grounding and removal. G2WEngine automatically extracts reusable UI assets from real gameplay videos and synthesizes temporally coherent UI overlays on clean footage. Using this engine, we construct Game2World, comprising 96K synthetic paired videos with precise reconstruction targets and 1,079 in-the-wild clips from 303 games for realistic evaluation. Its asset library contains 5,132 verified UI elements across 21 taxonomy categories, collected from 1,010 representative gameplay frames. Based on Game2World, we propose GameCleaner, a mask-free gameplay UI removal model that combines multimodal semantic understanding with video editing capabilities. Unlike mask-based methods, GameCleaner directly identifies and removes diverse HUD elements while preserving the underlying scene content and temporal dynamics. In a controlled pilot, world models trained on UI-free gameplay improve overall VideoReward by 6.83% over those trained on UI-overlaid data. On UI-removal evaluation, GameCleaner achieves an average AAR of 95.36 on synthetic videos, outperforming the strongest temporal mask baseline by 57.3%, and obtains the best in-the-wild AAR of 80.05 with 99.8 background preservation. These results demonstrate the scalable potential of transforming Internet gameplay videos into high-quality world-model training data. Code, dataset, and model will be available at https://github.com/Dongping-Chen/Game2World.
summary_zh: 电子游戏为视频世界模型提供了可扩展的训练数据来源，其涵盖多样化的环境、复杂的交互以及丰富的真实游戏视频。然而，原始游戏画面将游戏世界与屏幕界面纠缠在一起，引入了特定游戏的偏置和无关动态，阻碍了世界模型的训练。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GameUI-Taxonomy与G2WEngine——一个形式化定义游戏UI识别与去除的全栈框架。G2WEngine能够从真实游戏视频中自动提取可复用的UI资产，并在纯净画面上合成时间连贯的UI覆盖层。基于该引擎，我们构建了Game2World数据集，包含9.6万段配有精确重建目标的合成成对视频，以及来自303款游戏的1079段真实场景片段用于实际评估。其资产库包含来自1010个代表性游戏画面的5132个经过验证的UI元素，覆盖21个分类类别。基于Game2World，我们提出GameCleaner——一种无需掩码的游戏UI去除模型，融合了多模态语义理解与视频编辑能力。与基于掩码的方法不同，GameCleaner能直接识别并移除多种HUD元素，同时保留底层场景内容与时间动态。在受控先导实验中，基于无UI游戏画面训练的世界模型，在VideoReward指标上比基于含UI叠加数据训练的模型提升6.83%。在UI去除评估中，GameCleaner在合成视频上达到95.36的平均AAR，超越最强时序掩码基线57.3%，并在真实场景中获得80.05的最优AAR，同时保持99.8%的背景完整性。这些结果表明将互联网游戏视频转化为高质量世界模型训练数据具有可扩展潜力。代码、数据集与模型将发布于https://github.com/Dongping-Chen/Game2World。
tldr: This paper introduces Game2World Engine, a framework that removes UI overlays from gameplay videos to create clean training data for video world models, showing improved world model performance on UI-free data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Game2World Engine，一个从游戏视频中去除UI覆盖层以生成干净训练数据的框架，用于训练视频世界模型，并证明无UI数据能提升世界模型性能。

title: NeoWorld-Pro: Programming Interactive Scenes from Monocular Images for Embodied Simulation
summary: The advancement of Embodied AI necessitates high-quality simulation assets that faithfully mirror the real world. However, transforming raw visual observations into simulation-ready scenes remains challenging due to the lack of physical grounding and scene-level interactivity in current image-to-URDF methods. We propose NeoWorld-Pro, a framework that reformulates monocular scene reconstruction as procedural programming for interactive 3D environments. Leveraging the zero-shot reasoning and code synthesis capabilities of MLLMs, NeoWorld-Pro converts a single RGB image into executable programs specifying object geometry, articulation, and physical properties. A physics-in-the-loop mechanism then iteratively refines the generated programs by validating their execution in a physics engine, enforcing physically plausible articulations, valid object compositions and interactions, and accurate spatial relationships. Experiments show that NeoWorld-Pro outperforms open-loop and prior monocular reconstruction methods, while enabling complex downstream tasks such as stable stacking and fine-grained manipulation.
summary_zh: 具身智能的进步需要能够忠实反映真实世界的高质量仿真资源。然而，由于当前图像到URDF的转换方法缺乏物理基础与场景级交互性，将原始视觉观测转化为可直接用于仿真的场景仍具挑战。我们提出NeoWorld-Pro框架，该框架将单目场景重建重新定义为面向交互式三维环境的程序化编程。借助多模态大语言模型的零样本推理与代码合成能力，NeoWorld-Pro可将单张RGB图像转化为可执行程序，并精确指定物体几何结构、关节运动方式及物理属性。通过物理在环机制，系统在物理引擎中验证程序执行效果，迭代优化所生成的程序，确保关节运动符合物理规律、物体组合与交互有效合理、空间关系准确无误。实验表明，NeoWorld-Pro性能优于开环方法与现有单目重建技术，并能支撑稳定堆叠与精细操作等复杂下游任务。
tldr: NeoWorld-Pro converts a single RGB image into physically interactive 3D simulation scenes by using MLLMs to generate procedural programs and a physics-in-the-loop mechanism for refinement, enabling downstream embodied tasks like stacking and manipulation.
tldr_zh: NeoWorld-Pro 利用多模态大语言模型将单张 RGB 图像转化为交互式 3D 仿真场景的程序化表示，并通过物理引擎反馈迭代优化，支持堆叠与精细操作等具身智能下游任务。

title: Platonic Representation Hypothesis on World Models
summary: World models have demonstrated significant potential for perceiving and simulating complex environments. Despite their strong performance, the fundamental nature of their learned representations remains poorly understood. In this paper, we investigate the Platonic Representation Hypothesis within this domain by proposing the Predictive Consistency Assumption: we posit that the optimization of a shared state transition objective acts as a selective pressure that encourages heterogeneous models to converge toward a shared latent structure. Through systematic experiments with the DINO World Model (DINO-WM), in which we vary visual encoders to create heterogeneous models, we find that capable world models evolve toward geometrically similar internal structures. Moreover, via model stitching, we show that the internal features of one world model can be mapped to another with limited performance degradation, providing evidence of functional compatibility. Our findings suggest that the pursuit of predictive consistency can promote shared, transition-compatible latent structure across world models.
summary_zh: 世界模型在感知与模拟复杂环境方面展现了显著潜力。尽管其性能强劲，但所学表征的基本性质仍鲜为人知。本文通过提出预测一致性假设（Predictive Consistency Assumption）来探究该领域内的柏拉图表征假说（Platonic Representation Hypothesis）：我们假定，对共享状态转移目标的优化会产生一种选择性压力，促使异质模型向共享的潜在结构收敛。通过对DINO世界模型（DINO-WM）开展系统实验——实验中通过改变视觉编码器构建异质模型——我们发现，能力足够的世界模型会演化出几何相似的内部结构。此外，通过模型拼接（model stitching）实验，我们证明一个世界模型的内部特征可映射至另一模型且性能下降有限，这为功能兼容性提供了证据。我们的研究结果表明，追求预测一致性能够促进世界模型间形成共享的、与状态转移兼容的潜在结构。
tldr: This paper empirically validates the Platonic Representation Hypothesis within world models by showing that diverse models optimizing a predictive consistency objective converge to similar latent representations, as evidenced by geometric alignment and functional stitching in the DINO-WM framework.
tldr_zh: 本文在世界模型中实证验证了柏拉图式表征假说，表明通过优化预测一致性目标，异质模型会收敛到相似的潜在表示，几何对齐和功能拼接实验提供了证据。

title: WarpSAC: Towards the Pinnacle of Scalable Off-policy RL by Rethinking Exploration and Exploitation
summary:
Massively parallel simulation changes the data regime in which off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is trained, challenging stabilizers designed for data-limited replay. Through controlled experiments across eight benchmark families, we show that these stabilizers are data-regime-dependent: parameter normalization helps with narrow replay coverage but restricts value fitting when data are abundant, while clipped double-Q can be relaxed in high-throughput manipulation. Age-biased replay weighting improves learning efficiency across regimes, especially with limited network capacity.
  Based on these findings, we propose WarpSAC, a regime-aware family of off-policy RL algorithms. WarpSAC uses Sample Weight Decay for efficient exploitation and provides two variants: WarpSAC-L (Norm ON, clipped double-Q) for data-limited CPU-scale training, and WarpSAC-A (Norm OFF, single-Q) for data-abundant GPU-parallel training. WarpSAC improves normalized score--step AUC over FlashSAC by 4.5% across nine CPU-scale environments and 23.1% across fourteen GPU-parallel environments. It increases UnitreeG1TransportBox-v1 success rate from 19.8% to 96.4%, improves mean normalized wall-time AUC on MuJoCo Playground by 19.1%, and achieves 36.4% faster sim-to-real deployment on Unitree G1 than FlashSAC. These results show that scalable off-policy RL should adapt its stabilizers to the available data regime.
summary_zh:
大规模并行仿真改变了离线策略强化学习（RL）的训练数据模式，对专为数据有限回放设计的稳定器提出了挑战。通过在八个基准族上开展受控实验，我们表明这些稳定器具有数据模式依赖性：参数归一化有助于狭窄的回放覆盖，但在数据充足时会限制价值拟合；而裁剪双Q在吞吐量较高的操作中可以放宽。基于年龄偏置的回放加权在多模式下均能提升学习效率，尤其当网络容量受限时。

基于这些发现，我们提出WarpSAC——一种感知数据模式的离线策略RL算法族。WarpSAC采用样本权重衰减实现高效利用，并提供两种变体：面向数据有限CPU尺度训练的WarpSAC-L（开启归一化、采用裁剪双Q），以及面向数据充足GPU并行训练的WarpSAC-A（关闭归一化、采用单Q）。WarpSAC在九个CPU尺度环境下将归一化得分-步累计面积较FlashSAC提升4.5%，在十四个GPU并行环境下提升23.1%；将UnitreeG1TransportBox-v1成功率从19.8%提升至96.4%，在MuJoCo Playground上改善平均归一化墙钟时间累计面积达19.1%，并在Unitree G1上实现比FlashSAC快36.4%的仿真到现实部署。这些结果表明，可扩展的离线策略RL应使其稳定器适配可用数据模式。
tldr: WarpSAC proposes regime-aware off-policy RL algorithms that adapt stabilizers to data availability, achieving large improvements in GPU-parallel manipulation and sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: WarpSAC 提出了一种基于数据规模自适应调节稳定器的离策略强化学习算法，在 GPU 并行操作和 sim-to-real 迁移上取得了显著提升。

title: Fiber Bragg Grating Whiskers for Bioinspired Hydrodynamic Perception on Underwater Robots
summary: Harbor seals track hydrodynamic trails with their vibrissae, enabling passive perception of moving targets in dark or turbid water. Inspired by this capability, we present compact fiber Bragg grating (FBG) whiskers for underwater robots. Like seal whiskers, they have a non-uniform taper and elliptical cross-section. Controlled towing experiments show a monotonic relative-flow response from 0.1 to 0.6 m/s, a strong reduction of self-induced oscillation relative to a cylindrical baseline, and a pronounced dependence on angle of attack. Experiments with a pitching foil show that the whiskers can detect the characteristic vortices shed by a stationary or moving source, detectable several seconds after the source has passed. Using this information, a single front-mounted whisker enabled a small underwater robot to distinguish between continuing straight and executing a turn, selecting the correct branch in 17 of 20 trials (85.0%) from whisker signals alone. These results connect bioinspired hydrodynamic sensing to robot action and suggest the utility of whiskers for tracking underwater objects.
summary_zh: 斑海豹依靠其触须感知水动力尾迹，从而能够在黑暗或浑浊水域中被动探测运动目标。受此能力启发，我们为水下机器人研制了紧凑型光纤布拉格光栅（FBG）触须。与海豹触须相似，此类传感器具有非均匀锥形截面和椭圆横截面。受控拖曳实验表明：其在0.1至0.6米/秒流速范围内呈现单调相对流响应、相较于圆柱基准结构可显著抑制自激振荡，且对攻角具有明显依赖性。俯仰翼型实验显示，该触须能探测静止或运动源脱落的特征涡旋，甚至在源通过后数秒仍可检测到涡旋信号。基于此信息，单个前置触须即可使小型水下机器人区分直线航行与转向动作——在20次试验中，仅凭触须信号，机器人有17次（85.0%）正确选择了分支路径。这些研究结果将仿生水动力感知与机器人行为决策相衔接，揭示了触须传感器用于水下目标追踪的应用潜力。
tldr: This paper presents bioinspired fiber Bragg grating whiskers for underwater robots that enable passive hydrodynamic perception, demonstrating flow sensing, vortex detection, and navigation decision-making from whisker signals alone.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了用于水下机器人的仿生光纤布拉格光栅触须，能够实现被动水动力感知，并通过触须信号单独完成流速传感、涡流检测和导航决策。

title: Bridging Teacher Expectations and Robot Learning via Coupling Dynamics
summary: Human-robot teaching focuses on enabling nontechnical experts to customize robots according to their needs after deployment. With recent advances in machine learning, human-robot teaching is no longer confined to offline learning where the data gathering step from a human teacher is separated from when the robot learns. Instead, more recent approaches for human-robot teaching focus on coupling human teaching with robot learning. This coupling impacts the structure, timing, and content of the teaching and learning interaction. However, it is currently unclear how such coupling dynamics affect humanrobot teaching effectiveness and human perceptions towards the teaching process. Informed by human learning theories, in this paper we propose a new scale for classifying human-robot teaching interactions according to coupling dynamics present between the human teacher and robot learner. We apply this scale to a subset of the human-robot teaching literature to identify how coupling dynamics and human teacher mental model mismatches with the ground truth robot learning system affect teaching effectiveness and human perceptions towards the teaching process
summary_zh: 人机教学旨在使非技术专家能够在机器人部署后，根据自身需求对其进行定制。随着机器学习的最新进展，人机教学不再局限于离线学习——即人类教师的数据采集步骤与机器人的学习过程相分离。相反，近年来的人机教学方法更注重将人类教学与机器人学习相结合。这种结合影响了教学与学习互动的结构、时机和内容。然而，目前尚不清楚这种结合动态如何影响人机教学的有效性以及人类对教学过程的感知。受人类学习理论的启发，本文提出了一种新的分类尺度，用于根据人类教师与机器人学习者之间的结合动态对人机教学互动进行分类。我们将该尺度应用于人机教学文献的一个子集，以识别结合动态及人类教师心理模型与机器人真实学习系统之间的不匹配，如何影响教学有效性及人类对教学过程的感知。
tldr: This paper proposes a new scale to classify human-robot teaching interactions based on coupling dynamics between human teachers and robot learners, and analyzes mismatches in mental models to improve teaching effectiveness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于人类教师与机器人学习者之间耦合动力学的新尺度来分类人机教学交互，并分析了心理模型不匹配对教学效果的影响。

title: Safety-aware Model Predictive Path Integral Control with Signal Temporal Logic
summary: Safety-aware motion planning remains a challenge in robotics, especially when missions are time-critical and are under complex specifications. In this paper, we propose safety-aware-stl-mppi, a computationally efficient sampling-based receding-horizon planning framework designed to promote satisfaction of constraints expressed in Signal Temporal Logic (STL). Our approach encodes discrete-time STL formulas into candidate time-varying control barrier functions (CBF), which are integrated into a model predictive path integral (MPPI) controller. Our method inherits the benefits of low computational cost from an efficiently parallelizable sampling based planner and utilizes CBF for constraints expressed in STL. We compare against several MPPI baselines using four artificial Mars Rover planning case studies with a diverse environment and cost setups, where we show our method consistently achieving high safety and efficiency. We show a quadcopter planning experiment with NVIDIA Isaac Lab.
summary_zh: 安全感知的运动规划仍是机器人领域的一项挑战，尤其在任务对时间敏感且需满足复杂规格要求的场景中。本文提出了一种名为safety-aware-stl-mppi的计算高效型采样滚动时域规划框架，旨在提升对信号时序逻辑（STL）约束的满足能力。该方法将离散时间STL公式编码为时变控制屏障函数（CBF），并将其集成至模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器中。该框架继承了基于采样的可高效并行规划器的低计算成本优势，并利用CBF处理STL表示的约束。通过四项包含不同环境与成本设置的仿真火星车规划案例研究，我们与多个MPPI基线方法进行了对比，结果表明所提方法能持续实现高安全性与高效率。此外，我们还展示了基于NVIDIA Isaac Lab的四旋翼无人机规划实验。
tldr: This paper presents a sampling-based receding-horizon planner that integrates Signal Temporal Logic constraints via time-varying control barrier functions into an MPPI controller, achieving safe and efficient motion planning for Mars Rover and quadcopter tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于采样的滚动时域规划框架，通过将信号时序逻辑约束编码为时变控制障碍函数并集成到MPPI控制器中，在火星车和四旋翼飞行任务中实现了安全高效的运动规划。

title: Interpreting Control Latents for System Identification via Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Latent-conditioned adaptive policies can control robots across changing dynamics, but their learned latents remain internal representations of the policy rather than physical models that can be inspected, rolled out, or used by other control modules. This limits closed-loop analysis, diagnosis, and further improvement of a fixed policy. A direct mapping from latent to physical parameters is also under-specified, because multiple systems can induce similar closed-loop behavior. We therefore decode each operational latent into a distribution of quadrotor models using conditional flow matching. The decoded distribution enables two downstream uses without modifying the policy: online predictive tuning of a high-level controller around the fixed low-level policy, and robustness analysis under specified disturbances. Under perturbed actuator dynamics, decoded-model predictive tuning reduces position tracking RMSE by $23\%$ and heading RMSE by $45\%$ relative to fixed gains. Under Gaussian force disturbances, decoded-model ensembles closely predict the lateral tracking-error evolution. Together, these results show that control latents can be converted into physical model ensembles for tuning, robustness analysis, and diagnosis of frozen adaptive policies.
summary_zh: 隐条件自适应策略能够控制机器人应对变化的动力学特性，但其学习的隐变量仍作为策略的内部表征，而非可被检查、执行或由其他控制模块使用的物理模型。这限制了固定策略的闭环分析、诊断及进一步改进。由于多个系统可能产生相似的闭环行为，从隐变量到物理参数的直接映射存在欠定性问题。因此，我们利用条件流匹配将每个运行时的隐变量解码为四旋翼模型的分布。解码后的分布能够在无需修改策略的情况下实现两种下游应用：围绕固定底层策略对高层控制器进行在线预测性调优，以及指定扰动下的鲁棒性分析。在作动器动力学受扰条件下，与固定增益相比，基于解码模型的预测性调优使位置跟踪均方根误差降低23%，航向角均方根误差降低45%。在高斯力扰动条件下，解码模型集成能够精确预测横向跟踪误差的演化。这些结果表明，控制隐变量可转化为物理模型集成，用于冻结自适应策略的调优、鲁棒性分析与诊断。
tldr: This paper introduces a method using conditional flow matching to decode latent representations from adaptive robot policies into distributions of physical quadrotor models, enabling predictive tuning and robustness analysis without modifying the policy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，利用条件流匹配将自适应机器人策略中的潜在表示解码为物理四旋翼模型分布，从而在不修改策略的情况下实现预测性调优和鲁棒性分析。

title: Resilience Matters for Embodied Agents System: New Metrics, Systematic Evaluation, and Optimization
summary: Embodied Agents System (EAS) are increasingly deployed in open-world physical domains, where reliability directly dictates deployment quality and human-agent trust. However, existing evaluations rely on outcome-centric metrics as success rate or safety scores that collapse diverse execution trajectories into coarse scores, obscuring the dynamic processes underlying agent behavior. Therefore, they ignore a critical property of EAS -- which we define as the Resilience -- that reflects how EASs recover, stabilize, and extend under perturbations and across iterative updates. The lack of resilience is particularly critical in open-world environments due to continuous unexpected disruptions, thus directly affecting the quality of EAS deployment. To address this problem, we gain insight from the resilience-engineering concepts to EAS groundings and propose a novel resilience evaluation framework that can be flexibly applied to any EAS. Specifically, we define the first comprehensive resilience metrics suite for EASs system that exposes Rebound, Stability, and Graceful Extensibility across embodied tasks execution, providing a practical grounding for EAS resilience analysis. We further implement the resilience evaluation layer that transforms execution process into assessments for diagnosis and optimization. Across 400 household tasks with 10 EAS, we reveal the process-level distinction hidden by outcome metrics, including recovery cost differences among successful episodes ($ΔC_{rec}=25.2$), increased instability and task-family degradation. Metrics-guided optimizations reduce recovery cost and increase stability, graceful extensibility completion, showing the diagnostic effect of resilience evaluation. Our results reveal a trade-off among resilience characteristics, suggesting that a resilient EAS construction should be configured according to deployment-specific requirements.
summary_zh: 具身智能体系统（EAS）正越来越多地部署于开放世界物理域中，其可靠性直接决定部署质量与人机信任度。然而现有评估依赖成功率、安全分数等结果导向型指标，将多样化的执行轨迹压缩为粗略评分，遮蔽了智能体行为背后的动态过程。因此，这些评估忽视了EAS的关键属性——我们将其定义为韧性——反映系统在扰动与迭代更新中恢复、稳定及延展的能力。在开放世界环境中，由于持续突发的干扰，韧性缺失问题尤为严峻，直接影响EAS部署质量。为解决该问题，我们从韧性工程理念中汲取灵感，将其映射至EAS基础架构，并提出可灵活应用于任何EAS的新型韧性评估框架。具体而言，我们首次为EAS系统定义了综合韧性度量体系，涵盖具身任务执行中的回弹、稳定性与优雅延展性，为EAS韧性分析提供了实用基础。进一步地，我们实现了韧性评估层，将执行过程转化为面向诊断与优化的评估指标。通过对10个EAS完成400个家庭任务的实验，我们揭示了被结果指标掩盖的过程级差异，包括成功回合间的恢复成本差异（ΔC_rec=25.2）、稳定性下降及任务族退化等现象。基于度量引导的优化降低了恢复成本，提升了稳定性与优雅延展性完成度，验证了韧性评估的诊断效能。研究结果揭示了韧性特征间的权衡关系，表明韧性EAS的构建应依据部署特定需求进行配置。
tldr: This paper proposes a new resilience evaluation framework for Embodied Agent Systems, defining metrics for Rebound, Stability, and Graceful Extensibility to capture dynamic recovery processes not reflected in traditional outcome metrics, and demonstrates its diagnostic and optimization value across household tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个针对具身智能系统的新韧性评估框架，定义了回弹、稳定性和优雅扩展性指标，以捕捉传统结果指标无法体现的动态恢复过程，并在家居任务中展示了其诊断与优化价值。

title: Primate vision reveals a missing principle for robust dynamic AI
summary: How does an intelligent visual system combine what objects look like with how they move while remaining robust as appearance changes? We addressed this question by comparing human perception and neural activity in macaque inferior temporal cortex with representations from image- and video-based neural networks spanning recognition, segmentation, optic-flow processing and predictive world modeling. Temporal integration improved object representations, but most video recognition models generalized poorly when appearance was disrupted while motion structure was preserved. Humans and macaque IT remained robust. Notably, predictive world models combined strong cross-appearance generalization with the closest correspondence to IT, outperforming other video-modeling approaches in neural fidelity. Yet no model reproduced the cortical transformation from early appearance-dominated responses toward later appearance-invariant motion coding. These results identify progressive integration of motion into object representations as a principle of robust dynamic vision and implicate predictive learning as a promising route toward realizing this computation in artificial systems.
summary_zh: 智能视觉系统如何在物体外观变化时，仍能将物体的外观特征与其运动方式相结合并保持鲁棒性？我们通过比较人类感知、猕猴下颞叶皮层神经活动，与基于图像和视频的神经网络（涵盖识别、分割、光流处理及预测性世界建模）的表征，对这一问题进行了研究。时间整合改善了物体表征，但大多数视频识别模型在外观被破坏而运动结构保持不变时，泛化能力较差。人类和猕猴下颞叶皮层则保持鲁棒。值得注意的是，预测性世界模型在跨外观泛化方面表现强劲，且与下颞叶皮层的对应关系最为密切，在神经保真度上优于其他视频建模方法。然而，没有模型能够复现从早期以外观主导的反应，向后期外观不变的运动编码的皮层转变。这些结果表明，将运动逐步整合到物体表征中是鲁棒动态视觉的一个原则，并预示预测性学习是实现人工系统中该计算的有前景的途径。
tldr: Compares primate vision and AI models on robust dynamic object recognition, finding that predictive world models best match primate IT and generalize across appearance changes, but no model replicates the cortical shift from appearance to motion coding.
tldr_zh: 比较灵长类视觉与AI模型在鲁棒动态物体识别中的表现，发现预测世界模型最匹配灵长类IT区并能跨外观泛化，但尚无模型复现从外观到运动编码的皮层转变。

title: SceneReGen: Generative Reconstruction of 3D Scenes from a Single Image
summary: Single-image 3D scene reconstruction must complete partially observed objects and place them coherently in a shared observation-aligned scene frame. Object-level generative priors offer strong completion ability, but their centered, scale-normalized outputs are typically expressed in an object frame, creating a fundamental representation gap between object generation and scene reconstruction. We introduce SceneReGen, a generative reconstruction framework that reinterprets scene reconstruction as the generation and assembly of complete object assets in a shared observation-aligned scene frame. SceneReGen addresses the generation-reconstruction gap through selective pose factorization: each object's observed orientation is encoded directly in the generated mesh, while translation and scale are estimated from instance-level and global scene evidence. Given a scene image and instance masks, a geometry encoder extracts dense cues; learnable shape queries condition a pretrained DiT-based 3D generator to produce complete meshes in their observed orientations, while position queries fuse object and scene features to assemble them in the shared frame. On the 3D-FUTURE evaluation subset, SceneReGen achieves the best scene-level CD, scene-level F-Score, and 3D bounding-box IoU among the evaluated methods, ties the best object-level CD, and ranks second in object-level F-Score. Qualitative outputs in autonomous-driving and embodied-AI scenes further illustrate the potential of asset-centric reconstruction beyond indoor furniture.
tldr: SceneReGen is a generative framework that reconstructs complete 3D scenes from a single image by generating and assembling object assets in a shared observation-aligned frame, addressing the gap between object-level generation and scene-level reconstruction.
tldr_zh: SceneReGen 是一个生成式框架，能从单张图像重建完整的 3D 场景，通过生成并组装位于共享观测对齐坐标系中的物体资产，弥合了物体级生成与场景级重建之间的差距。

title: CoDrift: Compositional Drifting for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning is intrinsically multi-objective: a policy must remain compatible with the behavioral support of a fixed dataset while preferentially selecting high-value actions. We recast these objectives in a common form by viewing each as an action-space motion field that specifies how generated actions should move. This perspective enables heterogeneous learning objectives to be combined directly through field composition. Inspired by drifting models, we propose CoDrift, a compositional framework for one-step generative policy learning. CoDrift combines three objective-level fields into a unified policy field. The conditional field preserves state-dependent behavioral structure, while the marginal field pools actions across states to provide a more stable generative signal in the single-positive-sample regime of continuous-control offline RL. The value field moves generated actions toward higher-value regions. The composed field is absorbed into a stochastic generator that produces an action with a single forward pass at deployment. We evaluate CoDrift on 73 tasks from OGBench and D4RL in both offline and offline-to-online settings. CoDrift compares favorably with state-of-the-art methods and achieves the best average rank in both settings.
tldr: CoDrift proposes a compositional drifting framework for offline reinforcement learning that unifies multiple objectives into a single policy field, enabling one-step generative policy learning.
tldr_zh: CoDrift 提出了一种用于离线强化学习的组合漂移框架，将多个目标统一为单一策略场，实现一步式生成策略学习。

title: From Seeing to Acting: Smart Glasses as First-Person Intelligence Platforms
summary: Smart glasses are evolving from capture and display accessories into first-person intelligence platforms that connect human perception, persistent context, and digital or physical action. Their on-body viewpoint aligns with the wearer's vision, audition, motion, and hand-object interaction, but must operate under tight energy, thermal, privacy, and feedback constraints. Despite rapid progress in augmented reality, egocentric vision, multimodal models, human-computer interaction, and embodied intelligence, the literature remains fragmented across devices, tasks, and benchmarks. \textit{The key challenge is not whether a model can recognize, answer, remember, or act in isolation, but whether a complete system can sustain a reliable, temporally valid, correctable, and governable perception-state-interaction-action loop.} This survey is \textit{the \textbf{first} to systematically study smart glasses through such a unified framework}. We formalize first-person data flow and constrained task utility, characterize devices along eight verifiable hardware capability axes, organize the literature around seven interdependent foundational capabilities, and introduce an L0-L5 framework spanning capture, reactive perception, contextual assistance, persistent state, governed action, and embodied coupling.
